author: susanna-wesley
fields.title: Susanna Wesley
fields.subtitle: Ebyafaayo Ebyawandiikibwa Eliza Clarke
fields.description: Ebyafaayo bya Susanna Wesley ebyawandiikibwa Eliza Clarke. Susanna ye yali nnyina wa John ne Charles Wesley, era amaka ge ag'entegeka n'okuyigiriza kwe okw'obugumiikiriza mu Epworth byayamba okukuza abasajja babiri ku abo abasinga obukulu mu Bukristaayo bw'e Bungereza. Ekitabo kimugoberera okuva lwe yazaalibwa okutuusa lwe yafuuka nnamwandu: obufumbo bwe, engeri gye yatendekamu abaana be, omuliro ogwayokya ennyumba y'omusumba, n'ebigezo n'okukkiriza kwe okunywevu mu myaka gye egy'oluvannyuma. Kye kifaananyi ky'okutya Katonda okw'akasirise, okugumiikiriza wakati mu bizibu.

qa.question: Ebyafaayo bino ebya Susanna Wesley byogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Bwe bulamu bwa Susanna Wesley nga Eliza Clarke bwe yabuwandiika. Susanna ye yali nnyina wa John ne Charles Wesley, era amaka ge ag'entegeka n'okuyigiriza kwe okw'obugumiikiriza mu Epworth byayamba okukuza abasajja babiri ku abo abasinga obukulu mu Bukristaayo bw'e Bungereza. Ekitabo kimugoberera okuva lwe yazaalibwa, okuyita mu bufumbo bwe, engeri gye yakuzaamu amaka amanene mu mpisa ennywevu, ebigezo bye n'okukkiriza kwe, n'obuyinza bwe obw'olubeerera ku batabani be abaakulembera okuzuukuka kw'enjiri.

qa.question: Susanna Wesley yali ani?
qa.answer: Susanna Wesley (1669–1742) yali Mungereza omukazi ajjukirwa okusinga byonna nga nnyina wa John Wesley, eyatandika ekibiina ky'Abametodisiti, ne Charles Wesley, omuwandiisi w'ennyimba omukulu. Yali mukazi ow'amagezi amangi era ow'okutya Katonda okw'obuziba, n'akuza amaka amanene mu mbeera enzibu mu nnyumba y'omusumba ey'e Epworth, era okuyigiriza kwe okw'entegeka n'obuyinza bwe obw'omwoyo byakuza nnyo batabani be abaatiikirivu.

qa.question: Lwaki ayitibwa 'Nnyina w'Abametodisiti'?
qa.answer: Kubanga amaka ge ag'entegeka n'empisa ennywevu, n'okutendeka abaana be mu by'omwoyo n'obwegendereza, byazimba omusingi gw'empisa n'okwewaayo John ne Charles Wesley kwe baazimba. Engeri ye ey'entegeka ey'okukuza n'okuyigiriza amaka ge, n'okukkiriza kwe okunywevu, byakuza nnyo abasajja abaakulembera okuzuukuka kw'Abametodisiti, ne kiba nti emirundi mingi assibwamu ekitiibwa nga nnyina waakyo mu mwoyo.

qa.question: Amaka ge mu Epworth gaali gatya?
qa.answer: Gaali ga ntegeka, ga mpisa ennywevu, era ga kutya Katonda, wadde nga waaliwo obwavu, ebizibu, n'abaana bangi nnyo. Susanna yawa buli mwana obwegendereza n'okuyigiriza okwa bulijjo, n'afuga amaka ng'agoberera amateeka agaategekebwa, era n'akuuma obulamu obw'omwoyo obw'amaanyi munda mu go. Amaka gano ag'empisa n'okusaba gaafuuka ennimiro mwe zaamera empisa n'engeri ezaali ku batabani be abaatiikirivu.

qa.question: Bizibu ki bye yayitamu?
qa.answer: Bingi — obwavu, bba eyali omuzibu era emirundi mingi nga taliiwo, okufa kw'abaana be abawerako, omuliro ogwayokya ennyumba y'omusumba ne gubulako katono okutwala John omuto, n'obuzito obwa bulijjo obw'okukuza amaka amanene n'ebintu ebitono. Ebyafaayo bino biraga okukkiriza kwe n'obunywevu bwe mu bigezo bino, era ekyo kye kimu ku bifuula olugero lwe okuba olw'omuwendo ng'ekyokulabirako ky'okugumiikiriza okw'okutya Katonda.

qa.question: Yakwata atya ku John ne Charles Wesley?
qa.answer: Mu ngeri ey'obuziba era ey'olubeerera. Okuyigiriza kwa Susanna okw'entegeka, okunyiikiriza kwe ku mpisa ennywevu n'eddiini ey'omuntu ku bubwe, n'okukkiriza kwe okw'amaanyi byakuza empisa n'enzikiriza za batabani be okuva mu buto. John okusingira ddala yeeyongera okumuwandiikira ku by'omwoyo ne bwe yali amaze okukula, era n'assa ekitiibwa mu magezi ge, era 'enkola' ey'empisa ennywevu eyatuuma Abametodisiti erinnya lyabwe yava nnyo mu maka ge yazimba.

qa.question: Ani asaanidde okusoma ebyafaayo bino?
qa.answer: Buli ayagala okumanya emirandira gy'Abametodisiti n'okuzuukuka kw'enjiri, ebyafaayo by'obulamu bw'amaka g'Ekikristaayo, oba abakazi abatera okwerabirwa abaali emabega w'ebibiina ebinene. Kiwa ekifaananyi ekizzaamu amaanyi eky'omukazi eyatya Katonda era omukozi, era kiraga n'amaka agaayamba okukuza John ne Charles Wesley.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanidde kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, ng'agoberera obulamu bwa Susanna mu nsengeka yaabwo okuva mu kukula kwe, okuyita mu bufumbo bwe, obuzadde bwe, n'emyaka gye egy'oluvannyuma. Nga bwe biri ebyafaayo ebigenda mu maaso, bigendereddwa okusomebwa mu nsengeka, omusomi alyoke alabe engeri empisa ze n'okukkiriza kwe gye byakula, n'engeri amaka ge ag'entegeka gye gaakuzaamu abatabani abaakyusa Obukristaayo bw'e Bungereza.

fields.title: Okuzaalibwa n'Olulyo
fields.body_html:
EBIBINJA by'Ekkanisa erwana mu nsi yonna tebyali bikulemberwa muduumizi asinga John Wesley. Obuzaaliranwa bw'eby'olutalo bwali bwa maanyi mu buli kitundu ky'amagezi ge ag'obwangu n'omubiri gwe omutono naye ogw'amaanyi, era obusobozi bwe obw'okutegeka oboolyawo bwe bwasinga nnyo enjigiriza yonna gye yayigiriza okukuuma eggye ly'Abametodisiti nga litambula n'amaanyi mu nteekateeka ennungi okumala emyaka kikumi mu ataano egiyise. Ate era yalina ekirabo ky'okwogera okusikiriza ennyo, okwasikanga abantu ne bamugoberera ng'ebibiina by'abantu bwe byagoberera Peter the Hermit, era okwawalirizanga abantu okwewaayo nga bwe kyali mu kuyigiriza kwa Ignatius Loyola. Yazaalibwa nga mukulembeze w'abantu, eyagenderanga butereevu ku nsonga ye, n'agituukiriza olw'obukulu bwe bwe yasinga abalala. Muganda we Charles yamufuula omumyuka we omulungi ennyo; Charles oyo, singa teyaliko John, oboolyawo yandibadde n'obulamu obw'emirembe era obw'okutya Katonda, n'aba omusumba w'ekigo omunyiikivu era ow'empisa ennungi, ng'alina akatono ku magezi g'abasomi, nga kitaawe bwe yali. Abantu nga John tebazaalibwa buli mulembe, era bwe balabika, batera kuba bava mu lulyo olwalaga ebitone mu bantu abamu kinnoomu, naye nga terunnaba kukung'aanya maanyi gaalwo gonna mu muzzukulu omu.

Mu byafaayo by'olulyo ng'olwo temubula bubonero obulaga nnabbi, kabona oba omulabi ajja, era olw'ensonga eyo obulamu bw'abajjajjaabe bulimu ebisikiriza ennyo. Abalenzi batera okwoleka bulungi ennyo empisa za bannyaabwe, n'olwekyo mu Susanna Wesley mwe tusaanidde okunoonyeza ensulo enkweke ez'amaanyi agataggwaawo n'okutegeera okw'amaanyi ebyaleetera mutabani we okweyoleka ennyo ng'omuntu ow'ettutumu mu banne. Singa teyaliko ye, kirabika ekijjukizo kye kyandibuze; kubanga mu maaso g'abantu ab'ebweru, yali mukyala bukyala ow'omusumba omwavu ow'omu kyalo eyali alwanagana n'obulamu, ng'alina "ensawo ejjudde obusaale" ey'abaana nga bwe kyogerwa, ensimbi entono, n'okwekuuma ekitiibwa okutaggwaawo, okuyitibwa "amalala amalungi." Ye yali omwana ow'amakumi abiri mu ataano era asembayo obuto owa kitaawe, Dr. Samuel Annesley, gwe yazaala ne mukyala we ow'okubiri, era yazaalibwa mu Spital Yard nga 20 Janwali 1669. Ku ludda lwa kitaawe ne ku lwa nnyina yali wa lulyo lwa kitiibwa. Kitaawe wa nnyina, John White, eyazaalibwa e Higlan mu Pembrokeshire, nga bangi ku Bawelisi abalala bwe baakola, yatikkirwa mu Jesus College, Oxford; oluvannyuma yasomera mu Middle Temple n'afuuka bencher, omu ku bakulu b'ekibiina ky'abawolereza. Kirabika yali munnamateeka omulungi era omuntu eyagaggawala, kubanga tusanga nga yalina bakasitoma bangi nnyo ab'Abapuritaani, era mu 1640 yalondebwa okuba omubaka wa Paalamenti (M.P.) owa Southwark. Mu Paalamenti yamanyibwa ng'omubaka omunyiikivu era asiikuula ensonga mu kibiina ekyali kiwakanya Kabaka, Charles I., era kirabika yalina omugabo ogw'enkukunala mu bintu ebyaviirako okufa kwa kabaka oyo ow'ekisiraani. Teyasirika wadde okusirikirira ng'ensonga y'Obulabirizi eteesebwako, era yandyagadde nnyo okulaba ebifo by'abadiikoni, bakabona n'abalabirizi nga biggyibwawo. Yali ssentebe w'Akakiiko k'eby'Eddiini, era mu kifo ekyo yalina okwekenneenya emisango gy'abasumba kikumi abaali beeyisa mu ngeri ey'ensonyi. Emisango egyo yagifulumya mu kitabo ekya quarto eky'empapula ataano mu musanvu, era kopi yaakyo, ng'eriko omutwe The First Century of Scandalous and Malignant Priests, esobola okulabibwa mu British Museum. Ate era Omwami White yali omu ku b'Olukiiko lw'Abayivu b'eby'Eddiini olwa Westminster (Westminster Assembly of Divines); era olw'okwetabula n'obutateredde bw'ebiseera ebyo, obunyiikivu bwe obw'obuzaaliranwa, n'ebbugumu ly'okwawukana kw'ebibiina, yeemalako amaanyi n'afa ku myaka ataano mu ena gyokka, egyali emitono, n'aziikibwa n'emikolo mingi mu Temple Church nga 29 Janwali 1644. Ku ntaana ye ne bateekako ejjinja lya mabaale eriwandiikiddwako bino: — Wano wagalamidde John, ettaala eyayaka era emasamasa, Erinnya lye, obulamu bwe n'ebikolwa bye byonna byali Byeru (White).

Awatali kubuusabuusa, jjajja wa jjajjaawe ku ludda lwa nnyina ono gwe Charles Wesley gwe yayogerako emyaka mingi oluvannyuma, muwala we Sally bwe yagaana okukkiriza nti bakabaka bafuga ku bwa Katonda; n'asunguwalira obujeemu bwe n'agamba nti, "Nkakasa ddala, omusaayi ogw'obujeemu ogwa bajjajjaabe abamu gukulukuta mu misuwa gye!"

Dr. Annesley yennyini yali wa lulyo lwa bakungu, era ekyo kyalabikiranga ku buli kitundu kye. Kitaawe ne Earl wa Anglesey ow'omu biseera ebyo baali baana ba basajja ab'oluganda: bakitaabwe baali booluganda. Samuel Annesley yali mwana omu yekka, era yaweebwa erinnya ery'obubatizo eryasikirwa bazzukulu be bangi nnyo, ku kusaba kwa jjajjaawe omukyala omutukuvu eyayitibwa okuwummula nga tannazaalibwa. Yazaalibwa mu 1620 e Haseley mu Warwickshire, n'asikira obugagga bungi. Yalina ekisiraani eky'okufiirwa kitaawe ng'alina emyaka ena gyokka, n'akuzibwa nnyina, eyalabika okuba omukyala eyatyanga Katonda ennyo. Kijjukirwe nti eddiini ye yali ensonga eyasinga okwokya mu biseera ebyo, era enzikiriza y'Abapuritaani yali ku ntikko yaayo; wadde nga waaliwo abantu bangi abatya Katonda era ab'eby'okulabirako ebirungi mu kibiina ekyali kibawakanya, kye twandiyise kati High Church. Annesley omuvubuka yayingira Queen's College, Oxford, ng'alina emyaka kkumi n'etaano, n'akola bulungi eyo, era mu kiseera kyayo n'afuna diguli ye eya M.A. Bwe yali wa myaka amakumi abiri mu ena era ng'amaze okusalawo n'obwegendereza okufuula Ekkanisa omulimu gwe, ensonga z'eggwanga zaali zituuse ku kizibu ekinene. Charles I. yali alangiridde olutalo ku Paalamenti, ne kwiini we yali asaabaze okuva e Dover n'amayinja ag'omuwendo ag'engule, ng'asuubira okugatunda, alyoke afunire ebyokulwanyisa omwami we gwe yali ayagala ennyo. Ab'ekibiina kya Kabaka ne bava mu bifo byabwe mu House of Commons, awo ababaka abaasigalawo ne beegatta wamu nnyo, ne bawandiika abasirikale ba militia, ne balonda Earl wa Warwick okuba Omuduumizi w'Eggye ly'oku Mazzi. Ye yennyini, olw'okwagala omuvubuka oyo baali baliraanye mu ssaza, era bwe yafuna ebbaluwa ekakasa okutuuzibwa kwe ng'eteekeddwako emikono gy'abasumba musanvu, ye yamufunira diguli ya LL.D. n'amulonda okuba omusumba w'eggye ku lyato ly'olutalo eryayitibwa Globe. Naye ekifo ekyo tekyamusanyusa Samuel Annesley, era amangu ddala tumusanga ng'akivuddemu, n'akkiriza ekigo kya Cliffe mu Kent, ekyaleetanga pawundi nga ebikumi bina buli mwaka. Ekigo kino kyali kisigadde nga tekiriimu musumba olw'okugobwa kw'omusumba eyasooka olw'obwenzi, n'olwekyo okulondebwa kwe kirabika kwe kulaga nti yali amanyiganye ne John White, muwala we gwe yawasa oluvannyuma. Naye nga tannatuula e Cliffe, yali awasizza omukyala omuto, eyamuzaalira omwana ow'obulenzi, gwe baatuuma Samuel nga kitaawe. Omukyala oyo yafa, n'aziikibwa mu kifo ekitukuvu eky'ekkanisa (chancel) omwami we mwe yaweerezanga, era omwana we omuto yamala emyaka ena gyokka nga maama we afudde, n'aziikibwa eyo mu 1653. Dr. Annesley yawakanyizibwa nnyo bwe yasooka okutuuka e Cliffe, kubanga abantu baali ba mpisa nga ez'omusumba waabwe eyasooka, era omusumba omuggya ne bamwaniriza n'ebisoggo, n'emiti egy'amannyo egikung'aanya omuddo, n'amayinja. Ekyo tekyamutiisa n'akatono; yabakakasa nti ye yali omuntu asembayo okutiisibwa n'adduka mu kifo kye, era nti yandisigadde e Cliffe okutuusa lwe bandibadde nga bategekeddwa okuyita mu ye okufuna obuweereza bw'omuntu omulala asinga. Yakola nga bwe yasuubiza, era n'afuna essanyu ery'okulaba enkyukakyuka ennene mu bo nga tannayitibwa kugenda walala.

Mu 1648 ne balangirira olunaku lw'okusiiba olw'eggwanga lwonna olutukuvu, era Dr. Annesley n'ayitibwa okubuulira mu maaso ga House of Commons. Okubuulira kwe kwamuleetera okuganja ennyo, era ne kukubibwa mu kyapa ku kiragiro; kwalimu ekitundu Paalamenti kye yasiima ennyo mu mbeera gye yalimu mu kiseera ekyo, naye ekyanyiiza ennyo ab'ekibiina kya Kabaka, abaakiraba, mu butuufu, ng'okuvvoola Kabaka, eyali asibiddwa mu kiseera ekyo mu Carisbrooke Castle. Okusinziira ku bigambo by'omusumba oyo omuto yennyini, ebikyasangibwa mu State Paper Office, Kabaka bwe yattibwa mu mwaka ogwaddako, yalangirira mu lwatu nti alaba nga kwali "kutemula kwa ntiisa," n'ayogera ku Cromwell nti ye "mukuusa asinga bonna eyali atawaanyizza Ekkanisa ya Kristo," n'ayogera n'ebirala ebitaliimu kitiibwa ku abo abaali bafuga; ebigambo ebyo bwe byatuusibwa eri abalala, ne bimuviirako okuva e Cliffe, oba oboolyawo okugobwayo, ekyanakuwaza ennyo ab'ekigo kye, abaali bayize okumwagala n'okumwesiga.

Abatuuze b'ekigo kya St. John the Evangelist, Friday Street, Cheapside, bonna mu ddoboozi limu ne bamulonda okuba omusumba waabwe mu 1652; era wadde ng'ayogera ku kigo ekyo nti kye kyali kisinga obutono mu London, kyeyoleka nti yamalayo emyaka mukaaga oba musanvu. Kirabika yawasa Miss White amangu ddala nga yaakatuula mu kibuga ekikulu. Nti yandyagadde nnyo okugenda awalala kiweebwa obukakafu olw'okulangirira kwe nti Cromwell emirundi ebiri yagaana okumuwa ekigo ekyaleetanga pawundi ebikumi bina buli mwaka, wadde nga ye yali alondeddwa nnannyini kifo (patron). Kyokka mu Julaayi 1657 Omukuumi w'Eggwanga (Protector) yawa Annesley omulimu gw'okusomesa akawungeezi ku Lunaku lwa Mukama e St. Paul's, ogwamuleeteranga pawundi kikumi mu abiri buli mwaka; era oluvannyuma lw'emyezi kkumi n'ebiri, olw'ekisa kya Richard Cromwell, n'afuulibwa omusumba wa St. Giles', Cripplegate, wadde ng'abatuuze abamu tebaakyagala, abo abaasaba Charles II. ku Kuzzibwawo kw'Obwakabaka (Restoration) okumuggyawo. Kyokka kabaka oyo yamukakasa mu kifo kye — oboolyawo kubanga teyayagala kukola nkyukakyuka za bwangu oba ez'amaanyi ennyo.

Dr. Annesley yali muntu wa kitiibwa nnyo mu basumba b'Abapuritaani, ka abe nga yasiima okuttibwa kwa "Kabaka eyafiirira eddiini" oba nedda, kubanga yali omu ku bakulu abaalondebwa mu Tteeka lya Paalamenti okusiima n'okukkiriza abaweereza b'Enjiri mu nkola y'Abapresbyteri. Tewali kubuusabuusa nti yandyagadde okusigala mu kigo kye n'okuganja eri Kabaka, kubanga obuzaaliranwa bwe obw'olulyo bwali bwa kumufuula ow'ekibiina kya Kabaka okusinga ow'ekibiina kya Paalamenti (Roundhead). Naye ensonga bwe yatuuka ku muntu ow'omunda, yanywerera ku misingi gye, era mu 1662, Etteeka ly'Okufaanagana (Act of Uniformity) bwe lyayisibwa, yagaana okulikkiriza, era nga Howe ne Baxter, n'abasumba enkumi bbiri abasinga obulungi n'okumanyika mu biseera ebyo, n'agobwa ku Lunaku lwa St. Bartholomew. Earl wa Anglesey yafuba nnyo okusendasenda muganda we ow'olulyo okugondera, n'amusuubiza okumulinnyisa mu bifo; naye tekyasoboka kumukyusa, era yabuuliranga emirundi mingi mu kyama, wadde nga emyaka kkumi gyayitawo nga Ekirangiriro ky'Obuddembe (Declaration of Indulgence) tekinnamusobozesa mu mirembe okufunira olukusa Ennyumba ey'Okukung'aaniramu mu Little St. Helen's, mwe yaweerezanga ekibiina ekinene era ekyamwagalanga okutuusa lwe yafa. Yali musajja mulungi nnyo mu ndabika, muwanvu era wa kitiibwa, ng'alina omubiri ogw'amaanyi ennyo, era abaana be abamu baamufaanana mu bulungi bw'endabika. Okugeraageranya ebifaananyi bye n'eby'abantu abalamu abava mu lulyo lwe kulaga nti ennyindo ye eyeewese ng'omumwa gw'empungu, omumwa gwe ogw'okungulu omumpi, enviiri ze eza kitaka ezeewetaweta, n'amaaso ge ag'amaanyi ennyo era agaawangaala, byasikirwa nnyo bazzukulu be. Kyokka bake ku bo be baali abawanvu, wadde ng'abasinga obungi babadde ba maanyi era abagumu.

Yayagalanga nnyo mukyala we, era amaka gaabwe gaayongerangako omwana buli mwaka, n'okusingawo. Waaliwo abalenzi babiri, Samuel eyafiira e Buyindi, ne Benjamin eyali omukwasi w'ebintu (executor) by'endaame ya kitaawe, naye abaana abasinga obungi baali bawala. Judith yali mukyala mulungi nnyo era ow'amagezi amagumu, ekifaananyi kye kyakubibwa Sir Peter Lely; Anne yali wa magezi ag'okusaaga ate nga mulungi, n'afumbirwa omusajja omugagga; Elizabeth, eyafumbirwa Dunton, omutunzi w'ebitabo ow'enjawulo, yali mulungi nnyo mu ndabika, wa mutima mulungi, era oboolyawo yali kumpi n'okutuukirira ng'omuntu yenna ow'omubiri bw'ayinza okuba. Waaliwo ne Sarah n'abalala basatu, be tutamanyiiko kirala kyonna wabula nti baakula ne bafuuka bakazi ne bafumbirwa. Susanna yali mugonvu mu mubiri era mulungi nnyo, era yasigaza obulungi bwe n'enkula y'omubiri ennungi okutuusa mu bukadde, wadde nga yazaala abaana kkumi na mwenda.

Waliwo olugero olumanyiddwa ennyo ku Rev. Thomas Manton, eyabatiza Susanna: mukwano gwe bwe yamubuuza Dr. Annesley "amatabi g'emizeeyituuni" ameka ge yalina, n'addamu nti baali dazeeni bbiri oba ekitundu kimu kya kuna eky'ekikumi. Kyokka kirabika nti mu muwendo guno omunene abamu baafa nga bakyali bawere. Naye era, ensawo yali ejjudde obusaale ddala, wadde nga, kubanga abazadde tebaali baavu n'akatono, bonna abaawonawo baalabirirwa bulungi era ne basomesebwa bulungi mu bujjuvu.

fields.title: Obuvubuka n'Obufumbo
fields.body_html:
Ne bwe kiba nti Susanna Annesley yali abulwa ebimu ku bigezo by'abawala ab'omu kiseera ekyo, Olungereza olutuufu olutaliiko kamogo yali alumanyi bulungi ddala; yalina ebigambo ebimukulukutira mangu, amagezi ag'obuzaaliranwa mangi, era n'ekirabo eky'okuwandiika ebbaluwa — ekirabo ekiteeberezebwa nti kyabula mu nsi bwe waatandikibwawo Penny Post (okuweereza ebbaluwa ku peni emu). Kirabika yali amanyiiko Olufalansa ekimala okusoma ebitabo by'abawandiisi ebyangu; naye mu myaka omuwala ow'emyaka gye era ow'obusobozi bwe we yandibadde asoma ebitabo eby'amagezi n'eby'olulimi, kirabika yali ayiga ebibuuzo by'eddiini ebyali bikubaganyizibwako ebirowoozo mu kiseera ekyo. Kya mazima nti bye byali bisinga okubeera mu birowoozo by'abantu bonna; naye era kya mazima nti kitaawe, Dr. Annesley, yali yalekayo enkaayana, era teyayongera wadde akatabo kamu ku ggye eddene ery'obutabo obw'enkaayana obwajjula ensi mu biseera ebyo. Yali muntu wa mutima mugazi era ow'endowooza engazi, era tewali bujulizi businga kino: muwala we asembayo obuto, nga tannaweza myaka kkumi n'esatu, yaweebwa eddembe lingi bwe lityo ery'okugoberera omwoyo gwe, n'alondawo mu bugenderevu okwegatta ku Kkanisa ya Bungereza mu kifo ky'okusigala mu Bakontanya, kitaawe be yali yeegattako.

Oboolyawo yakkiriziganya naye mu mutima; ka kibe ki, teyamunenya wadde okumuziyiza. Okutuusa ku nkomerero y'obulamu bwe, Susanna ye yasigala omwana we gwe yasinga okwagala, era ye gwe yakwasa ebiwandiiko by'amaka, ebyo, eky'ennaku, ebyayokebwa mu muliro ogwazikiriza ennyumba y'omusumba e Epworth emyaka mingi oluvannyuma. Mu bagenyi abangi abaakyalanga mu nnyumba eyo ey'okusembeza abagenyi mu Spital Yard mwalimu Samuel Wesley, ow'olunyiriri oluwanvu olw'" abakungu n'abayivu," nga bwe baayitibwa omu ku bazzukulu be. Yali abeera era ng'asomera mu ssomero lya Rev. Edward Veal ery'Abakontanya e Stepney, era yali muyizi ateekeddwako essuubi, ng'alina ekkalaamu ewandiika amangu. Olunyiriri lw'ennyumba ye lwali lusobola okulondoolwa okutuuka mu biseera bya Athelstan, bwe baali abantu abassibwamu ekitiibwa, oboolyawo nga be bakyasigaddewo ku kika ekirungi eky'edda ekyali kiweddemu amaanyi. Baali bakwatagana n'amasaza ga Devon ne Somerset, bulijjo nga bawasa era nga bafumbirwa mu maka agasinga ekitiibwa; abamu ku bo baalwanira mu Ireland ne bafunayo ebintu. Kimala okwongerako nti Lord Mornington, Duke wa Wellington, Sir Robert Ker Porter ne bannyina, abawandiisi b'engero abaatutumuka, baali mu b'ekika kyabwe n'ab'oluganda lwabwe, okulaga nti ebitone bingi era eby'enjawulo, n'amaanyi amangi ennyo, byali birabo bye baasikira. Samuel Wesley yali mutabani wa Rev. John Wesley, eyali omusumba (vicar) w'e Winterborn, Whitchurch, mu Dorsetshire, omu ku basumba abaagobwa mu bifo byabwe, era yali muzzukulu wa Rev. Bartholomew Wesley, eyawasa Ann Colley ow'e Castle Carbery, Ireland, era eyali mutabani owookusatu owa Sir Herbert Wesley gwe yazaala mu mukazi we, era kizibwe we, Elizabeth Wesley ow'e Daugan Castle, Ireland. Ebintu bino ebitono kirabika bijja kutangaaza eri abasinga obungi ensonga enkulu ezikwata ku b'oluganda lw'ennyumba eno n'ebyo bye baali batera okwagala.

Samuel Wesley okuva mu buto bwe yali mukozi munyiikivu, era olw'okuba nti okusoma kwe okumala emyaka mingi tekwakwata kkubo lye yali ayagala, yeesalira amagezi ne yeefunira yekka okusomera mu yunivasite, okwetaagisa ennyo eri omuyivu. Omusingi gw'okusoma okugazi gwateekebwa mu Free School e Dorchester, gye yasigala okutuusa lwe yali kumpi okuweza emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, kitaawe bwe yafa, n'aleka nnamwandu n'abaana mu bwavu bungi. Awo mikwano gy'abazadde bombi Abakontanya ne bajja ne bafunira mutabani waabwe omukulu ateekeddwako essuubi sikaala (exhibition) ya pawundi asatu buli mwaka, ze baakuŋŋaanya bokka, ne bamusindika e London, ewa Omwami Veal e Stepney, gye yamala emyaka ng'ebiri.

Waliwo ebintu bibiri ebitatera kwawukana ku muntu alina akatono ku musaayi gw'Abairisi — naddala mu bantu ab'eddaala erya waggulu n'abayivu — obwangu obw'ekitalo obw'okuwandiikawandiika, n'okwagala okw'omuliro okw'okwenyigira mu nkaayana entono. Byombi byalabikira mangu mu Samuel Wesley, kubanga amangu ddala yatandika okwetaba mu kuyiiya ebitontome n'okwenyigira mu bibiina eby'enkaayana, era n'asanyusa nnyo abaali bamuyamba ne bakuba mu kyapa bingi ku bitontome bye eby'amagezi n'okusaaga (jeux d'esprit). Dr. Owen yamuwa ebigambo eby'amagezi, oboolyawo ng'atya nti essanyu ery'okulaba ebiwandiiko bye mu kyapa liyinza okumutamiiza n'alagajjalira okusoma okw'amaanyi okusingawo. Yabuulirira omuvubuka oyo yeemalire ku kuyiga okw'ekikugu okw'okwekenneenya ebiwandiiko, era eddagala eryo erikaawa n'aliwoomesa ekirabo kya pawundi kkumi buli mwaka ng'empeera y'empisa ennungi n'okukulaakulana mu kusoma. Olw'okuvunaanibwa obutasalako mu mbuga z'abalamuzi, Omwami Veal yawalirizibwa okuggala essomero lye, era omuyizi we omuto omugezi n'atwalibwa mu ly'Omwami Charles Morton, M.A., ow'e Newington Green, eryali mu kiseera ekyo lisinga amalala gonna mu masomero g'Abakontanya. Kirabika nnyina wa Samuel Wesley ne ssenga we atafumbirwangako baasengukira e London, era n'abeeranga nabo. Emirimu gy'okuwandiika n'empeera yaagyo ne bimuggulirwawo, kubanga yakwasibwa omulimu gw'okuvvuunula ebimu ku biwandiiko bya John Biddle, eyali atwalibwa nga kitaawe w'Abayunitaliyani mu Bungereza; naye kigambibwa nti olw'okuba nti mu mwoyo gwe teyasobola kusiima ndowooza ebiwandiiko ebyo gye byali bitwala, yaguvaako.

Kyokka okwagala okuwandiika ebitontome ebiduulira abalala kwasigala kwa maanyi, era ne kwongera okukoleezebwa bwe yasisinkana mu maka ga Dr. Annesley John Dunton, omusuubuzi w'ebitabo, eyali mu kiseera ekyo asaba Elizabeth Annesley amufumbirwe. Bombi baafuuka ba mukwano nnyo, nga bwe kitera okubaawo omukubi w'ebitabo omugagga bw'asisinkana omuvubuka alina ekitone ky'okuwandiika, ng'ekitone kye eky'enjawulo kitambulira wamu n'ebyo abantu b'omu kiseera ekyo bye baali baagala. Okuva olwo ensimbi ze yafunanga mu kuwandiika zaamuyambanga nnyo okwebeezaawo, era yali azeetaaga, kubanga yali atandise okwemulugunya ku Bakontanya n'okusanga ensobi mu njigiriza zaabwe. Dr. Owen yayagala ye n'abalala abamu bafune diguli mu emu ku yunivasite za Bungereza, ng'alowooza nti embeera eyinza okukyuka mangu, Abakontanya ne bakkirizibwa okufuna diguli eza bulijjo; naye ekirowoozo nti omu ku bo ayinza okuvaako ku misingi gy'Obukontanya kirabika tekyayingira mu mutwe gw'omusajja oyo omulungi. Era kirabika nti " omusumba ow'ekitiibwa era omulungi " ow'omu nnyumba ya Wesley yava ewala nnyo n'ajja e London, n'ayogera n'owooluganda lwe omuto mu bugumu ng'amulabula ku " kwawukana kw'Abakontanya " ; kale kirabika ebintu bingi byegatta okuleetera Samuel, ng'aweza emyaka abiri mu gumu, okuleka mikwano gye Abakontanya ne yeegatta ku Kkanisa ya Bungereza. Ate era yali amaliridde okugenda e Oxford, era ng'omuvubuka alina omwoyo ogw'amaanyi, mazima teyandyagadde kuziyizibwa n'okulemesebwa mu kusoma kwe mu yunivasite ng'ayingira mu kifo ekyo eky'okuyigiramu nga si wa Kkanisa ya Bungereza. Kino kyali kyekyusa okuva mu ndowooza gye yalimu bwe yawandiika ebitontome ebiduulira n'okusekerera abaali ku ludda olulala olw'ensonga eyo; era enkovu z'okuyigganyizibwa n'enkaayana zaali zikyali mpya nnyo, ne kiba nti mikwano gye abaali bagoberera obulamu bwe okutuusa olwo tebaasobola kulowooza nti " enkola zaffe entono zirina olunaku lwazo" era nti oluvannyuma "ziggwaawo."

Emitima gy'abantu gye gimu mu mirembe gyonna, era bw'olowooza nti Susanna Wesley yali muto emyaka egiwerako ku bba gwe yali agenda okufumbirwa, tosobola kwewala kulowooza nti Cupid (akabonero k'omukwano mu ngero ez'edda) yalina ky'akola ku nkyukakyuka y'endowooza gye yalangirira ng'akyali mu myaka gye egy'obuvubuka egisooka ddala, era nti kitaawe ow'ekisa era ow'omutima omugabi yalina ky'ateebereza ku mazima ago, era nga takiwakanya.

Samuel Wesley teyayagala kusisinkana kuwakanyizibwa okuva eka; n'olwekyo, yazuukuka obudde nga tebunnakya ku makya agamu mu Agusito 1683, n'atambula n'ebigere okutuuka e Oxford ng'alina siringi amakumi ana mu ttaano mu nsawo ye, eyo gye yeewandiisa ng'omuyizi omuweereza (servitor) mu Exeter College. Eyo yeebeezaawo ng'asomesa, ng'awandiikira abayizi abagagga emirimu gy'essomero n'ebirala abaali abagayaavu okugikola bokka (empisa gye yali tasaanidde kuwagira), ng'akola buli mulimu gw'okuwandiika Dunton gwe yasobola okumukwasa, era ng'akuŋŋaanya n'okukuba mu kyapa ebitontome bye n'ennyimba ze ebyali byasaasaana, mu kitabo kimu, ekirabika nga kyaleeta ensimbi ezisinga katono ezaakisaasaanyizibwako. Yayita bulungi ebigezo bye eby'enjawulo, era mu Juuni 1688 n'afuna diguli ye eya B.A. Okuba nti ye yekka mu bayizi ba Exeter eyafuna ekitiibwa ekyo ekitali kinene nnyo mu mwaka ogwo, tekyoleka nnyo busobozi wadde bunyiikivu bwa banne bonna awamu.

Samuel Wesley yava e Oxford mu kiseera kyennyini Kabaka James II. bwe yali afulumizza Ekirangiriro kye ekipya eky'Okugumiikiriza (Declaration of Indulgence), abasumba abasinga obungi kye baagaana okusoma mu makanisa gaabwe, ate Ssaabalabirizi Sancroft n'abalabirizi be omukaaga ne bawakanya, era olw'ekyo ne basibibwa mu Tower. Bwe kityo bwe kyajja okubaawo nti, Omulabirizi wa London bwe yali tali mu kifo kye olw'okuwalirizibwa, Samuel Wesley n'atikkirwa obwadiyakoni okuva mu mikono gya Dr. Sprat, Omulabirizi wa Rochester. Ekifo ky'omuyambi w'omusumba ekyamuweesa obuyinza obwo kyali kya pawundi abiri mu munaana zokka buli mwaka; naye teyakimalamu kusukka myezi kkumi n'ebiri, n'oluvannyuma n'atikkirwa obwakabona (priest) Dr. Compton, Omulabirizi wa London, mu St. Andrew's, Holborn, nga 24 Febwali 1689, nga wayise ennaku kkumi n'ebbiri zennyini bukya William ne Mary balangirirwa okuba abafuzi ba Great Britain. Kigambibwa nti ye yawandiika era n'akuba mu kyapa akatabo akasooka akaafuluma okuwagira gavumenti empya. Kiyinzika okuba nti kino kye kyamufunira okulondebwa okuba omusumba (chaplain) ku lyato ly'olutalo, gye yali omugagga ku kigero ng'afuna pawundi nsanvu buli mwaka, era ng'alina ebiseera bingi eby'okuwandiika, ebisinga obungi bye yakozesa okuyiiya ekitontome eky'ekyewuunyo ku Bulamu bwa Kristo.

Kirabika yali ayagala nnyo okubeera e London, kubanga mangu yalekulira obusumba obwo ku lyato, n'addamu okuba omuyambi w'omusumba mu kibuga ekikulu, ng'afuna pawundi asatu, ze yakubisaamu emirundi ebiri olw'ekkalaamu ye. Mu biseera ebyo ensimbi zaali za muwendo munene okusinga leero, naye era kyali tekiri kya magezi kuwasa ku nsimbi ntono bwe zityo; kyokka abaagalana beesigagana nnyo, ne kiba nti ye ne Susanna Annesley kirabika tebaalina kubuusabuusa kwonna, naye ne beeyama okufumbiriganwa mu biseera eby'omusana ebisooka mu mwaka (spring) mu 1689. Tekimanyiddwa mu kkanisa ki mwe baagattirwa, wadde ani eyabagatta, naye kiteeberezebwa nti amaka amapya ag'omugole gaali mu bisenge ebipangisibwa okumpi ne Holborn.

fields.title: Ennaku Ezaasooka mu Bufumbo
fields.body_html:
SUSANNA WESLEY ateekwa okuba nga yali mukazi mwegendereza mu kukozesa ensimbi era ng'amanyi bulungi okulabirira amaka, kubanga ye ne bba baamala emyaka ebiri nga basula mu bisenge bye baapangisa mu London — mu kiseera ekyo mutabani waabwe omubereberye Samuel mwe yazaalibwa — era ne basobola okwetuusaako ebyetaago byabwe n'okwewala ddala ebbanja, wadde ng'ensimbi ze baafunanga zaali ntono. Kaakano omwami oyo omuvubuka n'atandika omulimu gw'okuwandiika, gwe yali asuubira nti gujja kwongera nnyo ku by'afuna. Yeegatta ku Omwami Dunton n'abalala batono mu kutandikawo Athenian Gazette, olupapula olwafulumanga buli wiiki, olwamala emyaka egiwerako. Abo abaakolera awamu baasisinkananga mu biseera ebyategekebwa ku Smith's Coffee-house mu George Yard, kaakano ekiyitibwa George Street, okumpi ne Mansion House. Kibalibwa nti mu bbanga olupapula olwo lwe lwamala nga lufuluma, Omwami Wesley yaluwandiikira ebiwandiiko nga ebikumi bibiri, era mu kalamu k'omu ku bannaabwe be yakola nabo, Charles Gildon — eyawandiika oluvannyuma ebyafaayo by'" Athenian Society " — mwe tufunira ekifaananyi ekisinga obulungi eky'omuntu bba wa Susanna gwe yali mu buvubuka bwe obw'amaanyi.

" Yali muntu eyalina okumanya okw'amaanyi, si mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu mwokka, ne mu Nkiiko z'Ekkanisa, ne mu Bakulembeze b'Ekkanisa ab'edda, naye ne mu buli ssomo eddala eriri mu ago agayitibwa amagezi ag'obuntu. Obunyiikivu bwe n'obusobozi bwe mu kuluŋŋamya abantu mu by'omwoyo byali bingi nnyo. Yanywezanga abaali batentebuka n'amaanyi agatawangulika, era n'awangula abakyamu mu njigiriza. Wansi w'ebbugumu ery'essanyu ery'amagezi ge, n'omulamwa ogusinga okuba omukalu gwafuukanga ogw'ebibala era ogusanyusa. Engeri ye ey'okuwandiika yali nnungi era ey'obusajja, mpombefu naye nga tekooya, ey'amagezi naye nga teyeraga. Embeera ye n'emboozi ye byali by'ekisa era ebisemberekeka. Okusaasira kwe eri okubonaabona kw'abantu banne kwali kunene nga okuyiga kwe n'ebitone bye. Singa kyali kisoboka omuntu yenna okukola omulimu gw'omusumba w'ensi yonna, mazima yanditwaddeko ng'obuvunaanyizibwa bwe okulabirira obulungi bw'omwoyo obw'abantu bonna. Mu buli kye yawandiika ne mu buli kye yakola yalaganga okufaayo okw'amaanyi eri bonna abalina ekifaananyi eky'ekitiibwa eky'Omutonzi waabwe, era yalina omwoyo ogw'abatume ennyo, nti obulumi, emirimu, okutunula ekiro n'okusaba byamusanyusanga nnyo okusinga ekitiibwa bwe kisanyusa ab'omululu gw'obukulu, obugagga bwe busanyusa omukodo, oba amasanyu bwe gasanyusa abagoberera okwegomba kw'omubiri."

Bwe tutunuulira, nga wayise ebbanga eddene bwe lityo, emirimu gya Samuel Wesley egy'okuwandiika, kyeyoleka nti yali munnaddiini omuyivu, era ng'alina ekirabo eky'okuyiiya ebitontome awatali kufuba. Ebirowoozo bye n'engeri ye ey'okuwandiika byafunda kubanga buli kiseera yabyolekezanga ku nkaayana z'eby'enzikiriza, era yawandiika nnyo era mu bwangu mu kkubo limu lyokka, asobole okufuna eby'okulabirira amaka ge amanene, n'atatuuka ku ddaala erya waggulu obuvubuka bwe lwe bwali bulaga nti alituukako. Naye yali muntu mulungi, era omusumba omwesigwa ow'emyoyo mu kasonda akatamanyiddwa ak'e Lincolnshire omukisa gwe mwe gwamutuusa oluvannyuma; wadde nga, singa yasigala mu London, kisoboka nti yandyeyongedde okumanyibwa, era n'afuuka omu ku bitangaala by'amagezi ebyayakaayakana mu biseera bye.

Marquis w'e Normanby yali awulidde mu ngeri emu ku musumba ono omuvubuka n'obwavu bwe, era mu 1690, ekigo ekitono eky'e South Ormsby bwe kyasigala nga tekirina musumba olw'okufa kw'omusumba waakyo, n'ayogera ku Omwami Wesley eri aba Massingberd, abaali — nga bwe bali ne kaakano — bannannyini ttaka ly'eyo era abaalina obuyinza okulonda omusumba w'ekigo ekyo. Amangu ago ne bamuwa ekifo ekyo, n'akikkiriza n'essanyu, era ne kitwalibwa ng'okweyongerayo mu maaso. Omusaala gwali pawundi amakumi ataano buli mwaka; waaliwo ennyumba ey'okubeeramu, wadde nga yali mbi nnyo, era olw'okuba nti omulimu gw'obusumba tegwali muzito n'akatono, waaliwo essuubi ly'ebiseera bingi eby'okuwandiika. Omusumba omuggya yali yaakaweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu munaana, mukyala we yali mu mwaka gwe ogw'amakumi abiri mu ebiri, ate omwana waabwe yali wa myezi ena gyokka, bwe baava mu London ne bagenda mu kitundu eky'omu kyalo ekyali kigenda okubeera amaka gaabwe, era ebijjukizo byabwe mwe bisibiddwa emirembe gyonna. Obulamu obw'omu kyalo obutakyukakyuka, n'obutabaawo ddala bwa bikolwa ebisisimula Omwami Wesley bye yali amanyidde, buteekwa okuba nga mangu ddala byamunyiiza omwoyo, wadde nga yagezaako okwebaza, nga bwe kirabika mu bigambo bye ye kennyini: — " Mu kayumba akanaku, akazimbiddwa n'emmuli n'ebbumba, Nga mmalira mu kusinda olunaku olutaliimu ssanyu: Okumpi awo omugga Humber ogutalina kisa we guwuluguma, Nga gulya mpolampola ensalosalo z'ensi eziriraanyeewo. Ensi k'egende gy'eyagala, sijja kwemulugunya, So siyinza kunakuwala, nga Eggulu lyange." Mu kigo mwalimu ennyumba amakumi asatu mu mukaaga zokka n'abantu nga ebikumi bibiri mu nkaaga, era omwo mwe mwali ekkanisa ey'edda eya St. Leonard, eyali ku kasozi waggulu w'ennyumba y'omusumba. Abafumbo abo abavubuka baatuuka mu Juuni, ne bateekateeka ebyabwe obutiti nga tebunnatuuka. Emyezi bwe gyagenda giyitawo, era Samuel omuto bwe yatandika okutambula, nnyina n'anakuwala nnyo okulaba nti, wadde yali mulamu bulungi era mugezi nnyo, teyalaga kabonero konna ka kwogera. Kino kyamweraliikiriza nnyo, era okulabirira omwana gwe yali atya nti kasiru, awamu n'okwagala okw'obuzaale eri omwana omulenzi omubereberye, kyaleetera " Sammy," nga bwe baamuyitanga, okuba omwana gwe yali asinga okwagala, era kino ye ne abalala bakimanya bulungi. Mu 1691 omwana omuwala n'azaalibwa, n'atuumibwa erinnya lya nnyina, era mu Janwali ow'omwaka ogwaddako Emilia n'ajja. Mu Apuli 1693 omwana Susanna n'afa, era kino kye kyali ekituli ekisooka mu maka. Mu 1694 abalongo ab'obulenzi, Annesley ne Jedediah, ne bazaalibwa, naye ne bafa nga bakyali bawere, era emyezi mitono oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwabwe ne wajja omuwala omulala, naye eyatuumibwa Susanna, eyawangaala okutuusa mu bukadde. Mary, eyasembayo okuzaalibwa e South Ormsby, olw'okugwa yalemala era n'abeera mulwadde; bwe kityo kyeyoleka nti emikono gya Mukyala Wesley gyabanga gijjudde emirimu bulijjo, era amaanyi ge ne gagezesebwa nnyo.

Omuntu yandirowoozezza nti mu kyalo kino ekyesudde tewandibaddewo buzibu bwonna mu nkolagana y'abantu; naye si bwe kyali. Marquis w'e Normanby, nga bangi ab'omu biseera bye, yali muntu ow'empisa embi ennyo, era yali akuuma " omukyala " mu nnyumba e South Ormsby. Omukyala oyo n'ayagala nnyo mukyala w'Omusumba eyali omulungi, era yandyagadde nnyo okuba mukwano gwe ow'oku lusegere. Mukyala Wesley, nga mumativu mu kifo kye ng'omukyala omusanyufu era nnyina w'abaana, tekirabika nti yagoba na bukambwe muganda we oyo eyali agudde; naye bba, eyali omukambwe era eyeekolera by'ayagala, teyali wa kukigumiikiriza, era kigambibwa nti lumu bwe yayingira ng'omukazi oyo omwonoonyi atudde ne mukyala we, n'amufulumya mu nnyumba mu ngeri ey'amaanyi ennyo. John Wesley agamba nti enneeyisa eno yanyiiza nnyo Marquis n'ekiwaliriza kitaawe okuleka ekifo ky'obusumba bw'ekigo ekyo; naye ebigambo bino tebiwagirwa bituufu ebyaliwo. Singa olugero luno lwali lwa mazima ddala, Marquis ateekwa okuba nga yategeera obusungu obw'obutonde obw'omwami ow'ekitiibwa, n'amussaamu ekitiibwa olw'ekyo, kubanga Omwami Wesley teyalekera awo kuba musumba we ow'awaka, wadde okumuwonga ebitabo awamu ne Marchioness, era omukungu oyo teyeerabira kwogera ku Musumba w'e South Ormsby mu lubiri lwa Kabaka. Okusisinkana okwo kuyinza okuba nga ddala kwali ne mukazi omulala eyali akwatagana ne Lord Castleton, eyapangisa Hall (ennyumba ennene ey'ettaka eryo) era eyabeeranga mu bulamu obw'obwenzi ennyo omwo. Ebyo byonna byaliwo nga wakyabulayo ebbanga ddene John Wesley azaalibwe, kale kyangu nnyo nti yandiba nga yasobya ku ebyo ebyaliwo ddala.

Samuel bwe yali wakati w'emyaka ena n'etaano, bazadde be ne bawona okweraliikirira kwonna ku kwogera kwe. Yali ayagala nnyo kkapa, era yagisitulanga n'agitambuza, era emirundi mingi n'agiddukira nayo mu nsonda ezisirifu, gye tuyinza okulowooza nti abaana abalala abato tebaagendangayo kutawaanya kkapa newakubadde nnannyini yo omuto. Lumu yamala ebbanga ddene nga talabika, nnyina n'atandika okweraliikirira. N'amunoonya mu nnyumba yonna ne mu lusuku, era ku nkomerero, bwe yali ng'akoowoola erinnya lye, n'awulira eddoboozi nga ligamba nti, " Nze nzuuno, maama! " Lyava wansi w'emmeeza, era bwe yakutama, n'alaba Sammy ne kkapa we. Okuva olwo n'ayogera bulungi ng'abaana abalala: okwebaza kwa Mukyala Wesley kuyinza okulowoozebwa.

Mu 1693 Omwami Wesley mwe yafulumiza ekitontome kye ekinene eky'ebitabo kkumi, ekiyitibwa The Life of Our Blessed Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ (Obulamu bwa Mukama waffe Atenderezebwe era Omulokozi Yesu Kristo), n'akiwonga eri Kwiini Mary. Tekyafulumizibwa muko we ow'omukwano, Dunton, wabula " kyakubibwa ku lwa Charles Harper, ku Flower-de-Luce, okwolekera Ekkanisa ya St. Dunstan, mu Fleet Street; ne Benjamin Motte, Aldersgate Street." Mazima ddala, Dunton teyalowooza nti kyandyongedde ku linnya ly'omuwandiisi waakyo, era yakivumirira nti " kikooya nnyo okusukkiridde," endowooza Pope gye yalina naye. Omulembe guno mazima gwandikkirizza endowooza yaabwe; naye kyafulumizibwa omulundi ogwokubiri mu 1697, era ne kiddamu okukubibwa nga kirongooseddwa era nga kikendeezeddwa oluvannyuma lw'emyaka kikumi. Ekitundu ekisinga okusikiriza, era ekyo kyokka kye kirungi okujuliza wano, kye kifaananyi ekiwoomu era eky'okusiima Omwami Wesley kye yakuba mukyala we gwe yali amaze naye mu bufumbo emyaka nga ena mu kiseera ekyo: — " Yayooyoota ennyumba yange ennyangu n'awa obulamu bwange omukisa, N'ampa omukisa okusinga erinnya ly'omukyala lye lyokka; Naye nze nnasigala nga nfuga awatali kuwakanyizibwa, So kwali si mulimu gwe, wabula ssanyu lye okuwulira: Teyalowoozanga n'akamu, n'okukikola nga takikola, kye nnagaananga. Mu nnyumba yaffe entono temwali kifo kya malala; So saabanga na nsonga kumulagira ekyabanga kituufu bulijjo, Yeetegerezanga ekinyanguyiza era ekinsanyusa. So nange saalaga butasiima olw'okufaayo kwe, Wabula nnakozesanga obuyinza bwange okulaga okwagala kwange: Kyonna kye yasabanga nnakimuwanga awatali kunenya wadde okwemulugunya. Kubanga bulijjo yasabanga eby'amagezi, era nze nnali omulamuzi. Byonna bye nnalagiranga byafuukanga okusaba mu mikono gye emirungi, N'okusaba kwe gye ndi kwali kiragiro. Emiryango gy'abalala gye yagendangako emirundi mitono nnyo: Amaka ge ge gaali essanyu lye, era ye yali wange; Ebweru yagendangayo lwa nsonga ntono, oba nga tagenda wabula nange, Oba nga kisa kimuyise, oba okugaba." Mu 1694 Marquis w'e Normanby yakola kyonna ky'asobola eri Kwiini ne Ssaabalabirizi Tillotson okuwagira Omwami Wesley afuuke Omulabirizi w'essaza ly'Ekkanisa mu Ireland, nga mu kiseera ekyo amasaza abiri gaali tegalina balabirizi. Bwe tulowooza ku musaayi gw'Abairisi omungi ogwali mu misuwa gy'aba Wesley, era nga n'ab'eŋŋanda zaabwe baali bantu ba kitiibwa mu Ireland (Emerald Isle), kirabika yandibadde mu kifo ekimusaanira mu ssaza ng'eryo, era enjawulo gye kyandireetedde amaka ge teyandipimiddwa. Oboolyawo Kwiini Mary newakubadde Ssaabalabirizi tebaamanya nsonga zino, wabula baalowooza bulowooza nti omusumba ow'emyaka amakumi asatu mu ebiri yali muto nnyo, era omusumba w'abantu ab'omu kyalo ebikumi bibiri mu ataano yali tannafuna bumanyirivu bumala, olw'ekifo ng'ekyo. Kyokka Kwiini teyamwerabira, era kigambibwa nti olw'ekyo kye yayagala ekyayogerwa nga obulwadde bwe obwasembayo tebunnatandika, ekigo ky'e Epworth kye kyava kimuweebwa.

Nga banaatera okuva e South Ormsby, Mukyala Wesley n'afuna ennaku ey'okufiirwa kitaawe, Dr. Annesley, eyafa, oluvannyuma lw'okulwala emyezi etaano, ku lunaku olusembayo olwa 1696. Amawulire, kya lwatu, tegaatambula mangu nnyo, era tegaali ga kwewuunyisa; naye ekyo tekyakendeeza ku nnaku gye yawulira. Mu kiseera ekyo yali wa myaka amakumi abiri mu musanvu, era ng'ali lubuto lw'omwana we ow'omunaana, nga mu baana be omu yekka ye jjajjaawe gwe yali alabyeko. Yali akkiriza nnyo nti waliwo okukwatagana wakati w'emyoyo gy'abo abaafa n'abo be baagala abakyali mu mubiri, era mu bulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo yayagalanga okulowooza nti kitaawe yali amuli kumpi nnyo okusinga bwe yali ng'ali mu Lincolnshire, ye kitaawe ng'akyali mu mubiri mu Spital Yard.

fields.title: Obulamu bw'Obufumbo mu Myaka egyaddirira
fields.body_html:
Ku ntandikwa y'omwaka 1697 ab'omu maka ga Wesley ne basenguka ne bagenda e Epworth, ku ludda olulala olw'essaza ly'e Lincoln. Wadde nga Epworth kaali kabuga katono akaalimu akatale n'abantu nga 2,000 bokka, ke kaali ekifo ekikulu mu kitundu ekiyitibwa Isle of Axholme, ekitundu ekiweza mayiro kkumi obuwanvu n'ana obugazi, ekyetooloddwa emigga Trent, Don ne Idle. Ekkanisa yaayo kizimbe kya dda nnyo, ekyatongozebwa mu linnya lya St. Andrew, era ennyumba y'omusumba mu biseera ebyo yali ng'olubiri bw'ogigeraageranya n'"akayumba k'ebitosi" ak'e South Ormsby. Teyali nnyumba ya matoffaali oba ya mayinja, wabula yali ya mbaawo n'ettaka erisiigiddwa, ey'emyaliiro esatu n'emitwe gy'akasolya etaano, ng'esereddwa n'essubi, era nga mulimu " effumbiro, ekisenge ekinene, eddiiro, etterekero ly'ebyokunywa n'emmere, n'ebisenge bisatu ebinene waggulu n'ebirala ebikozesebwa bulijjo; era n'akalimiro akatono; " wamu n'etterekero ly'emmere ekinene, ekiyumba ky'enjiibwa, n'ekyokero omwanikirwa ebimera bya hemp. Abaana kati baalina ekifo ekimala okutaayaaya ebweru, n'okuwummula n'okweyagala munda mu nnyumba; naye waaliwo ensimbi ez'okusasula nga bayingira mu kifo ekyo eky'obusumba, ebintu by'omu nnyumba eby'okugula olw'ennyumba eyo ennene, era — olw'okuba omusumba omuggya yali amaliridde okulima ye kennyini ettaka ly'ekkanisa eryamuweebwa — ebikozesebwa n'ente olw'obulimi obwo obwali obubi n'okusinga obw'omuntu atannaba kubumanya, obulimi omusajja ow'ebitabo eyakulira mu kibuga bwe yali tasaanira n'akatono. Omwami Wesley, eyali amaze okubeera mu bbanja, yeewola pawundi kikumi okuva eri Omulabirizi w'e Salisbury; ezo bwe zitaamala, yali tannaba na kutebenkera bulungi mu kifo kye n'aba nga yeewola pawundi endala ataano. Amagoba n'okusasula ensimbi ezo byamubeera ng'olubengo olusibiddwa mu bulago bwe obulamu bwe bwonna obwasigalawo.

Ab'omu maka ago baali baakatuuka e Epworth Mehetabel, omuwala waabwe ow'okutaano, n'azaalibwa; era mu kiseera kye kimu Mukyala Wesley n'awulira nti mwannyina omukulu omulungi Elizabeth, mukyala wa John Dunton, afudde. Dunton ne mukyala we baasigala nga baagalana nnyo okutuusa ku lunaku omukyala lwe yafa, era bba eyali afiiriddwa yalangirira nti mu myaka ekkumi n'etaano gye baamala mu bufumbo, tewali ndabika ya busungu yali eyise wakati waabwe. Ye yamukwatiranga ebitabo n'ensimbi, era bulijjo yeetabanga nnyo mu bizinensi ye; era wadde nga waaliwo okweraliikirira n'emitawaana, Dunton teyaddangako ewaka n'amusanga ng'anyiize. Yamujjanjabanga n'omutima gwe gwonna bwe yalwalanga, era bwe kyalabika nga bayinza okusenguka ne bagenda e America okutandikayo bizinensi, yakkiriza olugendo olwo ku nnyanja, ng'akakasa n'essanyu " omutima gwe omwagalwa ennyo " nti yandigenze gy'ali n'essanyu, n'ayongerako nti, " Nkukakasa, omwagalwa wange, nti ggwe wekka bwe bugagga bwonna bwe njagala; era bwe ndiba n'omukisa okuddamu okubeera naawe, nditambula okutuuka ku nkomerero y'ensi okusinga okwawukana naawe nate. . . . Nandisinze okwagala okubeera naawe nga tulya mugaati na mazzi okusinga okweyagalira mu bugagga bwa Indies ez'Ebuvanjuba n'ez'Ebugwanjuba nga toliiwo." Mu bbaluwa endala agamba nti, " Nkwegayiridde, omwagalwa wange, laga okwagala kwo gye ndi ng'ofaayo ku bulamu bwo. Weefunire engoye ezibuguma, ebizibawo eby'ebyoya by'endiga, era ogule ekkooti ewanvu. Beera n'essanyu; tobulwa kintu; tobuusabuusa nti Katonda alitufaako." Kirabika yali amanyiddwa nnyo mu mulembe gwe olw'obulungi n'obukkakkamu bwe obw'obuzaaliranwa — ebintu, eky'ennaku, ebitatera bulijjo kugendera wamu n'okutya Katonda okusinga obwesimbu.

Mukyala Wesley yali asanyuka nnyo olw'omukwano ogw'obooluganda ogwaliwo wakati wa bba ne mwannyina n'Omwami Dunton, era okufiirwa kuno kwamuluma nnyo. Omwami Wesley ye yawandiika ebigambo ebyayolebwa ku ntaana ya Mukyala Dunton mu Bunhill Fields; era wadde nga mu mulembe ogwo kyali kya mpisa okuwa abo abaawandiikirwanga ebigambo ku ntaana buli mpisa ennungi eri wansi w'enjuba, abantu bonna bakkiriza nti buli kigambo mu byo kyali kya mazima : — " Ggwe ensuwa entukuvu! gye tukwasizza Okukuuma omugatte guno omwagalwa ogw'enfuufu eziikiddwa, Manya obuvunaanyizibwa bwo, era gukuume bulungi, Okutuusa omulyango gw'okufa ogw'ekikomo lwe gulisumululwa ;

Okutuusa malayika lw'aligulagira okuzuukira, N'agutwala mu Lusuku lwa Katonda — Omukyala ow'ekisa, omwagazi, ow'amagezi ;

Mukwano eyabudaabudanga era n'abuulirira;

Obulungi obukkakkamu ng'omukka gwa Zephyr, empewo ennyogovu ;

Okutya Katonda okwamwenya ne mu kufa ;

Omukyala bw'atyo era mukwano bw'atyo Bonna bamukaabira era bonna bamutendereza.

Okusinga bonna, oyo anyigirizibwa okweraliikirira okulya omutima, Oyo eyamumanya, era eyamwagala okusinga ;

Oyo eyagabana ku mutima gwe omwesigwa, Oyo eyafugamu nga talina amuvuganya, Era taliwummuza kusinda Okutuusa lw'alifa, abeere naye.

Oba, bw'aba ayagala okubifunza byonna mu bimpi, Wano we waziikibwa Eliza."

Bannyina bano ababiri baali bafaanagana nnyo mu ndabika ne mu mpisa, n'olwekyo buli kintu ekyawandiikibwa ku Mukyala Dunton kituyamba okutegeera obulungi Mukyala Wesley yennyini bwe yali.

Omwami Wesley yali ku mbaga ya Dunton n'omugole we, era n'abawa " Oluyimba lw'Embaga " olwali lujjudde enjiibwa n'okwagala, ne ba Cupid ne ba Hymen. Kirabika yalina okuteebereza okw'amagezi nti omusuubuzi w'ebitabo ono eyali afiiriddwa mukyala we teyatondebwa kubeera yekka, kubanga mu bbaluwa gye yaweerezaamu ebigambo by'oku ntaana, ayogera mu ngeri ey'akakodyo nti asuubira nti bijja kutuuka ng'Oluyimba lw'Embaga olulala terunnaba kwetaagibwa. Omwami Dunton ddala yawasa omukyala omulala, mu myezi mukaaga gyokka, era Omwami Wesley n'amulekayo omukwano mangu ddala nga Dr. Primrose bwe yandikoze mu mbeera y'emu. Ye kennyini teyagezesebwa mu ngeri eyo, kubanga Mukyala Wesley ye yamusigalako; naye okusinziira ku bye tumanyi ku mpisa ze, kirabika nnyo nti teyandimaze bbanga ddene nga talina mukyala singa yafuna ennaku ey'okufiirwa munne omwesigwa.

Kirabika kyali mu kiseera Mukyala Wesley we yaakatuukira e Epworth lwe yatunuulira ensonga y'okusomesa abaana be. Singa teyakikola, abaana be abawala bandikuze nga tebamanyi kintu, kubanga ensimbi ez'okubaweereza mu masomero tezandifunise n'akatono. Abalenzi bo, kya bulijjo, bandifubiddwako nnyo; kubanga okusoma — era mu ssomero eddene ery'olukale — kitaabwe yakutwalanga ng'ekintu ekitayinza kubulawo (sine qua non), era yandikoze buli kisoboka, n'akyusa eggulu n'ensi, okukibafunira. Mukyala Wesley yali mukyala mukkakkamu ow'ebikolwa, eyali n'emirimu mingi naye n'afuna obudde okukola buli kimu, olw'amaanyi n'obunyiikivu obutaggwaawo, n'endowooza etegeka buli kintu mu nteeko. Kya lwatu, tekyasoboka kusomesa mutabani we omukulu nga tannaba kumanya kwogera; naye amangu ddala nga yaakatandika okwogera, naye n'atandika okumusomesa.

Okusomesa okwo kwagenda mangu era nga kwa ssanyu, kubanga yawandiika nti " yalina okujjukira okw'ekitalo ennyo ne kiba nti sijjukira nga mmugambye ekigambo kye kimu emirundi ebiri. Ekyali eky'ewuunyisa okusingawo, buli kigambo kye yabanga ayize mu ssomo lye yakimanyanga buli we yakirabanga, ka kibe mu Bayibuli ye oba mu kitabo ekirala kyonna; era mu ngeri eyo yamanya mangu nnyo okusoma obulungi ebitabo by'abawandiisi Abangereza." Okumala emyaka ng'ebiri, Samuel ye yali omuyizi we yekka, era olw'ebyo bye yayigira ku ye, teyagezangako kusomesa mwana we yenna nnukuta za alufaabeti okutuusa nga baweza emyaka etaano, wadde nga omuto ku bonna, Kezia, yamanya ennukuta ze nga tannaweza myaka egyo. Nnyina yanakuwala olw'ekyo, n'agamba nti si ye yakikola, naye kirabika okusoma kwali mu mpewo y'awaka. Omwana wa Mukyala Wesley ow'omwenda yazaalibwa e Epworth mu 1698; naye olw'ebiwandiiko by'ekigo okwokebwa omuliro, tekimanyiddwa oba yali mulenzi oba muwala. Omwana oyo yafa mangu, era omwana eyaddako mu maka yali John, eyaddirirwa omwaka ogwaddako Benjamin; bombi baafa nga bakyali bawere.

Kirabika mu kiseera ekisooka eky'okubeera e Epworth, nnyina w'Omwami Wesley eyali akaddiye yabeeranga naye, era oboolyawo yali muyambi wa muwendo eri omukyala omuto, eyabanga bulijjo n'olubuto, era emirundi mingi n'asigala mu kisenge kye ne ku kitanda okumala emyezi mukaaga omulundi gumu; wadde nga bwe kityo, olw'okuba nga emirundi mingi yabanga n'omukozi omukazi omu yekka ow'emirimu gyonna, ateekwa okuba nga yalabiriranga abaana ne mu biseera bye eby'obunafu obusingayo; era okunyigirizibwa kuno okw'omutima n'omubiri okutakoma kwe kwayongera nnyo ku bunafu bwe.

Nga 16 Maayi 1701, omwami n'omukyala ne bateesa wamu. Ensimbi zaali ntono nnyo, era amanda gaali geetaagibwa; kubanga wadde nga obudde obw'ebbugumu bwali bunaatera okutuuka, tekyandibadde kirungi okubeera awatali muliro ng'omwana omulala asuubirwa buli kaseera. Buli kapeesa ne kakuŋŋaanyizibwa, naye bombi baasobola okukuŋŋaanya siringi mukaaga zokka. Amanda ne gatumibwa, naye ensawo ne zisigala nga njereere. Ku Lwakuna ku makya ne wabaawo ekyewuunyo eky'essanyu. Ssaabalabirizi Sharpe ow'ekisa, eyali amanyi obwavu bwe bwanyigiriza ab'omu maka g'e Epworth, n'ebikwata ku mabanja byonna, n'engeri omusumba gye yakolanga ennyo nga yeefuba okuggya mu bwongo bwe ennyiriri z'ebitontome n'ebiwandiiko ebya bulijjo olw'abafulumya ebitabo ab'e London, yayogera ku ye eri abakungu abawerako, era n'atuuka n'okusaba Olukiiko lwa House of Lords ku lulwe. Countess wa Northampton, bwe yakwatibwako olw'ebyo bye yawulira ku bwetaavu bwabwe, n'awaayo pawundi amakumi abiri eri abo Ssaabalabirizi be yali ayambako; kkumi ku zo, nga Omwami Wesley bwe yayagala, zaalekebwa mu mikono gya Ssaabalabirizi olwa Mukyala Wesley omukadde, ate kkumi endala ne ziweerezebwa n'omubaka eri omusumba, ne zituuka ku makya ago ge yali talina na kapeesa. Ensimbi ezo tezaalwa wadde essaawa emu, kubanga akawungeezi ako kennyini ne bazaalibwa abalongo, omulenzi n'omuwala. Bwe yali ategeeza Ssaabalabirizi ebyo, Omwami Wesley yawandiika : — " Ekiro ekyayise mukyala wange anzaalidde abaana abatonotono. Kati bali babiri bokka, omulenzi n'omuwala, era ndowooza bwe bali bonna kati ; tufunye bana mu myaka ebiri n'olunaku lumu, ku bo basatu be balamu."

Abalongo abo wadde omulenzi eyabasookawo tewali n'omu eyawangaala emyezi mingi; era mu 1702 Anne n'azaalibwa. Nnyina olw'okuba kati, eky'ewuunyisa, yalina omwana omuwere omu yekka mu mikono, ate nga Mehetabel omuto, oba Hetty nga bwe baamuyitanga, yali atuuse ku myaka egy'ekitiibwa egy'etaano, Mukyala Wesley n'atandika okukuba essomero erya bulijjo n'abaana be okumala essaawa mukaaga buli lunaku, era n'agenda mu maaso nalyo okumala emyaka amakumi abiri, nga liyimirira ebiseera bitono byokka ebitaali bya kwewalika, olw'okuzaala okwaddiriŋŋananga n'omuliro ogwakwata ennyumba y'omusumba.

Obugumiikiriza bwe yasomesangamu bweyolekera ku lunaku lumu bba bwe yayagala okumanya n'atuula awo n'abala ng'addiŋŋana ekintu kye kimu eri omwana omu emirundi egisukka mu amakumi abiri. " Nneewuunya obugumiikiriza bwo," bwe yagamba; " omwana oyo omubuulidde ekintu ekyo kye kimu emirundi amakumi abiri." " Singa nneematira nga nkyogedde emirundi kkumi n'omwenda gyokka," bwe yamuddamu, " nandibadde nfiiriddwa okufuba kwange kwonna. Omulundi ogw'amakumi abiri gwe gwakituukiriza."

Mukyala Wesley tekirabika nti yatwala nkola ye ey'okusomesa nga ya kitalo, naye teyasobola kuleka baana be kutaayaaya nga tebalina abalabirira, era teyalina nsimbi za kusasula basomesa ba waka, abayigiriza ab'enjawulo, wadde amasomero. Engeri yokka ey'okubasomesa yali ya kukikola yekka; era nga bakuŋŋaanye mpola okumwetooloola nga bakola emirimu gyabwe, ye yatunganga n'empiso ye, n'akwata ebitabo by'ensimbi z'ettaka ly'ekkanisa, n'awandiika ebbaluwa ze, n'alabirira omwana we omuwere, mu mirembe n'obweyagaze bungi nnyo okusinga bwe yandibadde ng'ekibinja ekyo ekitono kiddukadduka buli wamu nga kikola effujjo ery'oluyoogaano. Yali mutabani we John, bwe yali ng'aweza emyaka amakumi asatu, era oboolyawo ng'alowooza ku bulamu bw'amaka ge ye kennyini bwe yandibadde nabwo, eyamusaba okuwandiika mu bujjuvu engeri gye yakuzaamu n'okusomesa abaana be; era ebyo bye yawandiika bisinga kuweebwa mu bigambo bye ye kennyini.

fields.title: Okusomesa n'Okukuza Abaana
fields.body_html:
JOHN WESLEY mazima teyasobola kujjukira ntandikwa ya mulimu gwa nnyina ogw'okusomesa, kubanga gwatandika nga tannaba na kuzaalibwa; naye ddala yafuna emiganyulo gyagwo, kubanga nnyina, ng'ayambibwako katono bba mu bikulu by'ennimi enkadde n'okubala, ye yamuteekateeka okuyingira essomero lya Charterhouse ng'alina emyaka kkumi n'emu, era n'ayingira n'ettendo eddene eri ye kennyini n'eri abaali bamusomesezza. Bwe yakula yamwegayirira emirundi mingi amuwandiikire mu bujjuvu engeri gye yabakuzaamu, naye kyeyoleka nti yali talina kwagala kunene kukikola, kubanga ku nkomerero y'ebbaluwa ey'ennaku z'omwezi nga 21 Febwali 1732 agamba nti: — " Okuwandiika ekintu kyonna ku ngeri gye nnasomesaamu abaana kye kintu kye ssaagala n'akamu. Ndowooza tekiyinza kugasa muntu yenna okumanya nze, eyamala emyaka emingi bwe gityo nga mbeera bwomu mu kasirise, engeri gye nnakozesangamu obudde bwange n'obwegendereza bwange mu kukuza abaana bange. Tewali muntu ayinza kugoberera nkola yange nga tavudde ku nsi, mu makulu gaayo ddala ag'ekigambo; era bantu batono nnyo, oba tewali n'omu, abayinza okwewaayo ddala emyaka egisukka amakumi abiri egy'obuvubuka bwabwe obusinga amaanyi, nga basuubira okulokola emyoyo gy'abaana baabwe, gye balowooza nti giyinza okulokolebwa awatali kutawaana kungi bwe kutyo; kubanga ekyo kye kyali ekigendererwa kyange ekikulu, newaakubadde nga nnakikola mu ngeri etaali ya magezi era nga sikitukirizza bulungi."

Eky'essanyu, ku nkomerero yakkiriza okusendebwasendebwa, n'awandiikira mutabani we John bw'ati: — " MWANA WANGE OMWAGALWA, " Epworth, nga 24 Julaayi 1732.

" Nga bw'oyagala, nkuŋŋaanyizza amateeka amakulu ge nnagobereranga mu kusomesa n'okukuza ab'omu maka gange.

" Abaana bulijjo baateekebwanga mu nkola ey'obulamu etegeke, mu bintu bye baali basobola, okuva lwe baazaalibwanga; ng'okwambala n'okweyambula, okukyusa engoye zaabwe ez'omunda, n'ebirala. Emyezi esatu egisooka batera kugimala nga beebase. Oluvannyuma lw'ekyo, bwe kyasobokanga, baateekebwanga mu kitanda kyabwe nga batunula, ne bawuubibwa okutuusa lwe beebaka, era ne bagenda nga bawuubibwa okutuusa ekiseera kyabwe eky'okuzuukuka. Kino kyakolebwanga okubayigiriza okwebaka mu nkola etegeke, eyali essaawa ssatu ku makya n'essaawa ssatu olweggulo; oluvannyuma essaawa bbiri, okutuusa lwe bataddamu kwetaaga kwebaka emisana n'akatono. Bwe baawezanga omwaka gumu (abamu nga tebannaguweza), baayigirizibwanga okutya omuggo n'okukaaba mpola, era mu ngeri eyo ne bawona ebibonerezo bingi bye bandifunye singa si bwe kityo, era eddoboozi eryo ery'okukaaba kw'abaana erisinga okutama lyali tiriwulirwa nnyo mu nnyumba, wabula ab'omu maka baabeeranga mu kasirise nga gy'obeera nti tewaali mwana n'omu mu bo.

" Amangu ddala nga bamaze okukula ne baba n'amaanyi, baakkirizibwanga okulya emirundi esatu gyokka olunaku. Ku ky'emisana, akameeza kaabwe akatono n'entebe zaabwe byateekebwanga kumpi n'ebyaffe, we twali tusobola okubalaba; era baalekebwanga okulya n'okunywa (bbiya omutono) nga bwe baagala, naye nga tebakkirizibwa kusaba kintu kyonna mu ddoboozi. Bwe baabanga beetaaga ekintu, baakiwuubaaliranga omuweereza omukazi eyabalabiriranga, n'ajja n'akimbuulira; era amangu ddala nga basobola okukwata akambe n'ewuuma, baateekebwanga ku mmeeza yaffe. Tebaakkirizibwanga kulonda mmere gye baagala, wabula bulijjo baalyanga ebyo ebyategekebwanga ab'omu maka bonna. Ku makya bulijjo baalyanga emmere ey'okulya n'ekijiiko; n'ekiro oluusi. Naye kyonna kye baabanga nakyo, ku mmere eyo tebakkirizibwanga kulya 'ku kintu ekisukka mu kimu, era n'ekyo nga balya kitono ddala. Okunywa oba okulya wakati w'emmere tekwakkirizibwanga n'akatono, okuggyako ng'omuntu alwadde, ekyabangawo gake nnyo. Era tebaakkirizibwanga kuyingira mu ffumbiro kusaba kintu ku baweereza nga balya: bwe kyategeerekekanga nti bakikoze, mazima baakubibwanga, n'abaweereza ne banenyezebwa nnyo. Ku ssaawa kkumi na bbiri ez'akawungeezi (6 o'clock), amangu ddala ng'okusaba kw'amaka kuwedde, baalyanga eky'ekiro; ku ssaawa emu ey'ekiro (7) omuweereza omukazi n'abanaaza, era ng'atandikira ku muto, n'abeeyambula n'abatuusa bonna mu buliri nga tezinnaba kuwera ssaawa bbiri ez'ekiro (8), era mu kiseera ekyo yabalekanga mu bisenge byabwe eby'enjawulo nga batunula, kubanga mu nnyumba yaffe tewaali kintu ng'ekyo ekikkirizibwa eky'okutuula awali omwana okutuusa lw'ebaka.

" Baali bamanyidde nnyo okulya n'okunywa ekyo kyonna kye baaweebwanga, nti omu ku bo bwe yalwalanga tewaali buzibu bwonna mu kumumiza eddagala erisinga okukaawa; kubanga tebaagezangako kulijeemera, newaakubadde ng'abamu ku bo baalisesemanga amangu ddala. Kino nkyogera okulaga nti omuntu ayinza okuyigirizibwa okumira ekintu kyonna, ne bwe kiba nga tekimusanyusa n'akamu.

" Okusobola okubumba ebirowoozo by'abaana, ekintu ekisooka okukolebwa kwe kuwangula okwagala kwabwe ne tubaleeta mu mpisa ey'obuwulize. Okuyigiriza okutegeera mulimu gwetaaga budde, era eri abaana gulina okugenda mpolampola, nga bwe basobola okugugumira; naye okufuga okwagala kwabwe kintu ekirina okukolebwa omulundi gumu, era amangu bwe kikolebwa, kye kisinga obulungi; kubanga bwe balagajjalirwa ne batabonerezebwa mu kiseera ekituufu, bajja kufuna obukakanyavu n'obujeemu obutatera kuwangulwa oluvannyuma, era obutayinza kuwangulwa awatali kukozesa bukambwe obwandindumye nze nga bwe bwandirumye omwana. Mu maaso g'ensi, abazadde be mpita ab'ettima balowoozebwa okuba ab'ekisa era abanyiikivu mu kwagala, abo abaleka abaana baabwe okufuna empisa ze bamanyi nti zirina okumenyebwa oluvannyuma. Si ekyo kyokka, abamu babeera n'okwagala okw'obusirusiru ennyo ne bayigiriza abaana baabwe, nga bazannya, okukola ebintu bye bajja oluvannyuma katono okubakubira ennyo. Omwana bw'abonerezebwa ateekwa okuwangulwa, era kino tekiba kizibu kukola, singa tafuuse mukakanyavu olw'okumusiimuulira ennyo. Era okwagala kw'omwana bwe kumala okufugibwa ddala, n'aleetebwa okussaamu abazadde be ekitiibwa n'okubatya, awo ebisirusiru bingi eby'obuto n'ensobi ez'obutafaayo biyinza okusonyiyibwa. Ebimu bandibuusiddwa amaaso ne bitafiibwako, n'ebirala ne binenyezebwa mu bukkakkamu; naye tewali kwonoona kwa bugenderevu kwe kwandisonyiyiddwa abaana awatali kubonereza, kutono oba kungi, nga bwe kisaanira okusinziira ku kika n'embeera y'ensonga. Nkalambira ku kuwangula okwagala kw'abaana nga bakyali bato, kubanga eno ye musingi gwokka ogw'amaanyi era ogw'amagezi ogw'okusomesa eddiini, nga tegulimu, okuyigiriza n'ekyokulabirako byombi tebiyinza kugasa. Naye kino bwe kimala okukolebwa mu bujjuvu, omwana asobola okufugibwa n'amagezi n'okutya Katonda kw'abazadde be, okutuusa okutegeera kwe yennyini lwe kukula, n'emisingi gy'eddiini ne gisimba emirandira mu birowoozo bye.

" Sinnaba kukomya nsonga eno. Nga okwagala kw'omuntu ku bubwe bwe kuli ekikolo ky'ekibi kyonna n'obuyinike bwonna, bwe kityo kyonna ekikuliisa mu baana kibaleetera obuyinike n'obutatya Katonda mu maaso; kyonna ekikuziyiza ne kikutta, kibaleetera essanyu n'okutya Katonda mu biseera ebigenda okujja. Kino kyeyoleka n'okusingawo bwe tulowooza nti eddiini teri kirala wabula okukola Katonda by'ayagala so si ebyaffe; nti olw'okuba ekiziyiza ekimu ekisinga obunene eky'essanyu lyaffe ery'ensi n'ery'emirembe n'emirembe kwe kwagala kuno okw'omuntu ku bubwe, tewali kukusiimuulira kwonna kuyinza kuba kutono, era tewali kukugaana kwonna kuyinza kuba kwa bwereere. Eggulu oba ggeyeena byesigamye ku kino kyokka, ne kiba nti omuzadde afuba okukuwangula mu mwana we akolera awamu ne Katonda mu kuzza buggya n'okulokola omwoyo. Omuzadde akusiimuulira akola omulimu gwa Setaani; afuula eddiini etasoboka, obulokozi obutatuukikako, era akola kyonna ky'asobola okusingisa omwana we omusango ogw'okuzikirizibwa, omubiri n'emmeeme, emirembe gyonna.

" Abaana baffe baayigirizibwanga, amangu ddala nga basobola okwogera, Essaala ya Mukama, gye baalagirwanga okwogera bulijjo nga bagolokose ku makya ne nga bagenda okwebaka; era nga bwe baagendanga bakula, ne kwongerwako essaala ennyimpi ku lw'abazadde baabwe, n'essaala ezimu ezitegekeddwa ez'ekkanisa, katekisimu ennyimpi, n'ekitundu ky'Ebyawandiikibwa nga bwe kyagendanga kisaanira okujjukira kwabwe. Baayigirizibwanga nnyo nga bakyali bato okwawula Ssabbiiti ku nnaku endala, nga tebannaba na kusobola kwogera bulungi oba kutambula. Era mu kiseera kye kimu baayigirizibwanga okusirika ng'ab'omu maka basaba, n'okusaba omukisa amangu ddala oluvannyuma, kye baakolanga nga bakozesa obubonero, nga tebannaba kusobola kufukamira wadde okwogera.

" Baategeezebwanga mangu nti tebajja kufuna kintu kyonna kye bakaabira, era ne bayigirizibwa okusaba mu mpisa ennungi kye beetaaga. Tebaakkirizibwanga kusaba wadde omuweereza asembayo obuto ekintu kyonna awatali kugamba nti ' Nkwegayiridde mpa ekintu kino ' ; era omuweereza yanenyezebwanga singa yabakkirizanga okuleka ekigambo ekyo.

" Okukozesa erinnya lya Katonda bwereere, okukolima n'okulayira, okuvvoola ebitukuvu, ebigambo eby'obuwemu, n'amannya ag'ekikopi ag'obutaba na mpisa, tebyawulirwanga n'akatono mu bo; era tebaakkirizibwanga kuyitagana mannya gaabwe gokka awatali kwongerako ekigambo muganda wange oba mwannyinaze.

"Tewaali kintu ng'okuzannya oba okwogera mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka ekyakkirizibwanga, wabula buli muntu yakuumibwanga nga anyiikira omulimu gwe mu ssaawa omukaaga ez'essomero. Era kumpi tekikkirizika kye kiyinza okuyigirizibwa omwana mu myezi esatu bw'anyiikira n'amaanyi, singa alina obusobozi obwa wakati n'obulamu obulungi. Okuggyako Kezzy, bonna baali basobola okusoma mu kiseera ekyo okusinga abakazi abasinga obungi bwe basobola okusoma mu bulamu bwabwe bwonna. Okusituka mu bifo byabwe, oba okufuluma mu kisenge, tekwakkirizibwanga okuggyako nga waliwo ensonga ennungi; era okudduka okufuluma mu luggya, mu nnimiro, oba mu luguudo awatali lukusa, bulijjo kwatwalibwanga ng'omusango ogw'amaanyi ennyo.

" Okumala emyaka egimu twagenda bulungi nnyo. Tewaabangawo baana abaali mu nteekateeka esinga eyo. Tewaabangawo baana abaali basinga okwagala okutya Katonda, oba abaali basinga okuwulira abazadde baabwe, okutuusa lwe baasaasaanyizibwa mu ngeri ey'akabi mu maka ag'enjawulo oluvannyuma lw'omuliro. Mu maka ago baalekebwa nga ba ddembe ddala okwogera n'abaweereza, ekintu kye baali bakugirwa bulijjo emabegako, n'okudduka ebweru okuzannya n'abaana bonna, ababi n'abalungi. Mangu ddala ne bayiga okulagajjalira okukuuma Ssabbiiti n'obwegendereza, ne bamanya ennyimba eziwerako n'ebintu ebibi bye baali tebamanyi n'akatono emabegako. Empisa ennungi eyabaleeteranga okwewuunyizibwa abo bonna abaabalabanga nga bali awaka, yabula nnyo, era ne bayiga enjogera ey'ekikopi n'empisa nnyingi embi ezaatereezebwa n'obuzibu obutali butono.

" Ennyumba bwe yamala okuddamu okuzimbibwa, n'abaana bonna ne bakomezebwawo awaka, twatandika okulongoosa okukakali; era awo we twatandikira enkola ey'okuyimba zabbuli nga tutandika era nga tumaliriza essomero, ku makya ne ku kawungeezi. Era mu kiseera ekyo kwe twatandikira enkola ey'okwawukana bonna okugenda mu kifo eky'ekyama ku ssaawa kkumi n'emu ez'olweggulo (5 o'clock), omukulu bwe yatwalanga omuto eyali asobola okwogera, n'ow'okubiri n'atwala addako, ne babasomera zabbuli ez'olunaku olwo n'essuula mu Ndagaano Empya; nga ku makya bwe baalagirwanga okusoma zabbuli n'essuula mu Ndagaano Enkadde, oluvannyuma ne bagenda mu kusaba kwabwe okw'ekyama, nga tebannafuna kya nkya oba okujja mu b'omu maka.

" Waaliwo amateeka amatono agawerako ge twagobereranga. Ngoogera wano kubanga ndowooza ga mugaso.

" Erisooka, kyali kirabiddwa nti obuti n'okutya ekibonerezo bitera okutwala abaana mu kulimba okutuusa lwe kifuuka empisa gye batasobola kuleka. Okuziyiza kino, ne wateekebwawo etteeka nti buli eyalumirizibwanga ensobi gye yakola, bw'anaagyatula mu mazima n'asuubiza okwekyusa, tajja kukubibwa. Etteeka lino lyaziyiza obulimba bungi, era lyandiziyizza n'okusingawo singa omu ku b'omu maka yali alikkiriza. Naye ye teyasobola kukkirizibwa, era kyeyava alimbibwalimbibwa emirundi mingi n'ebigambo eby'obulimba n'eby'okwekwasa, ebitandikozeseddwa muntu n'omu, okuggyako omu, singa baali bakwatiddwa n'ekisa; era abamu, ne bwe kyali kityo, bulijjo baayogeranga amazima mu lwatu.

" Ery'okubiri, nti tewali kikolwa kya kibi, ng'okulimba, okubba obubbi obutono mu kkanisa oba ku Lunaku lwa Mukama, obujeemu, okuyomba, n'ebirala, kyandirekeddwa awatali kubonerezebwa."

(Omuntu awulira nti mu sentensi eyo esembayo Mukyala Wesley ateekwa okuba nga yatataaganyizibwa, oba nti oboolyawo olunyiriri lumu oba bbiri olw'ebbaluwa ye lwabula (kubanga ebbaluwa eno ekubiddwa mu kyapa emirundi egiwerako), kubanga bulijjo yali muntu wa magezi amatangaavu era omwegendereza mu by'awandiika, era mazima yandibadde atwala okubba ku lunaku lwonna ne mu kifo kyonna ng'ekibi.) " Ery'okusatu, nti tewali mwana yenna eyandinenyezeddwa oba okukubibwa emirundi ebiri olw'ensobi y'emu, era nti singa beekyusa, tebandiddamu kuvumirirwa lwa nsobi eyo oluvannyuma.

" Ery'okuna, nti buli kikolwa eky'obuwulize ekyeyoleka, naddala nga kikontana n'okwagala kwabwe bo bennyini, kyandisiimiddwa bulijjo, era emirundi mingi ne kiweebwa empeera okusinziira ku bunene bw'ensonga.

" Ery'okutaano, nti singa omwana yenna yakolanga ekikolwa eky'obuwulize, oba yakolanga ekintu kyonna ng'agenderera okusanyusa, newaakubadde ng'ekyo ky'akoze tekyali kirungi, naye obuwulize n'ekigendererwa ebyo byandikkiriziddwa n'ekisa, n'omwana n'alagirirwa mu bukkakkamu engeri y'okukola obulungi okusingawo mu maaso.

" Ery'omukaaga, nti obwannannyini (eddembe ly'ebintu by'omuntu) bukuumibwe bulijjo awatali kukyuka, era tewali n'omu akkirizibwa kutyoboola bintu bya munne mu nsonga esinga obutono, ne bwe kiba nga kya muwendo gwa farthing oba ppini, bye bataasaanidde kuggya ku nnannyini byo awatali kukkiriza kwe, nga tekyogerwa nti n'okusingawo ng'akikontanye nakyo. Etteeka lino teriyinza kuyigirizibwa nnyo ekisukkiridde mu birowoozo by'abaana; era olw'abazadde n'abakulu obutakikola nga bwe kibagwanidde, kye kivaako obulagajjavu obw'ensonyi mu bwenkanya bwe tuyinza okulaba mu nsi.

" Ery'omusanvu, nti ebisuubizo bikuumibwe nnyo; era ekirabo bwe kimala okuweebwayo, eddembe ne liva ku oyo akiwaddeyo, kireme kuddizibwa, wabula kirekerwe oyo eyakiweebwa akikozese nga bw'ayagala, okuggyako nga kyaweebwa ku bukwakkulizo, era ng'obukwakkulizo obwo tebutuukiriziddwa.

" Ery'omunaana, nti tewali muwala ayigirizibwa mulimu gwa mikono okutuusa ng'amaze okusoma obulungi ennyo; era nti akuumibwe ku mulimu ogwo n'obunyiikivu bwe bumu era okumala ebbanga lye limu lye yakuumibwanga mu kusoma. Etteeka lino nalyo lisaanidde nnyo okugobererwa, kubanga okuteeka abaana okuyiga okutunga nga tebannaba kusobola kusoma bulungi ddala y'ensonga ddala lwaki abakazi bangi nnyo tebasobola kusoma mu ngeri esaanira okuwulirwa, era tebategeerekeka bulungi n'akamu.

" SUSANNA WESLEY."

Amateeka gano omunaana gaalaga obutonde obw'amagezi era obugabi, era erisembayo ku go lyalaga omukazi eyatwalanga amagezi okuba ag'omuwendo okusinga ebintu eby'omubiri. Bantu batono nnyo ku bannansi be, abasajja n'abakazi, mu biseera bino ebya leero, abatuuka ku bukugu obw'okusoma mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka nga bawulirwa era nga bategeerekeka, nga bw'oyinza okukiraba ng'onyiikira okugenda mu kkanisa, abasumba abasinga obungi gye bamyumyuunya ne boonoona ddala essaala z'ekkanisa n'ebisomwa byombi.

Oboolyawo ebitabo by'essomero ebya bulijjo byali bitono e Epworth — mazima tewaaliwo ssente zisigaddewo kubigula — oba oboolyawo kyali kya mu nkola ey'ekigendererwa, abaana ba Mukyala Wesley okuyigirizibwa ennukuta zaabwe ennyini n'ebigambo ebitono okuva mu ssuula esooka ey'Olubereberye, era ne bafuulibwa abakugu mu kusoma buli lunyiriri nga tebannagenda ku lulwako. Amangu ddala ng'olunaku lw'amazaalibwa ag'okutaano luyise, ennyumba yateekebwanga mu nteekateeka, maama n'awaayo essaawa omukaaga ez'essomero ez'olunaku lumu lwonna okuyigiriza omuyizi we asinga obuto ennukuta ze, era ye kennyini yatubuulira obuwanguzi bwe yafunanga. Ateekwa okuba nga yalina obudde bungi obutaataaganyizibwa olw'omulimu gwe ogw'okusomesa, kubanga bba yamalanga ennaku ze ezisinga obungi mu kisenge kye eky'okusomeramu bwe yabanga awaka, era yalondebwa basumba banne ab'omu Lincolnshire okubakiikirira emirundi esatu egy'enjawulo mu Convocation (olukiiko olukulu olw'abasumba). Kino kyamutwalanga e London okumala emyezi mingi omulundi gumu; era newaakubadde ng'olugendo n'ensaasaanya ey'okubeera mu kibuga ekikulu okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo byali bimuggyako nnyo ssente, omulimu ogwo gwali gumusanyusa era gwamukuumanga mu maaso g'abantu, ne kireetera ebitabo bye okutunda amangu, ne kimuwa n'omukisa okweyoleka n'okwogera n'abafulumya ebitabo. Mu biseera ebyo bwe yabanga taliiwo, Mukyala Wesley ye yakwatanga byonna mu mikono gye, ettaka ly'ekkanisa, ekigo, n'ab'omu maka; ye yakuumanga ebitabo by'ebbalirira, n'akola kyonna ky'asobola mu by'okulima; newaakubadde nga, nga bba, yali amaze obuvubuka bwe e London ne mu bitabo, teyayinza kuba nga yali amanyi nnyo eby'ekika ekyo; yawandiikiraganga ne bba, omukulu we era omufuzi we, era n'asomesa abaana be n'obunyiikivu.

Kirabika ng'akaseera katono ak'okuwummulako ku bizibu by'ensimbi kaatandika okwakira ab'omu maka ga Wesley mu ttoggo lya 1702. Ekitabo ky'omusumba ekiyitibwa " Ebyafaayo by'Endagaano Enkadde n'Empya ebigezeddwako mu nnyimba, era ebiyooyooteddwa n'ebifaananyi ebyoleddwa ebikumi bisatu mu asatu " kyali kifulumye emyezi mitono emabega, era awatali kubuusabuusa kyali kisuubirwa okuleeta amagoba amangi. Naye ssente zaayingira mpola nnyo, era ababanja ne bapikiriza nnyo okusasulwa bye baali babanja, ne kiba nti mu Maaki Omwami Wesley yaddamu okulinnya embalaasi ye n'agenda e London okunoonya obuyambi. Okusaba kwe kwaddibwamu mu bifo bingi, kubanga Dean w'e Exeter yamuwa pawundi kkumi, Ssaabalabirizi w'e Canterbury guinea kkumi, Marquis w'e Normanby amakumi abiri, ne Marchioness ttaano. Ssente endala entono ntono zaatuusa omuwendo ku pawundi nkaaga, era omusajja oyo omulungi n'addayo eka ng'ajjudde essanyu, n'asasula amabanja agamu gonna, n'ekitundu ku galala, n'asigaza pawundi kkumi mu mikono gye okuyamba ku nsaasaanya ey'okukungula ebirime bye. Tekyetaagisa kulowooza nti ssente zino zaamuweebwa lwa kusaasirwa kwokka, kubanga okufulumya ebitabo mu kiseera ekyo, nga bwe kiri ne leero, kyali kya bbeeyi nnyo, era abawandiisi abaali batalina ssente nnyingi baakikolanga nga bayita mu kusaba abantu okusasulira ebitabo nga tebinnafuluma. Kiyinzika nnyo nti Marquis, ne Ssaabalabirizi, n'abalala baali basuubizza okuwaayo ssente zaabwe ez'okwewandiisa naye nga tebazisasudde, ne kiba nti Omwami Wesley ayinza okuba nga yakuŋŋaanya bukuŋŋaanya ssente ezaali zimugwanira mu bwenkanya.

Naye okufiirwa n'obwavu byamugoberera, kubanga ekyeya kyali kya bbugumu lingi, n'akasolya k'essubi ak'ennyumba y'omusumba ne kakala nnyo, era oboolyawo n'omudumu gw'omukka ogw'effumbiro gwali gwetaaga okulongoosebwa. Ka kibe bwe kiti, ensasi z'omuliro ezimu zaagwa ku kasolya, era newaakubadde ng'ennyumba teyayokebwa yonna, okwonooneka kungi kwabaawo. Kiteekwa okuba nga kyaliwo nga Anne alina wiiki ntono nnyo ng'azaaliddwa, oba nga tannaba kuzaalibwa. Omwami Wesley yawandiika ebyaliwo n'abiweereza mukwano gwe ow'ekisa era omwesigwa bulijjo, Ssaabalabirizi w'e York, gwe yali atandise okuwandiikira ebbaluwa nga 25 Julaayi, ng'awandiise ennaku z'omwezi zokka n'ebigambo "My Lord" (Ssebo Omulabirizi). Olupapula olwo lwennyini lwayokebwako ekitundu era ne lutoba n'amazzi agaazikiza omuliro; naye olw'okuba lwawonyezebwa, wamu n'ebitabo n'empapula endala, ebbaluwa yaggwa okuwandiikibwa ku lwo ku nkomerero, n'eweerezebwa Dr. Sharpe.

" Oyo azaalibwa okuba omuyiiya w'ennyimba, ntya nti ateekwa okubeera omwavu n'afa nga mwavu, kubanga ku lunaku olusembayo olwa Julaayi 1702, omuliro gwakwata mu nnyumba yange, olw'ensasi ezimu ezaakwata ku ssubi mu kiseera kino eky'ekyeya, ne gwokya ebitundu bibiri ku bisatu byayo nga tegunnazikizibwa. Nnali ku nkomerero ey'emmanga ey'ekibuga nga ngenze okulaba omulwadde, era okuva eyo ne ŋŋenda ewa R. Cogan. Bwe nnali nkomawo, ne bandeetera amawulire. Ne nfuna emu ku mbalaasi ze, ne ngyebagala ne nnyanguwa okudda, era bwe nnali mu kkubo ne mpulira nti mukyala wange, abaana, n'ebitabo byange byawonye, Katonda yeebazibwe olw'ekyo, era ne ku ebyo by'atutte. Bonna baali wamu mu kisenge kyange eky'okusomeramu, ng'omuliro guli wansi waabwe. Bwe gwakwata, yasitula babiri ku baana mu mikono gye, n'adduka ng'ayita mu kikka ne mu muliro; naye omu ku bo yalekebwa mu kutabukatabuka, okutuusa omulala lwe yamukaabira, baliraanwa ne bayingira ne bamuggyayo nga bayita mu muliro, nga bwe baakola ku bitabo byange n'ebintu byange ebisinga obungi; ne ku lupapula luno lwennyini mu birala, lwe nnazuula oluvannyuma bwe nnali nkebera ebyawonyezebwa.

" Nzudde nti kya ssanyu katono okuba nga wali omunaku, kubanga ebirowoozo byange byali bimaze okuggwaamu obukaawu olw'ebibambulira eby'emabega, ne kiba nti kino kumpi tekyankwatako n'akamu. Nja kweyongerayo, Katonda bw'anaannyamba, okutwala title yange (tithe? — ekimu eky'ekkumi); era ekyo bwe kinaggwa, okuddamu okuzimba ennyumba yange, nga nnamaze okunyigiriza ab'omu maka gange mu kitundu ekyasigalawo, era nga sibulwa bintu byange bingi."

Waliwo olugero olukwata ku kitundu kino eky'obulamu bwa Mukyala Wesley, olwo newaakubadde nga lwesigamye ku bujulirwa bwa mutabani we John, luteekwa okuba nga nsobi oba nga lwa kuzimbulukusa; era olw'okuba ekyogerwako kyaliwo nga tannaba kuzaalibwa, mazima yakiddiŋŋana nga bwe yakiwulira okuva ku balala, so si nga bwe yakimanya ye kennyini. Lugamba nti Mukyala Wesley, olw'okuba teyatwalanga William ow'e Orange ng'omufuzi omutuufu owa Bungereza, teyaddangamu mu kusaba kwa Kabaka nga bba akusoma mu kusinza kw'amaka. Bba n'amubuuza ensonga lwaki, n'afuna okunnyonnyola okwangu naye okujjuvu okw'endowooza ze mu by'obufuzi; awo n'amuddamu n'obusungu nti, " Sukey, oba nga bwe kiri bwe kityo, nze naawe tuteekwa okwawukana; kubanga bwe tuba ne bakabaka babiri, tuteekwa okuba n'obuliri bubiri," era n'alangirira nti okuggyako ng'alese endowooza ze, teyandyeyongedde kubeera naye. Olugero lugamba nti obujeemu bwe bwamuluma nnyo mu mutima, n'afuluma mu kisenge nga tayongeddeko kigambo, n'agenda mu kisenge kye eky'okusomeramu, era mu kiseera ky'olunaku olwo n'atambula ku mbalaasi n'agenda mu Convocation nga tamusiibudde wadde okuddamu okwogera naye. Yamala e London omwaka mulamba nga tamuwandiikira, era n'akomawo nga Kwiini Anne amaze okulya obwakabaka. Tewaali nkaayana wakati waabwe bombi ku ddembe lye ery'okufuga, bwe batyo ne baddamu obulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo, era John Wesley ye mwana eyasooka okuzaalibwa oluvannyuma. Olwo lwe lugero; naye lulabikira ddala nti lwa bulimba, kubanga ekisooka, ennaku z'omwezi eziweebwa n'ebigambibwa nti byaliwo tebikwatagana; era eky'okubiri, John Wesley yazaalibwa nga 17 Juuni mu Kalenda Enkadde, oba nga 28 mu Kalenda Empya, 1703, nga mwannyina Anne alina emyezi kkumi n'ebiri; ne kiba nti olugero lw'okubeera kwa kitaawe ewala n'awaka omwaka mulamba lugwa wansi. Amaanyi n'obunywevu bw'endowooza za Mukyala Wesley mu by'obufuzi birabikira mu bitundu by'ebiwandiiko bye ebiyitibwa " Occasional Papers," bye yawandiika emyaka ebiri oba esatu oluvannyuma. Eggwanga lyali mu lutalo, era ekigendererwa ky'entalo za Marlborough kyali kumenya buyinza bwa Bufalansa, newaakubadde nga waaliwo abamu abawolereza abaalangiriranga nti ekigendererwa kyazo n'enkomerero yazo kwe kukuuma enzikiriza ya Kiprotestanti. " Ku bikwata ku kukuuma eddiini yaffe," bw'awandiika, " ndowooza eyo nsonga esinga n'okusingawo obutaba na mazima ey'okwekwasa olw'olutalo okusinga endala. Kubanga, newaakubadde abasajja abamu ab'endowooza ey'enjawulo bayinza okwematiza, nze ndowooza nti nga Obwakabaka bw'Omulokozi waffe bwe butali bwa mu nsi muno, bwe kityo tekikkirizibwa n'akatono kukwata byakulwanyisa olw'okukuuma eddiini kyokka. Kifaanana ng'amalala ga Uzza, eyagolola omukono gwe n'obuvumu obw'ekyejo okuwanirira essanduuko eyali ewuuba; ekyo kinzijukiza ennyiriri zino ez'omuyiiya w'ennyimba atali mubi: — Mu nsonga ng'eyo okugiyingiramu kwa kufa, Nga Omuyudaaya oli ow'obuvumu, eyawanirira essanduuko eyali egwa; N'omukono ogutaaweebwa lukusa yeetantala okusembera, Era, newaakubadde yali ayagala kugiwonya, okugikwatako kwali kufa.

Era mazima obuwanguzi bw'amagye gaffe okutuusa kati tebulina ngeri gye bulaze nti okugezaako kwaffe kwali kutuufu; naye newaakubadde Katonda tasinze kulabika ng'ayagala abalabe baffe, era naye tawadde mukisa mu bujjuvu magye gaffe. Naye newaakubadde nga waliwo ensonga nnyingi eziweebwa olw'ekikolwa, bulijjo ebaawo ensonga emu yokka ey'amazima esalawo kye tukola, era eyo, mu nsonga eno, ndowooza kwe kukuuma abo abaakozesebwa mu Nkyukakyuka (Revolution) obutatuukibwako busungu bwa mukama waabwe eyanyiiga, n'okumuziyiza okudda, n'okunyweza obusika mu musika. Oba nga baakola bulungi okugoba omulangira ku ntebe ye ey'obusika, kino nkirekera emitima gyabwe gyennyini okusalawo; newaakubadde nga simanyi ngeri gye nnyinza kulowooza nti Kabaka wa Bungereza ayinza okuvunaanibwa abantu be olw'obufuzi obubi oba olw'okukozesa obubi obuyinza. Naye nga bw'aggya obuyinza bwe ku Katonda, bw'atyo ye yekka gw'alina okunnyonnyola engeri gy'abukozesaamu. Naye era, nnyawula nnyo wakati w'abo abeegatta mu lukwe olw'okulwanyisa Omulangira waabwe, n'abo, abatamanyi kintu kyonna ku nteekateeka eyo, era bwe batyo nga tebagikkirizaamu, abaagondera bugondezi Gavumenti eriwo kati, ekirabika gye ndi nga lye tteeka ly'eggwanga ly'Abangereza, era obuvunaanyizibwa bw'Abakristaayo ab'obwannannyini, era nga bwe kiri eri abantu bano abasinga obungi. Naye oba ng'okusabira omuntu eyeddiza obwakabaka obutali bubwe, n'okuwolereza bye yeddiza nga amaze okufuna entebe, si kwe kwegatta mu bibi bye, kino kyangu okusalawo." Kirabika nti era, olunaku lw'okusiiba olw'eggwanga bwe lwalangirirwa ne lukuumibwa, Mukyala Wesley yasigala waka mu kifo ky'okugenda mu kkanisa, era akiwolereza bw'ati: " Olw'okuba sikakasiza ddala nti olutalo lwa mateeka, siyinza kusabira mukisa ku magye gaffe okutuusa nga nfunye endowooza y'omuntu ansinga amagezi, era omulamuzi ansinga obusobozi, ku nsonga eno, kwe kugamba, oba ng'omuntu owa bulijjo atalina mukono gwonna mu kutandika olutalo, naye eyalunenya bulijjo, ayinza, newaakubadde bwe kityo, okwegayirira Katonda omukisa ku lwo, n'okusabira obuwanguzi obulungi eri amagye ago agaakwata ebyokulwanyisa, nga bwe ndowooza, mu ngeri emenya amateeka. Mu kiseera kino ndowooza nti buvunaanyizibwa bwange, olw'okuba siyinza kwegatta mu kusinza okwa lukale, okumala obudde abalala bwe bamala mu ekyo nga neetoowaza mu maaso ga Katonda olw'ebibi byange n'eby'eggwanga; n'okumwegayirira asonyiwe ensi eyo ey'omusango, mwe muli enkumi n'enkumi z'abantu abatalina musango, newaakubadde bwe kityo, nga bw'obageraageranya; era aleme okutta abatuukirivu awamu n'ababi; wabula akomye okuyiwa omusaayi gw'Abakristaayo, era, mu kiseera kye ekirungi, atuddize omukisa gw'emirembe egy'eggwanga lyonna.
