Charles yawandiika ebyaliwo byonna nga 30, oboolyawo ennaku bbiri oluvannyuma lw'okuziika, eri muganda we Samuel, eyali mu kiseera ekyo asenze e Tiverton, n'ayongerako nti : — " Maama yandisanyuse nnyo okukulaba amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka. Tubaze amabanja, era tusanze nga gasukka pawundi kikumi, nga tobaliddemu aga kizibwe Richardson. Mukyala Knight, nnannyini ttaka (lya Mukyala Wesley), yawamba ebisolo bye byonna, ebyabalirirwamu emiwendo egisukka pawundi amakumi ana, olwa pawundi kkumi na ttaano taata ze yali amubanja, ku Mmande ewedde, olunaku lwe yaziikibwa. Era muganda wange olweggulo lwa leero awaayo endagaano ey'okusasula ensimbi, ebisolo bisobole okuteebwa okutundibwa, era olw'okwekuuma ebisolo biwandiikibwa ku linnya lye, era ajja kusasulwa nga bwe binaatundibwa. Taata yaziikibwa mu ngeri etaasaasaanyizibwamu nnyo, naye mu kitiibwa, mu limbo ly'ekkanisa, nga bwe yali ayagala.

" Kijja kuba kyetaagisa nnyo okuleeta ebiwandiiko byonna eby'ebyo bye yali akubanja, olyoke oteeke akabonero ku bintu byonna eby'omu nnyumba ng'omubanzi omukulu, era bw'otyo okakase nti maama afuna ekiseera n'eddembe okubitunda ku muwendo ogusinga obulungi.

* •* * * # " Bw'onooyita e London ng'ojja, maama akusaba ojjukire nti nnamwandu w'omusumba. Ekibiina (the Society) ne bwe kinaamuwa kye kyagala, ateekwa okusigala ng'akuzitoowerera mu ngeri emu, nga bw'akiyita. Nga nkukwatirwa obuggya olw'omugugu ogwo ogw'ekitiibwa, era nneegomba nga nnandisobodde okugusitula naawe ! Oteekwa okunteeka mu ngeri emu ey'okufunamu ensimbi entono, ndyoke nkoleko ekintu mu kumenyeka kw'eryato ly'amaka gaffe, ne bwe kiba nga tekisukka ku kuwaayo olubaawo lumu."

Byonna ebyali eby'okufa ebya Samuel Wesley byateekebwa mu limbo ly'ekkanisa e Epworth, era waggulu w'ebisigalira bye ne wateekebwa ejjinja eppapajjavu ery'omusenyu omukalu, eriwaniriddwa amatoffaali, era nga ku ngulu waalyo kuwandiikiddwako ebigambo eby'okujjukira omufu nnamwandu we bye yawandiika. Kino kyaddamu okusalibwa n'okuddaabirizibwa mu 1819 Dr. Adam Clarke, era mu 1872 entaana yaddaabirizibwa ddala omukyala eyali abeera e Epworth.

fields.title: Obunnamwandu
fields.body_html:
TEWAALIWO kintu kyonna kyandisigazza Mukyala Wesley e Epworth ng'ensonga ze entono zimaze okutereezebwa, era nga batabani be bamaze okuddayo e Tiverton ne Oxford. Samuel yatwala Kezia ewuwe, nnyina n'agenda okubeera okumala ekiseera ne muwala we omukulu e Gainsborough. Awatali kubuusabuusa kyamubudaabuda okubeera ne Emilia, kubanga omukwano wakati waabwe bombi gwali bulijjo gwa maanyi nnyo; ate Martha, muwala we omulala eyali ayagala ennyo nnyina, yali mu London ng'eteekateeka okufumbirwa. Omusajja gwe yali yeeyamye okufumbirwa yali Omwami Wesley oba Westley Hall, mukwano gwa bannyina era omuyigirizwa waabwe e Oxford, eyayogerwako mu bbaluwa za Mukyala Wesley ezimu eri batabani be. Martha yasooka okumusisinkana bwe yali alabirira ennyumba ya kitaawe omuto Matthew mu London; eyo Hall gye yamwogerereza era Martha n'amukkiriza. Oluvannyuma Hall yawerekera John ne Charles e Epworth, era, ekyewuunyisa, kirabika tewali n'omu eyali amanyi nti yali yeeyamye dda okuwasa, n'atandika okwogereza Kezia n'obunyiikivu bungi. Bwe yamala okuwamba omutima gwe, yeefuula nti alabye okwolesebwa okuva mu ggulu okumugaana okumuwasa, era, oboolyawo ng'amanyi bulungi ebirungi Omwami Matthew Wesley bye yali ateeseteese okukolera muwala wa mwannyina gwe yasinga okwagala, n'addayo eri Martha gwe yali yeeyamye. Bannyina wa Martha bwe baawulira nti yali anaatera okufumbirwa Omwami Hall, ne bamulumiriza nti yali anyaze Kezia omwagalwa we; awo Martha n'awandiikira nnyina ng'amunnyonnyola ensonga yonna mu bujjuvu. Nnyina n'alaba nti yali mutuufu ddala okukkiriza Omwami Hall, n'awa olukusa lwe mu butongole okufumbirwa, ng'ayongerako nti singa ne kitaawe omuto awa olukusa lwe, tewandibaddewo kiziyiza kyonna.

Abaagalana abo baagattibwa mu kyeya kya 1735, ne bagenda okubeera e Wootton mu Gloucestershire, omugole omusajja gye yali omuyambi w'omusumba. Embaga yaabwe yatenderezebwa n'ekitontome ekiwanvu ennyo, ekyafulumira mu magazini ya Gentleman's Magazine eya Sebuttemba ow'omwaka ogwo.

Mu kiseera ekyo ebirowoozo bya John ne Charles Wesley byali bimaliddwa nnyo ku lugendo lwabwe olwali lunaatera okubatwala e Georgia. Jenerali James Oglethorpe yali yatandikawo Georgia emyaka egyali giyiseewo; nga bwe tulabye, yali awandiikagana n'omusumba wa Epworth, era yali amanyi bulungi Samuel Wesley ow'e Westminster, era mu ngeri eyo n'amanya muto we eyalina amaanyi n'obunyiikivu. Mu 1732, yakomawo mu Bungereza okunoonya abantu abalala okujjuza ekitundu kye ekyo, n'okukola omulimu gw'obuminsani mu bannansi b'eyo. Ng'ayambibwako Gavumenti, yakuŋŋaanya Abasikootilandi ab'oku nsozi (Highlanders) 130 n'Abagirimaani 170 okuddayo naye, era n'alonda John Wesley okuba omusumba (chaplain) era omuminsani, ne Charles okuba omuwandiisi we ow'ekyama. Olugendo olwo bwe lwasooka okubaleetebwako, tebaalwagala n'akamu, era John yalugaana mu bulambulukufu. Jenerali n'abakulira ekitundu ekyo ne bamwegayirira addemu alowooze ku kusalawo kwe, era awatali kubuusabuusa yajjukira nti kitaawe yafangayo nnyo ku kitundu ekyo. Okusalawo kwe kwatandika okukankana, naye yagamba nti tasobola kuva mu Bungereza nga nnyina omukadde era omunafu akyali mulamu. Awo ne bamubuuza obanga nnyina bw'anaamukkiriza okugenda, ensonga eyo tegenda kukyuka. Kyeyava agenda e Gainsborough n'amala ennaku ssatu ne Mukyala Wesley ne Emilia, ng'amaliridde mu mutima gwe okukkiriza ekyo nnyina ky'anaasalawo ng'eddoboozi lya Katonda mu kulabirira kwe. Bwe yamala okumubuulira by'ayagala, nnyina n'addamu nti: "Singa mbadde n'abaana ab'obulenzi 20, nandisanyuse okulaba nga bonna bakozesebwa mu mulimu ng'ogwo, ne bwe sandiddamu kubalaba." Kino, kya lwatu, kyamaliriza ensonga; amangu ago Charles n'ayawulibwa, ng'aweebwa obwadiyakoni n'obwakabona mu nnaku ntono nnyo olw'obwetaavu obw'amangu obwaliwo; era nga bali wamu ne mikwano gyabwe babiri ab'e Oxford, Omwami Ingham n'Omwami Delamotte, ne basitula mu kukkiriza, era si nga tebalina ku kagezo k'okwagala okufuna ebyewuunyisa n'okulaba ebifo ebipya, ekibeera eky'obuzaaliranwa mu basajja ab'emyaka gyabwe. Bonna baasaabala okuva e Gravesend, mu lyato eddungi Symmonds, nga 14 Okitobba 1735, nga wayise emyezi nga mukaaga okuva amaka g'e Epworth lwe gaasasika.

Tetuyinza kulowooza nti Mukyala Wesley teyawandiikagana bbaluwa nnyingi ne batabani be ku nsonga eyo, naye emu yokka y'esigaddewo. Ebbaluwa eno entono kirabika ye yali esooka gye yawandiika nga bamaze okusaabala: — "Gainsborough, nga 27 Novemba 1735. "MWANA WANGE OMWAGALWA,

Katonda ye Bulamu bwennyini, NDI NGA BWE NDI, n'olwekyo ateekwa okuba Obulungi Obusingayo! Wa mukisa nnyo awatali kkomo, ne kiba nti buli lwe tuwulira okubeerawo kwe okw'essanyu kuleeta mu mutima obulamu obw'essanyu. Buli ddaala lye tusembera gy'ali, mu kigero kye kimu, ddaala lya ssanyu; era emirundi mingi ndowooza nti singa abadde mu birowoozo byaffe bulijjo, nga naffe bwe tuli mu maaso ge bulijjo, tewandibaddewo bulumi wadde okuwulira obunaku. Ebbanga ddene kati kasookedde mmulonda okuba Obulungi bwange bwokka, Byonna byange, okusanyuka kwange, essanyu lyange, mu nsi eno era ne mu nsi egenda okujja. Era newaakubadde nga sibadde mwesigwa eri ekisa kye nga bwe nnandibadde, kyokka mpulira omwoyo gwange nga gunywerera ku kusalawo kwe, era buli lunaku gufuba okwegatta ku Katonda n'obunywevu. Naye waliwo ekintu kimu ekinteganya emirundi mingi: wadde nga mmanyi nti 'bwe tuba mu mubiri guno, tetuba waffe, olwo nga tetuli na Mukama waffe,' wadde nga sikyalina kawoowo wadde okwagala kwonna eri ekyo ensi ky'eyita essanyu, kyokka seegomba kuddayo waka, nga bwe nnandyetaagidde mu magezi. Kino kintiisa emirundi mingi; era nga bwe nkusabira bulijjo (kumpi obutalekaayo), mwana wange, bwe ntyo naawe nkwegayirira ombasabire, Katonda anfuule omulungi okusingawo, era antwale nga ndi mu mbeera yange esinga obulungi.

"Nnyoko akwagala, "SUSANNA WESLEY."

Mu Sebuttemba 1736, Mukyala Wesley, eyatambulatambula ennyo mu bunnamwandu bwe okusinga bwe yakola mu bulamu bwe bwonna obwasooka, yagenda okubeera ne mutabani we omukulu e Tiverton, oboolyawo ng'adda mu kifo kya Kezia, eyayitibwa ab'omu maka ga Hall okugenda okubeera nabo. Yaanirizibwa n'essanyu lingi Samuel ne mukyala we, ne Mukyala Berry nnyina wa mukyala oyo. Samuel yagamba nti yali ng'ali mu ddungu mu by'okukolagana n'abantu, "nga sirina muntu gwe nnyinza kunyumya naye okuggyako mukyala wange, okutuusa nnyange lwe yajja wiiki ewedde." Kumpi kikakafu nti, bwe yali e Tiverton, Mukyala Wesley yabuulira mutabani we ebintu bingi nga bwe yali asobola okujjukira ku maka ga kitaawe. Kijjukirwa nti kitaawe yali muganda w'Earl wa Anglesey ow'okumpi (baali baana ba baganda), nti yalina abaana ab'obulenzi babiri bokka (bombi baali bafudde nga tebaleka baana), era nti empapula ze zonna yazirekera muwala we omuto ennyo, naye eky'ennaku, zaayokerwa mu muliro ogwayokya ennyumba y'omusumba e Epworth. Obwa Earl bwa Anglesey bwali bukomye olw'obutabaawo basika ba bulenzi. Singa empapula za Annesley zaali zikyaliwo, kyalowoozebwa nti oboolyawo Samuel Wesley yandisobodde okubwesimbirawo ng'ayita mu nnyina. Kyokka mutabani we omu yekka yali yafa, ate muwala we omu yekka eyakula n'atuuka mu buwala obukulu yafumbirwa omusajja eyalina okwegomba okw'amaanyi, Omwami Earle, eyandisobodde okunoonyereza n'amaanyi ng'alina ekirabo ekyo mu maaso, singa Charles Wesley teyawasa ng'akuze era n'azaala abaana ab'obulenzi. Singa waaliwo essuubi lyonna ery'okubufuna, lyandibadde lya Charles omuto, naye kitaawe, eyagaana ku myaka 20 okukkirizibwa ng'omusika wa Garret Wesley ow'e Dangan, ye yali omuntu asembayo okunoonyereza ku busika bw'ebyalo n'ekitiibwa mu Bungereza. Ab'omu maka ga Earle oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera baagenda e Bufalansa ne babeera eyo; kigambibwa nti omu ku bawala baabwe yafumbirwa Marshal Ney omututumufu.

Amangu ddala amawulire agataali ga mirembe gaava e Georgia. John ne Charles baali bennyamivu nnyo, naddala Charles. Era yafuna ekirowoozo nti yali tazaaliddwa buggya. Samuel yawandiika ng'amukubiriza okukomawo, n'aweereza John obubaka nti yali yeeraliikirira Kezia okubeera n'ab'omu maka ga Hall, olw'okuba yali teyesiga bba wa mwannyina, era n'olw'okwagala omuwala oyo kwe yali amulinamu edda. Yagamba nti yali tasobola kumulabirira okuggyako nga John asasula ensimbi z'emmere ye n'ekisulo. Charles ddala yakomawo, n'atuuka mu Bungereza nga 3 Desemba 1736, ng'aleese ebbaluwa ez'obubaka okuva eri abaali babeera mu kitundu ekyo. Kitaawe omuto Matthew yamwaniriza n'essanyu lingi, era bwe yali mu nnyumba ye, n'afuna ebbaluwa ey'omukwano omungi okuva eri Samuel, ng'erimu amawulire gonna, n'okumuyita e Tiverton, okuyita kwe yakkiriza amangu ddala, ne nnyina n'asanyuka nnyo, newaakubadde nga mu kiseera ekyo yali mulwadde ng'asibiddwa mu kisenge kye.

Mu Julaayi 1737, Mukyala Wesley yagenda okubeera n'ab'omu maka ga Hall, era kirabika yali bulungi nnyo eyo. Ebikwata ku bbanga lye yamala nabo e Wootton bitono nnyo ebimanyiddwa. Waliwo ebbaluwa gye yawandiikira Mukyala Berry e Tiverton ekyaliwo, naye kumpi yonna eyogera ku by'eddiini byokka. Mu kitundu kyayo ekisembayo agamba nti: "Nneebaza Katonda nti obulamu bwange bulungiko okusinga bwe nnawandiika omulundi oguwedde, era nkubuulira, kubanga mmanyi nti kijja kukusanyusa, nti Omwami Hall ne mukyala we bankolera bulungi nnyo. Yeeyisa ng'omwami ow'ekitiibwa era Omukristaayo, ne muwala wange anfaako n'obuwulize n'obukkakkamu ebisingiridde ebigambo, ne kiba nti ku nsonga eno ndi mukkakkamu nnyo." Ab'omu maka ga Hall bwe baasengukira e Fisherton okumpi ne Salisbury, yagenda nabo, era bwe yali abeera eyo n'afuna essanyu ery'okulaba John ng'akomawo okuva e Georgia; era olw'ebyo bye yawulira okuva gy'ali ne Charles, n'atuuka ku kusalawo nti tewali n'omu ku bo yandiddeyo eyo. Yeewuunya nnyo batabani be bwe baakola ekiyitibwa okuzuula nti enzikiriza yaabwe n'okuyigiriza kwabwe okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo byali bikyamu, ne bagamba nti abantu basobola okukakasa obulokozi bw'emmeeme zaabwe nga bayita mu kukkiriza kwokka mu kutangirira kwa Kristo. Okuva mu kiseera ekyo baabuulira enjigiriza abayivu b'eby'eddiini gye bayita okuweebwa obutuukirivu olw'okukkiriza, n'obujulirwa bw'Omwoyo. Oboolyawo Mukyala Wesley yategeera nti "Katonda atuukiriza by'ayagala mu ngeri nnyingi," era ate yali asemberera ensalo emyoyo w'egendera nga gilaba okuyita mu lufu lw'ebirowoozo ebikyamu ne gitegeera amazima ag'olubeerera; kubanga bwe yali addamu ebbaluwa ey'okutabuka okuva eri mutabani we omukulu, eyalabulanga buli muntu gwe yali amanyi okwekuuma enkola eno empya ey'okubuulira Enjiri, yawandiika ebbaluwa, ng'olw'okuba eyogeddwako nnyo, kumpi efuuse ey'ebyafaayo. Kirowoozebwa nti mu kiseera ekyo yali akyalidde Epworth: — "MWANA WANGE OMWAGALWA, "Lwakuna, nga 8 Maaki 1738-9.

Ebbaluwa zo ebbiri eziwanvu zantuukako bulungi ku Lwakutaano oluwedde. Nkwebaza olw'okuziwandiika, era nfunye essanyu lingi okuzisoma. Ziwandiikiddwa n'omwoyo omulungi n'amagezi, era ndowooza zimala okumatiza buli muntu atalina kyekubiira nti okuzza obuggya ebyo abantu bye beetwala okufuna mu birooto, mu kwolesebwa, n'ebirala, si kya bwereere era kya busirusiru kyokka mu bye birimu, wabula era kirina akabi akanene eri Abakristaayo abanafu. Weetegerezza bulungi nti 'Katonda mu kulabirira kwe takozesa ngeri za njawulo okutuukiriza ekyo ngeri za bulijjo kye zisobola okutuukiriza.' N'olwekyo ekigendererwa kyennyini kye bagamba nti okubikkulirwa kuno okupya kwe kuweerezeddwa olw'akyo, kiri gye ndi nga kye kimu ku bujulizi obusinga amaanyi obulaga nti si kwa mazima. Nga bwe ndaba, bagamba nti okwolesebwa kuno n'ebirala biweebwa okukakasa abantu abamu ku bubwe nti bafuuliddwa abaana ba Katonda era nti balokoleddwa. Naye ekigendererwa kino kyateekerwateekerwa dda mu bujjuvu mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, omuntu yenna mw'ayinza okusanga amateeka ge tuteekwa okugoberera mu bulamu buno ne ge tulisalirwako omusango oluvannyuma, nga gateereddwawo mu ngeri enyangu ddala, 'oyo adduka asobole okusoma'; era mu mateeka gano mwe tusaanidde okwekeberera, nga eyo y'engeri Katonda gye yalagira, n'olwekyo tuyinza okusuubira okulung'amya kwe n'obuyambi bwe mu kwekebera okwo. Era singa, nga twekeberedde n'obwegendereza embeera yaffe, tusanga nti mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna twegombye oba kaakano twegomba mu mazima era tufuba okutuukiriza obukwakkulizo bw'endagaano y'enjiri obutusabibwa ku ludda lwaffe, awo tuyinza okutegeera nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu yateeka mu mitima gyaffe omusingi omulungi ogw'essuubi ery'amaanyi, ery'amagezi era ennamu mu kusaasira kwa Katonda okuyita mu Kristo.

"Kuno kwe kukakasa kwe tusaanidde okuluubirira, omutume kw'ayita 'okukakasa okujjuvu okw'essuubi,' kw'atukubiriza 'okunywereza ddala okutuusa ku nkomerero.' Ate ekiva mu kuzzaamu amaanyi abantu ab'ebirowoozo ebitaliimu mu ngeri eno empya ey'okunoonya okukakasa (nga bwe bakola bonna abawuliriza emboozi zaabwe ez'obusirusiru nga tebabanenya), ndowooza tekiyinza kuba kirala okuggyako okubaggya mu kkubo lya Katonda ne babakyusiza mu kkubo lye beeyiiyiza bokka. Olaze bulungi nti ebyokulabirako by'omu Byawandiikibwa, era n'ekyawandiikibwa ekyo kyennyini kye bakozesa okwewolereza, tebituukiriza kigendererwa kyabwe, ne kiba nti tebalina buyinza bwonna obubawagira, obw'abantu oba obwa Katonda (nga bw'otegeezezza obulungi); n'olwekyo okukkiriza ebyo bye banyumya kuteekwa kwesigama ku bigambo byabwe byokka bye boogera, ebitajja kuzitowa nnyo eri ekitundu ky'abantu abeegendereza era abalina amagezi.

"Nnatandika okuwandiikira Charles nga sinnakuwandiikira omulundi oguwedde, naye saasobola kweyongerayo, kubanga ekyoto kyange kyanyookera nnyo ne kumpi mbe nfuuse muzibe w'amaaso, era ne mmala ekiseera kiwanvu nga kumpi siraba. Omukisa gwa Katonda ku ddagala ly'amaaso lye nneekolera gwamponya obulumi, naye obunafu bwasigalawo okumala ebbanga ddene. Okuva olwo, ntegeezeddwa nti Omwami Hall ateekateeka okusengula ab'omu maka ge okugenda mu London, era amaze okufuna ennyumba, nange nteekwa (Katonda bw'anaaganya mbeere mulamu) okugenda nabo, era eyo gye nsuubira okulaba Charles; awo nja kusobola okwogera mu bujjuvu ebirowoozo byange ku ndowooza zaabwe empya okusinga bwe nnyinza okukikola mu kuwandiika; n'olwekyo sijja kumaliriza bbaluwa yange gy'ali.

"Ndowooza owulidde nti Omwami Whitfield atambula mu bitundu bino ng'akuŋŋaanya ensimbi ez'okuzimba ennyumba e Georgia ey'abaana bamulekwa, n'abaana ba bannansi ab'eyo bazadde baabwe be banaakkiriza okuwaayo, bayige olulimi lwaffe n'eddiini yaffe. Yajja wano okundaba, ne twogera ku baganda bo. Nnamugamba nti saagala ngeri gye babeeramu, era nti nandyagadde babeere n'ekifo kyabwe ku bwabwe, mwe bandibuuliridde mu ngeri entegeke, n'ebirala. N'anziramu nti, 'Sisobola kuteebereza bulungi bwe bakola mu London; nti abasumba baffe abasinga obungi beebase, era nti tewabangawo kiseera bwetaavu bw'ababuulizi abatambula we bwasinga obunene nga kaakano'; awo omwami eyali azze naye n'agamba nti mwana wange Charles ye yamukyusa n'akomawo eri Katonda, era nti batabani bange bamala obudde bwabwe bwonna nga bakola birungi. Awo ne mbuuza Omwami Whitfield obanga batabani bange tebaagala kuleeta nkyukakyuka ezimu mu Kkanisa, ekintu kye nnali ntya ennyo. N'ankakasa nti baali wala nnyo ne kino, kubanga baali bafuba nga bwe basobola okuzza Abakontanya mu kussa kimu naffe; nti mwana wange John yali abatizza Abapresbyteri bataano abakulu mu ngeri yaffe ku Lunaku lwa Pawulo Omutukuvu, era, nga bw'alowooza, yandikomezzaawo bangi mu kussa kimu naffe. Yamala akaseera katono, ne kiba nti saasobola kwogera naye nga bwe nnali njagala. Alabika okuba omusajja omulungi ennyo, era ayagala mu mazima obulokozi bw'abantu. Katonda akkirize amagezi ag'emisota gagattibwe ku bataliiko kya kunenyezebwa ng'amayiba!

"Olupapula lwange n'amaaso gange kumpi biweddeyo, n'olwekyo njagala kwongerako kino kyokka nti nkuweereza ggwe n'ab'omu maka go okwagala kwange okw'omutima ogwo n'omukisa gwange. Mpeereza Mukyala Berry okulamusa kwange. Saafuna kakisa ka kuweereza bbaluwa eno okutuusa ku Lwomukaaga nga 13 ogw'omwezi oguwedde. Mpeereza Jacky Ellison okwagala n'omukisa. Nkwegayiridde mpandiikira mangu. Tugenda mu Apuli."

Kale obanga ab'omu maka ga Hall baagenda mu London mu kiseera ekyo okusukka okukyalayo akaseera akatono, tekimanyiddwa, era tewali kabonero konna kazuuliddwa akalaga nti Mukyala Wesley yali amanyi okugezesebwa muwala we kwe yayitamu, wadde engeri ey'ekimalayika gye yakugumiikirizaamu. Mu ttoggo lya mwaka ogwo gwe gumu, Mukyala Wesley yali nate e Tiverton ne mutabani we omukulu. Charles, eyali omuntu ow'omutima ogwerulidde, yamuwandiikira mu bujjuvu era nga taliiko ky'akweka ku kitangaala ekipya ekyali kimubaliddeko ye ne John, era nnyina n'amuddamu, nga tayagala kumuggwaamu maanyi, naye ng'yeewuunya nnyo ebirowoozo ebyo ebipya kye bitegeeza, n'gye bigenda: — "CHARLES, "nga 19 Okitobba 1738.

"Kinsanyusa nnyo okulaba nti omutima gwo gukkakkanyeeko okusinga edda, era nneebaza nnyo Katonda olw'ekyo. 'Omwoyo gw'omuntu gumuwanirira mu bulwadde, naye emmeeme eyennyise ani ayinza okugigumiikiriza?' Obanga eyo ye yabadde embeera yo, ddala ebadde ya nnaku nnyo. Naye Katonda atenderezebwe, eyakuwa okumanya obubi bw'ekibi, nga bwe bukontana n'obulongoofu bw'obutonde bwa Katonda n'obulungi obutuukirivu obw'amateeka ge. Katonda atenderezebwe, eyakulaga nti wali weetaaga Omulokozi okukununula mu buyinza bw'ekibi ne Setaani (kubanga Kristo talibeera Mulokozi eri abo abatalaba nti bamwetaaga), era n'akulung'amya okukwata mu kukkiriza okusaasira okwo okw'ekitalo kwe tuweereddwa olw'okwagala okununula. Yesu ye Musawo yekka ow'emmeeme; omusaayi gwe gwe ddagala lyokka eriyinza okuwonya omwoyo omulumiddwa.

"Obugagga, oba ekitiibwa, oba okwegomba kw'omubiri, tebisobola kuwummuza mwoyo ogwazitoowereddwa ennyo era ogwakooye omugugu gw'ekibi. Ebintu ebyo birina amaanyi okwongera ku musango gwaffe nga bitwawula emitima gyaffe ku Katonda; naye tebirina maanyi n'akamu okututabaganya naye, okutabaganya Katonda n'omuntu n'omuntu ne Katonda, n'okuzza obuggya okwegatta wakati w'obutonde bwa Katonda n'obw'omuntu.

"Nedda, tewali n'omu wabula Kristo, tewali n'omu wabula Kristo, asobola ebyo. Naye Katonda atenderezebwe, ye Mulokozi atuukiridde mu byonna; era erinnya lye ettukuvu litenderezebwe, olw'okuba omuzudde ng'Omulokozi wo, mwana wange! Ayi, tumwagale nnyo, kubanga tusonyiyiddwa bingi!

"Nandyagadde okumanya endowooza yo ku kukkiriza okuweesa obutuukirivu, kubanga okwogerako ng'ekintu kye wakafuna gye buvuddeko.

"SUSANNA WESLEY."

Ebbaluwa ey'okubiri, eraga nti Mukyala Wesley yali tannategeerera ddala nkyukakyuka mu ndowooza batabani be gye baali bayiseemu era gye baali bayigiriza abagoberezi baabwe, kirabika nayo yawandiikibwa ng'ali e Tiverton: — "CHARLES OMWAGALWA, "nga 6 Desemba 1738.

"Ndowooza oguddemu mu ngeri ey'okulowooza eyeewuunyisa. Ogamba nti okutuusa emyezi mitono egiyise wali tolina bulamu bwa mwoyo wadde okukkiriza okuweesa obutuukirivu.

"Kale, kino kiri ng'omuntu okugamba nti yali si mulamu mu buwere bwe, olw'okuba bwe yali omwana omuwere yali tamanyi nti mulamu. Kale kye nsobola okuggya mu bbaluwa yo kyokka kiri kino nti okutuusa akaseera akatono akayise wali tonnamatira nnyo nti oli Mukristaayo nga bw'omatidde kaakano. Nsanyuka nnyo olw'okuba kaakano ofunye essuubi ery'amaanyi era eddamu mu kusaasira kwa Katonda okuyita mu Kristo. Si nti nsobola kulowooza nti wali tolina n'akatono kukkiriza okulokola edda; naye kintu kimu okuba n'okukkiriza, ate kintu kirala okumanya nti tukulina. Okukkiriza kibala kya Mwoyo era kirabo kya Katonda; naye okuwulira oba okumanyira ddala munda nti tulina okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala, kyetaagisa omulimu omulala ogwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu wa Katonda. Ogamba nti olina emirembe, naye si ssanyu mu kukkiriza. Katonda atenderezebwe olw'emirembe! Emirembe egyo gibeere naawe. Essanyu lijja kugoberera, oboolyawo si mangu nnyo, naye lijja kugoberera okukkiriza n'okwagala. Ebisuubizo bya Katonda bissiddwako akabonero gye tuli naye tebiteereddwako nnaku, n'olwekyo lindirira n'obugumiikiriza ky'ayagala. Ajja kukuwa essanyu mu kukkiriza. Amiina.

"SUS. WESLEY."

Mukyala Wesley yali mukkakkamu okusinga mutabani we Samuel, kubanga Samuel yatya nnyo bwe yawulira amawulire ku kayengo ak'ekitalo ak'okusikirizibwa okwalumba emmeeme n'emibiri gy'abantu nga bawuliriza okubuulira kwa baganda be n'Omwami Whitfield; n'okugaana kw'abasumba okubakkiriza okubuulira ku kituuti kyabwe, n'okugaana kw'abalabirizi okubakkiriza okubuulira mu bitundu byabwe. Yategeeranga eddoboozi lya kabona ng'alangirira okusonyiyibwa kw'ebibi okuva mu kifo ekikkirizibwa obuyinza bw'Ekkanisa, naye n'atya enjigiriza eyo yennyini bwe yalangirirwanga ebweru wansi w'eggulu. Yalaba ng'ebisenge eby'okwekuumisa eby'Ekkanisa bimenyebwa era ng'enzigi z'amataba ag'okwawukana zigguddwawo. Oboolyawo eyo yali ndowooza y'abakulembeze b'eddiini y'Abaebbulaniya (Rabbi) emyaka lukumi mu lunaana egiyise, Omuyigiriza omuto atamanyiddwa bwe yayogera ebigambo ebyakankanya emitima gy'ebibiina ebyamwetoolooleranga ku lubalama lw'ennyanja oba ku lusozi. Tewali kikolwa ng'ekyo kyali kizuukusizza Bungereza mu biseera eby'edda; gwali mwoyo okwanukula omwoyo, abantu okuzuukuka okuva mu tulo otungi ennyo, okukwata okw'amaanyi okw'ekirabo ky'omwoyo okwafuula amagumba amakalu obulamu obujjudde amaanyi. Samuel Wesley, n'obulungi bwe bwonna, teyalina kirabo ky'okufukibwako omukka gwa Katonda okwo; naye nnyina, n'okutegeera kwe okw'ekikazi okusinga okugonda, yatandika okuwulira n'okutegeera okubudaabuda kwakwo okw'omwoyo. Oboolyawo "ennyombo z'abantu" zandyeyongedde nnyo mu maka, singa Mukama oyo, Samuel gwe yaweereza n'obwesigwa nga bwe yali ategeera, teyamuyita kugenda mu bwakabaka bw'emirembe n'okulaba obulungi. Mukyala Wesley yamuleka ng'ali bulungi ng'obulijjo e Tiverton, n'agenda mu London ku ntandikwa ya 1739, oboolyawo ng'awummudde e Salisbury ku kkubo. John yali ateekateeka okufuna awaka era ekifo eky'omulimu gwe mu kibuga ekikulu, era yayagala nnyina abeere eyo. Ab'omu maka ga Hall baali kumpi, Hetty yali e Soho, Anne e Hatfield, ne Kezzy, omwana we omuto ennyo, yali e Bexley, mwannyina John gye yali amuteeka mu maka g'omusumba (Vicar) Omwami Piers, mukwano gwe era omugoberezi we. Charles yali alwadde gye buvuddeko, era Kezzy, newaakubadde nga naye yali munafu, yamujjanjaba n'obwegendereza bungi. Kirabika nnyina yasanyukira omukisa ogw'okubeera okumpi n'abo bonna, era yalaba Foundry ng'ekifo eky'okuwummuliramu mu bukadde bwe. Ddala kyalabika ng'ekirina essuubi, era nga kyandibadde kifo kirungi eky'okubeeramu, ekirimu empewo ennungi era eky'obulamu.

Moorfields lyali lusuku lw'abantu bonna mu kiseera ekyo, nga lirimu emiti emikadde emirungi egy'emivule (elm), ebifo ebigazi eby'omuddo omubisi n'amakubo amagazi ag'oluyinjayinja, abakulembeze b'ekibuga mwe baawummuliranga ne beesanyusizanga n'ab'omu maka gaabwe nga bamaze emirimu. Okumpi n'ekifo kino ekigazi waaliwo Windmill Hill, ku ludda lwalwo olw'ebuvanjuba nga kuliko ennyumba eyali ekutusekutuse eyabikkibwako amategula, Gavumenti ezaddiriŋŋana mwe zaasaanuuliranga emizinga egyasooka emikulu egyakozesebwa amagye gaffe. Naye mu 1716, bwe baali basaanuula buggya emizinga gy'Abafalansa egyanyagibwa mu ntalo za Marlborough ezaawangula, ne wabaawo okubwatuka okw'entiisa, okwafuumuula akasolya, ne kumenya ebisenge, ne kutta n'okulemaza bangi ku bakozi. Kyalabibwa nti ekintu eky'akabi bwe kityo tekisaanidde kubeera wakati mu London, era okuva olwo emizinga ne gisaanuulirwanga e Woolwich, ekkolero eddala (foundry) ne lirekebwa nga matongo. Ku maaso waaliwo yaadi nga 40, ate obuwanvu bw'ettaka kwe lyali nga yaadi 33. Ekifo n'ennyumba byagulibwa pawundi 115, era ennyumba bwe yamala okukyusibwa, okuddaabirizibwa n'okutegekebwa olw'emirimu gyayo emipya, yamalawo pawundi nga 650 endala. John Wesley teyalina nsimbi ndala okuggyako ezo ze yafunanga mu kifo kye eky'obu-Fellow e Oxford, naye mikwano gye ne bamuwola era ne bawaayo ensimbi, newaakubadde ng'omuwendo gwonna gwalwawo nnyo okuggwayo. Waaliwo ekkanisa etali nnungi nga erimu emmeeza ez'okutuulako, ekituuti ekitali kinyirire ekyakolebwa mu bwangu n'embaawo, ennyumba ey'okusuzaamu ababuulizi abatali basumba abaawule n'abaweereza omu oba babiri, ekisenge ekitono eky'amagaali n'ekiraalo ky'embalaasi, era waggulu w'ekisenge ky'obubinja (band room) waaliwo ebisenge bya John Wesley, gye yaleeta nnyina n'amufuula nnannyini maka.

Wano yasobola okwogera ku bintu bingi ne mutabani we, atubuulira nti okutuusa akaseera katono ng'ebyo tebinnabaawo yagamba nti "yali kumpi tawulirangako kintu ng'ekyo nga kyogerwako, Omwoyo wa Katonda okukakasiza wamu n'omwoyo waffe: wadde okulowooza nti kino kye kirabo kya bulijjo eky'abakkiriza bonna aba nnamaddala. 'N'olwekyo,' bwe yagamba, 'saagumanga kukisaba ku lwange. Naye wiiki bbiri oba ssatu eziyise, mwana wange Hall bwe yali ayogera ebigambo bino ng'ampa ekikopo, "Omusaayi gwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, ogwaweebwayo ku lulwo," ebigambo byafumita omutima gwange, ne mmanya nti Katonda ku lwa Kristo yali ansonyiye ebibi byange byonna.' Ne mmubuuza obanga kitaawe (Dr. Annesley) teyalina kukkiriza kwe kumu kuno; era obanga teyamuwulira ng'akubuulira abalala. N'addamu nti yali nakwo ye kennyini; era n'ayogera nga waakayita akaseera katono afe, nti okumala emyaka egisoba mu 40, teyalina kizikiza, wadde okutya, wadde okubuusabuusa n'akatono nti yakkirizibwa mu Mwagalwa. Naye nti, wadde kyali kityo, yali tajjukira kumuwulira ng'abuulira, nedda, wadde omulundi gumu, mu bulambulukufu ku nsonga eyo; n'olwekyo yalowooza nti naye yakitwala ng'omukisa ogw'enjawulo ogw'abantu abatono; so si nga kisuubiza eri abantu ba Katonda bonna."

Bw'atyo Mukyala Wesley n'asendebwa okukkiriza endowooza za mutabani we John, ekintu ekyanakuwaza ennyo Samuel, eyawandiika mu makkati ga Okitobba 1739: — "John ne Charles kaakano bafuuse bamanyifu nnyo, ne kiba nti ensi ejja kwagala okumanya ddi era wa gye baazaalibwa, mu masomero ki gye baakulira, mu matendekero ki ag'e Oxford gye baasomera, era ddi lwe baawandiisibwa, diguli ki ze baafuna, era wa, ddi, era ani eyabaawula; bitabo ki bye baawandiika oba bye baafulumya. Nandyagadde basobole okusiima okutuwaayo obudde obumala okutubuulirako ku byafaayo byabwe. Nze ku lwange, nandisinze okwagala okubalaba nga bakuŋŋaanya obusubi munda w'ebisenge, okusinga okubuulira mu kibangirizi kya Moorfields.

"Nnawulira n'okweraliikirira okw'amaanyi n'ennaku nti wawagira obulimba obubuna, okutuuka n'okufuuka omu ku kibiina kya Jack. Tekimala nti mpeddwako baganda bange bombi, naye ne mmange naye agoberere? Nsaba nnyo Omuyinza w'Ebintu Byonna akukuume oleme kwegatta ku kwawukana ku nkomerero y'obulamu bwo, nga bwe weegatta ku kumu ku ntandikwa yaabwo eky'omukisa omubi. Kijja kukwetaagisa okwekalakaasa emirundi mingi, bw'onoosigala ng'oli mwesigwa, nga bwe nsuubira eri Katonda nti ojja kusigala. Baakwewaana dda ng'omuyigirizwa waabwe. Charles yagambye Joe Bentham nti nze sikontana nnyo nabo, singa tutegeeragana. Ntya nti nja kuwalirizibwa okukirangirira mu lwatu, okutegeera kwabwe oba okusaasira kwabwe bwe kuli bwe kutyo. Naye bagenderera okwawukana. Ebintu bijja kugenda nga bwe bisaanidde okugenda, okuggyako nga Katonda mu kulabirira kwe ayingiddewo mu ngeri ey'enjawulo. Kaakano baagaanibwa dda okubuulira ku bituuti byonna mu London, era okubuulira mu bitundu by'omulabirizi oyo kwe kwawukana ddala. Kirabika kijja kubeera bwe kityo mu Bungereza yonna, singa abalabirizi banaaba n'obuvumu obumala. Balekayo okusaba okw'Ekitabo ky'Okusaba mu nnimiro; newaakubadde nga Omwami Whitfield ayogera nti akitwala nga kya muwendo, tasomangako n'omulundi gumu eri abantu be abambadde enziina ku ttale. Ebibiina byabwe bisobola okusaanyaawo ebibiina ebirala byonna okuggyako ebyabwe. Waliwo omuntu yenna alina amagezi aga bulijjo, oba omwoyo, ayinza okukkiriza omuweereza we yenna okwesiba mu ndagaano ey'okubuulira abantu bataano oba kkumi buli kimu awatali kukweka, ekikwata ku mwoyo gw'omuntu oyo omutegeeza, ne bwe kiba nga kikwata nnyo ku maka? Kisaanidde omuntu yenna ali mu bufumbo okubeera eyo, okuggyako nga omwami ne mukyala we bali eyo bombi? Kino kwe kwawukanya ddala abo 'Katonda be yagatta awamu.' Nga bwe nnagamba Jack, sitya nti Ekkanisa ejja kumugoba mu kussa kimu, kubanga empisa z'Ekkanisa ziri wansi nnyo, wabula ntya nti ye ajja kugoba Ekkanisa. Kumpi kituuse awo; obutukuvu n'ebikolwa ebirungi tebikyali na bukwakkulizo bwa kukkirizibwa kwaffe eri Katonda. Embaga ez'okwagala zitandikiddwawo, n'okusaba okutategekeddwa n'okunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa, ekyo ekisembayo kimala okuleeta okutabuka kwonna; era tekirabika nga bajja kubulwa byamagero okubawagira. Oyo yekka akkakkanya okwegugunga kw'amawanga y'asobola okubaziyiza obutafuuka kibiina kyawukanye ku bwakyo mu bbanga ttono nnyo.

"Ebibonerezo by'Ekkanisa biweddemu okutiisa kwabyo, olw'obusamize mu by'eddiini ku ludda olumu, n'obutakkiriza Katonda ku ludda olulala. N'olwekyo, okwogera ku kuyigganyizibwa okuva ku ludda olwo, kuba kuvuma bwereere. Kiri — .

'Okuyita omulabirizi omukadde ow'ekirevu ekiruddu, N'okufuula obuyinza bwe ekintu ekitaliimu, Nga Dagoni emikono gye bwe gyakutukako.' * * * * "Mwannyinaze Hall ampandiikidde ku nsonga eno, era nja kumuddamu amangu ddala nga bwe nnaasobola. Mu kiseera kino nja kusanyuka okuwulira okuva gy'oli, era nkwegayiridde otuwe omukisa gwo ffe n'ab'omu maka gaffe, n'okutusabira tulung'amizibwe bulungi mu bulamu bwaffe obusigaddeyo obw'obulumi, era tutuuke olw'okusaasira kwa Kristo mu ssanyu ery'olubeerera.

"Ndi, Maama omwagalwa, "Mutabani wo omuwulize era akwagala, "SAMUEL WESLEY."

Ebbaluwa eno empanvu eteekwa okuba nga yali emu ku bbaluwa ezisembayo Samuel Wesley ze yawandiika. Yali talina bulamu bulungi nnyo, naye yalowooza nti "yali atereera." Nga 5 Novemba yagenda okwebaka ng'obulamu bwe buli bulungi ekigero, naye n'alwala ku ssaawa mwenda ez'ekiro (3 o'clock ez'oku makya), n'afa oluvannyuma lw'okubonaabona okumala essaawa nnya, ku myaka 49.

Nga tetunnasiibula Samuel Wesley, kisaanidde okwogera nti eddwaliro lya St. George's Hospital, eriri kumpi okwolekera Apsley House, libaddewo ku lulwe. Lyasooka kuba ddwaliro (infirmary), erisooka mu Westminster, era lyatandikibwawo mu 1719, okusinga olw'okufuba kwe okutakoowa. Bwe kityo Hyde Park Corner kiwa obujulirwa ku buwanguzi bw'abooluganda babiri, omu ku bo yali mukugu mu by'entalo, ate omulala mu by'emirembe.

fields.title: Emyaka Egyasembayo
fields.body_html:
AMAWULIRE g'okufa kwa Samuel Wesley gaaweerezebwa mukwano gw'amaka era muliraanwa eri Charles, eyali e Bristol mu kiseera ekyo, era kirabika ne John eyali ku Foundry naye yagategeezebwa. John yali yeesongolwanga emirundi mingi ab'eŋŋanda ze olw'okusirikira ensonga z'amaka, era kirabika yasitula okugenda okusisinkana Charles balyoke bagende wamu e Tiverton okulaba muka mwannyinaabwe eyali afuuse nnamwandu, nga tannategeeza nnyina, eyali omulwadde mu kisenge kye, amawulire ago ag'ennaku. Oboolyawo yali tasobola kufuna mutima gwa kubimubuulira, kubanga ab'omu maka bonna baali bamanyi nnyo engeri gye yali ayagalamu omwana we omubereberye, n'engeri gye yali amubeeredde omwana ow'ekyokulabirako. Oboolyawo yalagira omu ku bannyina amubuulire mpolampola. Engeri gye yakigumiikirizaamu yennyini yagitegeeza Charles: — " CHARLES OMWAGALWA, " nga 29 Novemba 1739.

" Bwe nnawulira omulundi ogusooka okufa kwa mwannyoko, amangu ago nnakkiriza by'ayagala Katonda, nga sirina kwekandagga na kutono. Kyokka nneewuunya Jacky okuba nga teyantegeeza nga tannagenda, kubanga yali akimanyi; naye yali tamanyi ngeri Katonda gy'ankolamu mu mbeera ez'enjawulo, ekitali kya kwewuunya; kubanga newaakubadde nga emirundi mingi nnalaba okusaasira kwe n'amaanyi ge ebitaliiko kkomo nga bimpanirira, n'emirembe mu mwoyo wange munda ng'okugezesebwa kwandinsingidde amaanyi, naye engeri ze ez'okukola nange zennyini sisobola kuzitegeera wadde okuziyogera. Mwannyoko yali wa muwendo nnyo gye ndi mu bulamu buno, era oboolyawo nnasobya okumwagala ennyo okusukkiridde. Edda nnalowooza nti sisobola kugumiikiriza kumufiirwa, naye tewali amanya ky'asobola kugumiikiriza okutuusa ng'agezesebwa. Nga jjajjammwe omulungi omukadde bwe yayogeranga nti, ' Ekyo kye kibonoobono Katonda ky'afuula ekibonoobono.' Mazima okulabisibwa kw'okubeerawo kwe n'ekisa kye kusinga obulungi okuwanirira omuntu mu kubonaabona kwonna kwonna. Bw'aziyiza okubudaabuda kwe, n'atukweka amaaso ge, okubonaabona okutono ennyo tekugumiikirizika. Naye atenderezebwe era asinzibwe erinnya lye ettukuvu, tekyabadde bwe kityo gye ndi, newaakubadde nga sisaanira n'akatono ku kusaasira kwe kwonna. Nsanyuka okuba n'essuubi eddungi ery'obulokozi bw'omwana wange omwagalwa. Kaakano ali mu kiwummulo, era teyandyagadde kudda ku nsi wadde okufuna ensi yonna. Kale lwaki nkungubaga? Atuuse ku mwalo nga sinnatuuka, naye nange nja kumugoberera mangu. Talikomawo gye ndi, naye nze ndigenda gy'ali, tuleme kwawukana nate.

" Nkwebaza okufaayo ku nsonga zange ez'omu bulamu buno. Kyali kya buzaaliranwa okulowooza nti nnandinakuwadde olw'okufa kw'omwana wange omwagalwa ku nsonga eyo, kubanga ekitundu ekinene bwe kityo eky'obuyambi bwange kyasaliddwako. Naye okwogera amazima, sibangako na kirowoozo kimu ekyeraliikirivu ku nsonga ng'ezo; kubanga amangu ago kyanzijira mu mutima nti Katonda, mu kufiirwa omwana wange, yali ampita okwesigama ku ye yekka n'obunywevu obusingawo; nti newaakubadde ng'omwana wange yali mulungi, teyali Katonda wange; era nti kaakano Kitaffe ow'omu ggulu yali alabika ng'akutte ensonga yange mu mukono gwe yennyini mu ngeri esingako; n'olwekyo, ne bwe kyali nga tewali ssuubi, nnakkiriza mu ssuubi nti sigenda kubonaabona nate.

" Siyinza kuwandiika bingi, kubanga ndi munafu. Kati wayise wiiki ezisoba mu 10 nga sikka wansi, newaakubadde nga ndi bulungiko okusinga bwe nnali gye buvuddeko. Nkwegayiridde, tuusa okwagala kwange n'omukisa gwange eri muwala wange ne Philly. Nsaba Katonda amuwanirire era amugabirire.

" SUSANNA WESLEY."

Nga wayise omwezi nga gumu, yawandiika nate, oboolyawo ng'addamu ebbaluwa ya Charles, eyali abeera e Bristol ng'ekitebe kye: — "Foundry, nga 27 Desemba 1739. "CHARLES OMWAGALWA, " Toyinza kwegomba kundaba okusinga nze bwe nneegomba okukulaba. Mwannyoko, gwe nja okuyitanga okuva kati Omwana Wesley, okuva Sam wange omwagalwa bw'agenze ewaka, yakamala okubeera nange era yazzaamu nnyo omwoyo gwange amaanyi. Mazima, emirundi mingi nkizudde nti tayogera nga ndi wakati mu kumuwulira nga sifunyeemu mugaso gwa mwoyo. Naye okukyala kwe kwa wano na wali era kwa kaseera katono, era ekyo sikimunenyeza n'akatono, kubanga mmanyi nti akola omulimu omulungi, era, Katonda atenderezebwe, aweza nnyo mu buweereza bwe. Naye, Charles wange omwagalwa, nkyabeetaaga, ye oba ggwe; kubanga mazima, mu makulu gennyini, nfuuse omwana omuto era nneetaaga obuyambi obutasalako. ' Ng'ekyuma bwe kiwagala ekyuma, n'omuntu bw'abangula muntu munne.' Nfuna nnyo okubudaabudibwa n'okuwanirirwa mu kwogera ku by'eddiini bwe mba nkifunye. Edda nnasanyukanga obutabaako bantu, era nnakizuula nti gye nnakoma okufuna ebinyumu by'ebitonde ebitono, gye nnakoma okufuna ebingi okuva eri Katonda. Naye, zinsanze! Nseeredde okuva mu kukolagana okw'omwoyo kwe nnalina edda.

Era lwaki kiri bwe kityo? Kubanga mbulwa okukkiriza. Katonda ali buli wamu, Katonda atakyukakyuka newaakubadde okwefuula ekirala; ensobi eri mu nze, era nsiba ensobi zonna mu kusalawo n'ensobi zonna mu bikolwa ku kubulwa okukkiriza mu Yesu atenderezebwa. Owange omwagalwa, bwe ndowooza ku kitiibwa ky'obuntu bwe, obutuukirivu bw'obulongoofu bwe, obunene bw'okubonaabona kwe, naye okusinga byonna okwagala kwe okutaliiko kkomo, nneewuunya era nzibuwalirwa ddala; mbula mu birowoozo. Nfuuka busa mu maaso ge! Owange, omuntu amanyi ebintu bino naye n'asigala nga mwavu era wa wansi mu kukkiriza ne mu kwagala, talina kyakwekwasa nnyo! Njogera ng'omuntu omusango ogwo gw'agwako. Bampingamizza obutamaliriza bbaluwa yange. Nneemulugunya nti sirina muntu wa kwogera naye ku by'omwoyo, naye ennaku zino ntono ezisembyeyo mbadde n'okunyumya n'Abakristaayo abalungi bangi, abazzizzaamu amaanyi omwoyo gwange ogwali guzirika; era newaakubadde nga bampingamizza okuwandiika, okuyingirira kwe bampa kwali kwa ssanyu, era nsuubira nti tekwali kwa bwereere. Nsuubira nti mu bbanga ttono tujja kwogeraganya nga tulabagana amaaso n'amaaso; era olwo, Katonda bw'alikkiriza, ndikutegeeza ebirowoozo byange mu bujjuvu. Naye olwo, zinsanze! bw'onojja, mwannyoko anvaako. Kyokka ekyo Katonda by'ayagala, gw'oweereza mu buweereza bwe obutenderezebwa, eyakawa emirimu gyammwe omukisa okutuusa kati, era eyabakuuma mmwembi. Nti asigale ng'ayongera okuwa omulimu gwammwe okugenda mu maaso, n'abakuuma mmwembi okuva mu bubi, n'abawa amaanyi n'obuvumu okubuulira enjiri ey'amazima nga mwolekedde okusaba okw'omukago okw'abantu ababi ne bamalayika ababi, kye kusaba kw'omutima okwa, Charles omwagalwa, " Maama wo akwagala, " SUSANNA WESLEY."

Mu kiseera kino Emilia Wesley, eyali amaze emyaka mitono ng'afumbirwa Omwami Harper, eyali omusawo w'eddagala e Epworth edda era eyali omwavu ennyo okusukkiridde, yafuuka nnamwandu, n'ava e Gainsborough, n'ajja n'omuweereza we omwesigwa gwe yali ayagala ennyo okubeera ne nnyina ku Foundry.

Kirabika nga era mu kiseera kino kyennyini Mukyala Wesley mwe yawa obujulirwa bwe, waakiri mu nsonga emu, ng'awagira okubuulira kw'abantu abatali basumba abaawule. Omulimu gwa John Wesley gwali gwa mubuulizi w'enjiri era omutegesi, nga ekigo kye ye nsi yonna; yatambulanga ku mbalaasi okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala ng'anyweza ekkanisa, era kyali kyetaagisa omuntu omu okulekebwa ng'akulira ku Foundry. Eyalondebwa ye Omwami Thomas Maxfield, " omuvubuka ow'amagezi amalungi era atya Katonda." Emirimu gye gyali gya kusisinkana ebibinja n'obubinja, n'okusoma n'okunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa. Okuva awo okutuuka ku kubuulira ekibuulirwa yali ddaala limu lyokka, era mangu ddala n'akikola, ng'ayogera n'obunyiikivu bungi n'obwogezi obulungi. John Wesley yatabukira nnyo bwe yakiwulira, n'addayo awaka mangu. Nnyina n'alaba nti waliwo ekitali kirungi, n'amubuuza kye kiri. " Ndaba Thomas Maxfield afuuse mubuulizi," kwe kwali okuddamu okumpi okw'omusajja eyalina okwegomba okw'obuzaaliranwa okubeera omukulu era owookubiri tewali mu buli kye yakolanga. Mukyala Wesley mangu n'amutegeeza endowooza ye ku nsonga eyo: — " John, omanyi endowooza zange bwe zibadde. Toyinza kunteebereza nti nnyanguwa okuwagira ekintu kyonna eky'engeri eno. Naye weegendereze ky'okola ku muvubuka oyo; kubanga mazima ddala Katonda amuyise okubuulira nga bwe yakuyita ggwe. Weekenneenye ebibala by'okubuulira kwe bye bibadde, era omuwulire ggwe kennyini." Ebigambo bya nnyina byalina obuzito, era Maxfield n'abuulira mu maaso ga mukama we. "Ye Mukama," John Wesley bwe yaleekaana, " akole nga bw'asiima. Nze ani eyandiwakanyizza Katonda?"

Bwe kityo omusumba eyatikkirwa obwakabona, eyali anyweredde ddala ku nkizo z'obwakabona, omuyivu era " Fellow wa Lincoln " n'aleetebwa okukkiriza okubuulira kw'abantu abatali basumba abaawule, okwali kugenda okufuuka ekitundu ekikulu mu kibiina ky'Abametodisiti kye yatandikawo. Kiteeberezebwa nti Mukyala Wesley yafaayo nnyo ku bakazi abaayingira mu bibinja ku Foundry ne bajjanga eyo okuyigirizibwa n'okuweebwa amagezi. Kyandibadde kya buzaaliranwa okukikola ng'ali bulungi mu mubiri.

Kyali kya mpisa y'omunyiikivu omuvubuka nga Charles Wesley okulowooza nti endowooza za nnyina ku nteekateeka y'obulokozi zaali tezimala, n'agezaako okuzitereeza mu bbaluwa empanvu. Nnyina teyakoma ku kukkiriza n'obuwombeefu bungi bye yali ayogera, wabula yabiteeka ku mutima; era okuddamu kwe okw'obuwombeefu naye okw'ekitiibwa ye bbaluwa esembayo emanyiddwa gye yawandiika: — "CHARLES OMWAGALWA, "Foundry, nga 2 Okitobba 1740.

" Nneegatta naawe n'omutima gwange gwonna okwebaza Katonda olw'okuwona kwo. Alina ensonga nnyingi ez'amagezi ku buli kiguddewo mu nteekateeka ye, ezisukkulumye ennyo ku kutegeera kwaffe, era sibuusabuusa nti okukuzzaamu obulamu ku kigero ekimu kujja kutuukiriza ebigendererwa bingi by'otonnamanya.

"Nkwebaza olw'ebbaluwa yo ey'ekisa; ngiyita bwe ntyo, kubanga nzikiriza ddala nti yaluŋŋamizibwa okwegomba okw'amazima okw'obulungi bwange obw'omwoyo n'obw'emirembe n'emirembe. Waliwo amazima mangi nnyo mu bingi by'onvunaana: era sigenderera kwogera kigambo na kimu kwewolereza, wabula nsalawo okutwala ebintu byonna eri Oyo ategeera ebintu byonna. Kino kye nteekwa okukugamba: osobezzaamu katono ku mbeera yange. Zinsanze! embeera yange mbi nnyo okusinga bw'ogiteebereza! Siri omu ku abo abatafunangako kitangaala, oba abatalegangako ku birungi eby'omu ggulu, oba ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu, wabula emyaka mingi emabega nnazuukusibwa ddala, era mmanyi nnyo ekibi, ekyo ekyasikira n'ekyo kye nkoze. Embeera yange efaanana bulungi n'ey'Ekkanisa ey'omu Efeso; sibadde mwesigwa eri ettalanta ezaateekebwa mu mikono gyange, era sikyamwagala nga bwe nnamwagalanga edda. ' Naye wakyaliwo essuubi eri Isirayiri ku nsonga eno?' Siggwamu ssuubi, era olw'ekisa kya Katonda siriggwamu ssuubi; kubanga okuva lwe nnakyama mu ngeri ey'ennaku, bwe nnali kumpi okubulwa essuubi, bwe nnali nga nneerabidde Katonda, kyokka nnakizuula nti ye teyali anneerabidde. Ne mu kiseera ekyo yateeka mu mwoyo gwange, ng'ayita mu Mwoyo we, ebirungi by'okutangirira okukulu, bwe yaŋŋamba nti Kristo yandiferera. Katonda ow'amazima, Omulokozi Omuyinzawaabyonna, alimbuulira nti nnina omugabo mu musaayi gwe ne mu butuukirivu bwe, nze ne simukkiriza? Kikafuuwe! Nzikiriza, era nja kukkiriza; era newaakubadde nga nze mwonoonyi asinga bonna, ekyo tekimmalamu maanyi; kubanga ebisobyo byange byonna bibi bya muntu alina ekkomo, naye ebirungi by'okubonaabona kwa Mukama waffe n'obutuukirivu bwe tebiriiko kkomo! Bwe mba nga mbulwa ekintu kyonna kye siyinza kulokolebwa nga sikirina (kye simanyi kati), kale nzikiriza nti sijja kufa nga obwetaavu obwo tebunnamalibwawo. Obuuza ebibuuzo bingi bye saagala kuddamu; naye nkujjukiza Mukama waffe omwagalwa, alikumatiza mu bintu byonna bye kikwetaagisa okumanya. Sisobola kutegeera lwaki ogamba nti toli Mukristaayo, ekiri ng'okugamba Kristo mu maaso ge nti tolina ky'omwebaza, okuva bw'otali mulungi okusingawo olw'ekintu kyonna ky'akoze oba ky'abonyeebonye ku lulwo. Owange! obwo nga bunyoomi bungi, nga butasiima bwewuunyisa, eri Yesu atenderezebwa emirembe gyonna? Ndowooza nti ndi wala nnyo okuba Omukristaayo omulungi nga ggwe, oba nga bwe nnandibadde; naye Katonda aleme kunzikiriza kwegaana bukristaayo butono bwe nnina; wabula ka nneeyongere okukula mu kisa ne mu kutegeera Mukama waffe era Omulokozi waffe Yesu Kristo. Amiina. Simanyi ndowooza ki endala abantu gye bayinza okuba nayo ku butonde bw'omuntu, naye nze ku lwange ndowooza nti awatali kisa kya Katonda tetusobola n'akatono kulowooza, kwogera, wadde okukola ekirungi kyonna: n'olwekyo, bwe tuba nga mu kitundu kyonna eky'obulamu bwaffe tuweereddwa amaanyi okukola ekirungi kyonna, tusaanidde okuwa Katonda ekitiibwa. Bwe tuba nga tetukozesezza bulungi ttalanta ze twaweebwa, ensobi yaffe. Nkizudde nti eno ngeri ya kwogera ekozesebwa nnyo mu bantu bano, ennyiizizza nnyo; era emirundi mingi nneegomba boogere kitono ku bo bennyini n'ebingi ku Katonda. Emirundi mingi mpulira okwemulugunya okw'eddoboozi ery'omwanguka ku kibi, n'ebirala, naye tebatera, tebatera n'akatono, kwogera kigambo kya kutendereza na kwebaza Mukama waffe omwagalwa, wadde okukkiriza obutaliiko kkomo bwe . . ."

Ebigambo ebyasigalawo byabula, era okuva bwe kirabika nga byali bikwata ku ngeri y'abantu abajjanga ku Foundry ne mu nkuŋŋaana zaayo, kya nnaku nnyo.

Nga wayise emyezi nga 6 oluvannyuma lw'ebbaluwa eno okuwandiikibwa, ku ntandikwa ya Maaki 1741, Kezia Wesley yafiira e Bexley ng'aweza emyaka 32. Kiteeberezebwa nti teyawonera ddala ku kukankana kwe yafuna bwe yazuula nti Wesley Hall yali azannyirira okwagala kwe okw'obuvubuka ng'omuzannyo bwereere, so ng'ate yali yeeyamye eri mwannyina Martha. Ye yali asembayo obuto, eyazaalibwa nnyina ng'amaze okuyita mu kugezesebwa okw'entiisa n'akabi ak'omuliro ogw'e Epworth. Naye kennyini yali agumiikirizza okubulwa ebintu bingi mu buvubuka bwe, ebyo byonna nga biyamba okunnyonnyola obunafu bw'omubiri gwe; naye emitima nagyo girina kye gitegeeza mu bulamu bw'abakazi, era okwagala okutaliimu ssanyu kutera okuleeta obutaba na maanyi ga kudda engulu mu mubiri, naddala mu muntu atalina nkolagana nnywevu nnyo emusiba ku bulamu. Kirabika Charles yaliwo mwannyina bwe yafa, era yamatira olw'embeera y'ebirowoozo bye n'ey'omwoyo gwe.

Obulwadde bwokka obw'enjawulo Mukyala Wesley bwe yalwalanga bwali gout, era ye yabusikira mu lulyo. Mazima tebwava ku kulya bulungi n'okwejalabya ku lulwe. Amaanyi g'obulamu ne gagenda nga gaggwaawo mpolampola, era bawala be bonna abaali basigaddewo ne bakuŋŋaana okwetooloola nnyaabwe. Yasaba nnyo Anne aleme kumuvaako nate bwe yandibadde n'amaanyi okusigalawo. Charles yawalirizibwa okugenda, ng'alowooza nti nnyina ayinza okulwawo okutuusa lw'alikomawo; John yali e Bristol, era bwe yawulira nti amaanyi ge gaali gaggwaawo mangu, n'asitula ku mbalaasi ku Ssande akawungeezi, nga 18 Julaayi 1742, ng'amaze okubuulira ekibiina ekinene. Yatuuka ku Foundry nga 20, era bwe yamala okumulaba, n'awandiika mu kitabo kye eky'ebyafaayo by'olunaku nti, "Nnasanga maama wange ku nsalo y'obulamu obutaggwaawo; naye talina kubuusabuusa wadde okutya, wadde okwegomba okulala kwonna, okuggyako, Katonda bw'anaamala okumuyita, okuva mu bulamu buno agende abeere ne Kristo."

Ku Lwokutaano olwaddirira akawungeezi yalaba nti enkomerero yali eri kumpi nnyo: yali takyayogera, naye ng'akyategeera; awo n'asoma okusaba okw'okukwasa omwoyo Katonda, nga bwe yakola emyaka 7 emabega ku lwa kitaawe. Zaali ssaawa kkumi ez'olweggulo (4 o'clock), era olw'okukoowa okutunula n'okuwulira ennyo mu mutima, n'ava ku mabbali ge akaseera katono " okunywa ekikopo ky'ecaayi." Omu ku bannyina n'amuyita akomewo. " Yazibula amaaso ge nnyo," bw'ayogera, "n'agatunuuliza waggulu akaseera katono. Awo ebikowe ne bikka, omwoyo ne guteebwa, awatali kulwanagana na kumu, wadde okusinda, wadde okussa ekikkowe. Twayimirira okwetooloola ekitanda, ne tutuukiriza okusaba kwe okusembayo, kwe yayogera nga tannaba kusirika, ' Abaana, nga nnaakasumululwa, muyimbe zabbuli ey'okutendereza Katonda.'"

Kyagwa ku Mukyala Lambert okuwandiikira Charles ebyabaawo byonna mu nnaku za nnyina ezisembayo, era n'ayogera nti:

" Yabonaabona nnyo n'okugezesebwa okunene, mu mwoyo ne mu mubiri, okumala ennaku ntono nga omaze okumuvaako; naye Katonda yatuukiriza omulimu gwe mu ye nga wabulayo essaawa nga 12 amutwale gy'ali. Yazuukuka okuva mu tulo, era ffe, bwe twamuwulira ng'asanyuka, ne tussaayo omwoyo ku bigambo bye yayogera, bino, ' Omulokozi wange omwagalwa! ozze okunnyamba mu buzibu bwange obusembayo ku nkomerero?' Okuva mu kiseera ekyo yewaayo ddala n'emirembe; omulabe teyalina maanyi nate kumukolako kabi. Ekiseera kye ekyasigalawo kyonna yakimalira mu kutendereza."

Mukyala Wesley yaziikibwa ku Ssande, nga 1 Agusito, mu Bunhill Fields, John ng'asoma okusaba okw'okuziika okw'Ekkanisa ya Bungereza, nga Emilia, Susanna, Hetty, Anne ne Martha bayimiridde okwetooloola. Mikwano gye mingi nnyo gyali gikuŋŋaanye, awamu n'abalala abaaleetebwa awamu olw'okwagala okumanya n'okusaasira. Awo ne bayimba oluyimba, era John Wesley, eyali, mu kiseera eky'amaanyi g'obuvubuka bwe, yeegomba nnyo obutawangaala kusinga nnyina, n'ayimirira ku ntaana ya nnyina oyo n'abuulira ekibiina ekikuŋŋaanye ekimu ku bibuulirwa bye ebisinga obwogezi n'okujjula ennyiriri z'omutima.

Mangu ddala ejjinja eryangu lyasimbibwa ku mutwe gw'ekifo ekyo eky'okuwummuliramu ekisembayo, nga liriko ebigambo eby'ekijjukizo mu nnyiriri z'oluyimba ebyawandiikibwa Charles Wesley: — " Wano we wagalamidde Omubiri gwa MUKYALA SUSANNA WESLEY, Muwala asembayo obuto era eyasembayo okusigala nga mulamu owa Dr. Samuel Annesley."

" Mu ssuubi ekkakafu era ennywevu ery'okuzuukira, N'okutwala ennyumba ye mu bire waggulu, Omukristaayo wano yassa wansi omubiri gwe, Omusaalaba n'aguwaanyisaamu engule.

Muwala ow'amazima ow'okubonaabona, ye, Eyamanyiira obulumi n'ennaku, Yakungubaga mu kiro ekiwanvu eky'ennaku n'okutya, Ekiro eky'amateeka eky'emyaka 70. Awo Kitaffe n'abikkulira Omwana we, N'amumanyisa mu mugaati ogumenyeddwa; Yamanya era n'awulira ebibi bye nga bisonyiyiddwa, N'afuna omusingo gw'eggulu lye. Ng'asaanidde okussa ekimu eky'eggulu, Yawulira okuyitibwa nti ' Golokoka, Owoomukwano.' Nzija, amaaso ge ag'okufa ne gaddamu, Era ng'omwana gw'endiga, nga Mukama we, n'afa."

Kyali kya kwewuunya nti John, eyali atera okufaayo ennyo ku buli kantu, teyamwogera ku kitaawe ku jjinja lino ery'oku ntaana, wadde okuteekako olunaku nnyina lwe yazaalibwa oba lwe yafa. Naye yeemalira mu kukolesa ekifaananyi ekyasalibwa ku kyuma kya kikomo eky'ekifaananyi kye ekyali kimufaanana ennyo ekyakubibwa mu myaka gye egy'oluvannyuma. Kkopi yaakyo y'esooka mu kitabo kya Kirk, Mother of the Wesleys, era erabika ng'entono ku ntandikwa y'ekitabo kya Omwami Stevenson, Memorials of the Wesley Family. Era waliwo ekifaananyi ekitono ekikyaliwo ekiraga ekitundu ku ngeri gye yali afaananamu mu kiseera ky'amaanyi ge. Mu bazzukulu be ab'ewala ennyo mulimu abakazi omu oba babiri abamufaanana ddala mu ndabika.

Ejjinja ery'oku ntaana erasooka bwe lyali lyonoonese nnyo olw'ebiseera n'embeera y'obudde, mu 1828, ebipande eby'ekijjukizo eby'Abametodisiti abatutumufu abawerako bwe byateekebwa mu City Road Chapel ku nsimbi za Wesleyan Book Committee, ejjinja eriggya, eriko ebigambo ebiggya, lyasimbibwa ku ntaana ya Mukyala Wesley. Okussa ekitiibwa mu muyimbi waabwe omulungi tekwabaleetera kukuuma nnyiriri ze zonna, era ebigambo eby'ekijjukizo kati bigamba bwe biti: — " Wano we wagalamidde omubiri gwa MUKYALA SUSANNA WESLEY, Nnamwandu wa OMUSUMBA SAMUEL WESLEY, M.A.

(eyali Omusumba w'e Epworth, mu Lincolnshire), eyafa nga 23 Julaayi 1742, Ng'aweza emyaka 73.

Yali muwala asembayo obuto owa OMUSUMBA SAMUEL ANNESLEY, D.D., eyagobwa Etteeka ly'Obumu (Act of Uniformity) mu nnyumba y'omusumba ey'e St. Giles's, Cripplegate, nga 24 Agusito 1662.

Yali nnyina w'abaana 19, abaasinga okutuuka ku kitiibwa nga be BASUMBA JOHN ne CHARLES WESLEY;

owoolubereberye ku bano ye yali, wansi wa Katonda, Omutandisi w'Ebibiina by'Abantu Abayitibwa Abametodisiti." " Mu ssuubi ekkakafu era ekitaliimu kubuusabuusa ery'okuzuukira, N'okutwala ennyumba ye mu bire waggulu, Omukristaayo wano yassa wansi omubiri gwe, Omusaalaba n'aguwaanyisaamu engule."

Mu 1869 Bunhill Fields, newaakubadde nga kyali kyaggalwa dda okuziikibwamu, kyakuumibwa ng'ekiggya eky'emirembe gyonna, ne kisimbibwamu emiti, ne kikolebwamu amakubo agatuuka kumpi n'entaana ezisinga okumanyika. Ekifo awali omubiri gwa Mukyala Wesley we wali ennamba 17 ne 42 we zisisinkanira ku bbugwe ow'ebweru, era yaadi ntono ebugwanjuba-ku-bukiikaddyo okuva ku ntaana ya John Bunyan, eyali omulamu ng'abuulira mu buwala bwe obw'edda ennyo.

Ekikondo ekiwanvu eky'amayinja ga marble ag'e Sicily ekyazimbibwa okumujjukira kiyimiridde mu maaso ga City Road Chapel, nga kitunudde ku Bunhill Fields, okuva mu Desemba 1870, nga kiriko ebigambo ebifaanagana ennyo n'ebyo ebyasembyeyo okuwandiikibwa.

Obulamu buno obutono obwa Susanna Wesley tebuyinza kukomekkerezebwa bulungi okusinga mu bigambo bya Isaac Taylor omugenzi, nga naye yali mutabani wa maama eyasomesa, ng'ayambibwako bba, amaka ge gonna amanene ennyo, era n'afuna essanyu ery'okubalaba nga bakula ne bafuuka mu bantu abasinga obuyigirize n'okutya Katonda mu mulembe gwabwe oba mu mulembe gwonna ogw'abasajja n'abakazi Abangereza: " Nnyina wa ba Wesley ye yali nnyina w'ekibiina ky'Abametodisiti mu ngeri ey'eddiini n'ey'empisa; kubanga obuvumu bwe, okwewaayo kwe wansi w'obuyinza, obugulumivu bw'endowooza ye, obwetwaze bwayo, n'okwefuga kwayo, ebbugumu ly'okusinza kwe n'engeri ey'ebikolwa gye kwalagibwamu, byalabika era ne byeyolekera ddala mu mpisa ne mu nneeyisa ya batabani be."

fields.title: Abaasigalawo n'Ezzadde Lyabwe
fields.body_html:
AB'EKIKA abaali beetoolodde ekitanda Mukyala Wesley kwe yafiira baali bawala be Emilia, Susanna, Hetty, Anne ne Martha, wamu ne mutabani we John. Emilia, Mukyala Harper, yali kati aweza emyaka amakumi ataano, nnamwandu, era nga talina mwana; kubanga newakubadde yazaalako omwana, omwana oyo yafa mangu. Yali tafunyeeko ssanyu lingi mu bulamu bwe obw'obuwala wadde mu bufumbo bwe; empisa ze zaali za kwetaaga nnyo, era nga si nnungi nnyo; yali amanyi nti alina ebitone, era ng'alumwa nnyo nti teyafuna mukisa kwolesa bitone ebyo. Mu buvubuka bwe yali yayogereza Omwami Leybourne, era newakubadde olw'okuba Mukyala Wesley ne Samuel tebaasiima bufumbo obwo, obufumbo obwo ne busazibwamu, Emilia teyali mukazi eyeerabira amangu, oba ayagala omulala mangu. Okumenyeka kw'essuubi eryo kwakaawa obulamu bwe bwonna. Yali ayagala nnyo nnyina, era okwagala kwe yalina eri John, eyali amusinga obuto emyaka kkumi n'emu, kwalimu nnyo engeri ey'obuzadde; naye Hetty bwe yeesittala, Emilia yamukambuwalira. Obwavu bunyaga nnyo obuwoomi mu mbeera y'omukazi, era oluvannyuma lw'okufumbirwa yabonaabona nnyo n'obwavu okusinga bwe yabonaabona mu buwala bwe e Epworth ng'ensimbi n'engoye bya bbula. Omwami Harper yali tasobola na kwebeezaawo yekka, amagoba agaava mu ssomero lye tegaamala, n'alwala, n'atuuka n'okutunda engoye ze asobole okufuna emmere, era n'atuuka ku kusuubira buli ssaawa nti n'ekitanda kye kyennyini kijja kuwambibwa olw'ebbanja ly'obupangisa bw'ennyumba ly'atasasudde. Oba nga akabi ako kaatuukirira ddala oba nedda tekimanyiddwa; naye ka kibe kitya, okufa kwa bba kwamuwa eddembe okumaliriza ensonga ze e Gainsborough n'ajja e London wamu n'omuweereza we omukadde. Okuva olwo John ye yamulabiriranga, era yamalanga ebiseera bingi ku Foundry, newakubadde nga tekirabika nti yabeeranga eyo ddala. Omuzimu gw'e Epworth tegwamuvaako ddala, nga bwe kirabikira mu bbaluwa eno gye yawandiikira John: — " MWANNYINAZE OMWAGALWA, " nga 16 Febwali 1750.

" Njagala nnyo okukulaba n'okwogera naawe okumala essaawa eziwerako nga bwe twakolanga edda. Waliwo ebintu ebinkaluubirira; njagala ggwe obinnyonnyole. Enjigiriza emu eyiyo n'ey'abalala bangi, kwe kugamba nti essanyu teriyinza kusangibwa mu kintu kyonna oba mu bintu byonna eby'ensi muno, nga bwe nnina obumanyirivu bwange bwennyini obw'emyaka 16 obugikontana ddala, njagala twogere ku yo. Ekirala kye kintu ekyo eky'ekitalo kye tuyita ' Jeffery '. Tonsekerera nti nzikiriza eby'obusamize bwe nkubuulira nga bwe kiri ekikakafu nti ekintu ekyo kijja gye ndi nga waliwo ekibonoobono ekipya eky'amaanyi ekigenda okuntuukako; naye bitono nnyo ebimanyiddwa ku nsi etalabika, nze, waakiri, ne ssobola kusalawo oba nga mwoyo mukwano oba mwoyo mubi. Nja kusanyuka okumanya okuva gy'oli w'obeera, ne w'oyinza okusangibwa. Bw'oba ku Foundry, mazima ddala nja kujja okulaba mwannyinaze omwagalwa, oba n'ebigere oba mu kigaali, nfune omukisa omunene ennyo ogw'okunyumya naawe okumala essaawa eziwerako.

" Nze mukwano gwo asiima ddala era mwannyoko akwagala, " EMILIA HARPER."

Ebigambo ebyawandiikibwa emabega w'akabaluwa kano, mu mukono gwa John Wesley yennyini, bikakasa nti kaddibwamu nga 18, naye okuddamu okwo tekwaterekebwa. " Jeffery " yali kintu ekyelangiriranga n'okukonkona n'amaloboozi ag'enjawulo; era okuva nga 8 Febwali, nga wiiki nga emu nga akabaluwa tekannawandiikibwa, London bwe yali esasamaziddwa era n'etiisibwa olwa musisi ow'amaanyi, abantu abatalina kukkiriza kunene mu bintu ebisukkulumye ku butonde bayinza okusonyiyibwa bwe balowooza nti Mukyala Harper ayinza okuba nga yatabula amaloboozi agaava mu kukankana okwo okw'obutonde n'ago ekisirikko eky'e Epworth bye kyali kimanyidde okweyolesa nago.

Ekibiina ky'Abametodisiti bwe kyafuna ekkanisa emanyiddwa obulungi mu West Street, Mukyala Harper n'omuweereza omukadde baasengukira mu nnyumba eyali egiriraanye, ne babeera mu bisenge ebyagattibwa ku kkanisa ng'oyita mu kayumba akaali emabega w'ekituuti n'eddirisa, eryo bwe lyaggulwanga, ababeera munda ne basobola okwegatta ku kusinza nga tebalabibwa. Mukyala Harper yafuuka mukadde wa kisa era omukkakkamu ennyo bwe yali amaze okubulwa ekijjukizo, n'afa olw'okuggwaamu amaanyi kw'omubiri mu 1771, ng'anaatera okuweza emyaka kinaana.

Kijjukirwa nti Susanna Wesley, muwala ow'okubiri ow'ab'omu maka g'e Epworth, yafumbirwa Richard Ellison mu 1721, era nti newakubadde nga yali mu mbeera ennungi ekigero, bulijjo yatwalibwanga ng'omukoddomi atasanyusa. Abaana bana abaazaalibwa mu bufumbo buno bwe baali bakuze oba nga bakula, omuliro gwakwata ennyumba y'Omwami Ellison, era okuva olwo mukyala we n'agaana okubeera naye, n'abeeranga mu London ewa batabani be ne bawala be, olumu ewa omu, olulala ewa omulala. Bba eyali alekeddwawo yagezaako mu buli ngeri gye yasobola okumukomyawo, naye ye n'atakkiriza kumulaba wadde okuddamu bbaluwa ze. Ku nkomerero yasaasaanya olugambo nti afudde, n'omukazi amangu ago n'agenda e Lincolnshire okuziika. Bwe yakizuula nti bwali bukodyo bwokka okumukomyawo, yaddayo e London amangu ago, era tewaali n'omu eyasobola okumusendasenda okutabagana ne bba. Ebizibu byatuuka ku Mwami Ellison mu myaka gye egy'oluvannyuma. Gwali mulimu gw'Abakulira Emikutu gy'Amazzi (Commissioners of Sewers) mu bitundu by'entobazzi (Fen Country) okukuuma emikutu eminene nga miggule, era bwe baagulagajjalira, amazzi ne gasaasaana ne gabikka ettaka lye okumala emyaka ng'ebiri. Ente ze n'embalaasi ze zaafa, n'atasobola kulima birime, wadde okufuna kaliyirwa, n'olwekyo n'atuuka ku bwavu obw'amaanyi ennyo n'agenda ku Foundry ne yeesiga ekisa kya muko we, John Wesley, eyamusemba eri omusuubuzi w'ebyensimbi omugagga eyali agaba ensimbi ezimu ez'obwesigwa, ng'agamba nti " obuyambi obutono ennyo tebuyinza kujjira mu kiseera ekisaanidde okusinga kino." Newakubadde mukyala w'omusajja ono atalina mukisa yasigala ewala, John ne Charles baamukolera ebirungi nnyo, era ne bamutwala ng'omuntu eyakyuka ddala. Yafiira mu London ku ntandikwa ya Apuli 1760, era Charles Wesley ye yasoma okusaba kw'okuziika ku mulambo gwe.

Abaana b'abafumbo bano abataagalana baali John, Ann, Deborah ne Richard Annesley Ellison. Omukulu yabeera era n'afiira e Bristol, era abamu ku bazzukulu be bakyabeera mu kibuga ekyo. Ann yafumbirwa Pierre le Lievre, omunoonyi w'obubudamo Omufalansa, eyafa n'amulekera omwana omulenzi omu; oluvannyuma n'afumbirwa Omwami Gaunt. Yali mukazi mumpi, mulamu nnyo mu mbeera, mugezi, era mulungi mu ndabika, era Mukyala Ellison yabeeranga nnyo naye, n'afiira mu nnyumba ye, ng'aweza emyaka nkaaga mu mwenda, ku ntandikwa ya Desemba 1764. John Wesley yawandiikira Charles nga 7, ng'agamba nti, " Mwannyinaffe Sukey yali mu bulumi obw'amaanyi okumala ennaku ttaano, oluvannyuma n'afa ng'alina obukakafu obujjuvu obw'okukkiriza. Ebimu ku bigambo bye ebyasembayo, bwe yali amaze akaseera nga tasobola kwogera, byali bino: ' Yesu ali wano, Eggulu kwe kwagala! ' "

Mutabani wa Mukyala Gaunt ow'omu bufumbo bwe obwasooka yatuumibwa Pierre okusinziira ku kitaawe, n'asomera e Kingswood, mu ssomero eddene ab'oluganda Wesley lye baatandika okumpi ne Bristol. Erinnya lye ery'obukristaayo yalifuula ery'Olungereza n'aliyita Peter, era n'aggyawo akagambo akaali kakulembera erinnya lye ery'ekika. Yayingira obuweereza bw'Ekkanisa n'afuuka omukulu w'essomero lya Lutterworth Grammar School, era omuyambi w'omusumba era omuyambi w'Omwami Johnson, eyali, mu biseera ebyo eby'omusumba omu okukulira ebigo ebingi, omusumba w'e Lutterworth era vicar w'e Claybrook. Mu kifo ekyo eky'okubiri Omwami Johnson yalina ennyumba ennungi ennyo n'ekibangirizi, era yasomesanga abayizi, mu bo mwe mwali Lord Macaulay omugenzi. Omwami Lievre yawasa Miss Sturges, ne bakuza abaana mukaaga. William, eyasembayo ku bo, yafa emyaka nga amakumi abiri emabega e Bruntingthorpe, mu Leicestershire, gye kirabika yali omukulu w'erimu ku masomero ago amatono agaali gaweebwa obuyambi obw'enkalakkalira, kaakano agaddamu okutegekebwa Abakulira oba agaagattibwa ku masomero amalala. Yali musajja eyeewala abantu, ayagala okusoma, ng'alina omwoyo era n'obukugu bungi obw'okukozesa ebigambo obulungi obw'omuwandiisi w'ebitontome ow'amazima; era singa yali abeera mu bantu ab'ebiwandiiko, awatali kubuusabuusa yandyekoledde erinnya n'ekifo. Naye bwe kyali, ab'ewaabwe baamusekereranga olw'okwagala okuyiiya ennyimba, n'agwa mu bunafu obutera okulabika mu abo abaasubwa omulimu gwabwe ogw'amazima. Kyokka amawulire ag'e Derbyshire n'e Leicestershire gaasanyukanga okufulumya ebitontome bye mu bifo byago ebyategekerwa ebitontome (Poet's Corners). Ebimu ku byo birungi nnyo, era singa biddamu okukubibwa, bandisiimiddwa bangi.

Deborah Ellison naye yafumbirwa omunoonyi w'obubudamo Omufalansa, omuluzi w'engoye za liiri ayitibwa Pierre Collett; era omu ku bawala be n'afuuka mukyala w'Omumetodisiti omututumufu, Dr. Byam.

Richard Annesley Ellison yafa ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu musanvu gyokka, n'aleka abawala babiri. Omukulu ku bo yafumbirwa Omwami Voysey ow'e King's House, Salisbury, n'afuuka nnyina w'abaana ab'obulenzi babiri n'ab'obuwala babiri. Omwana omulenzi omukulu yafa nga tawasizza; omuwala omukulu yafumbirwa Comte de Fauconpret de Thulus, omugezi Omufalansa eyali omututumufu ennyo, eyavvuunula mu Lufalansa ebitabo byonna ebya Sir Walter Scott ebigunjiddwa, mu kiseera kye yali mu buwaŋŋanguse mu nsi eno. Louis Philippe bwe yalya obwakabaka mu 1830, yaddayo ne mukyala we e Bufalansa, gye yafunira ekifo ekya waggulu mu Yunivasite y'e Paris. Amaka gaabwe gaali e Fontainebleau, gye baakuŋŋaanyizanga abamu ku bantu abasinga obugezi mu biseera ebyo, era eyo M. de Fauconpret gye yafiira mu 1842. Nnamwandu we yafiira e Hackney mu kyeya kya 1868. Muganda we omuto yafumbirwa emirundi ebiri, omulundi ogusooka eri Omwami Edlin, n'ogw'okubiri eri Omwami Bristow. Babiri ku batabani be ne bawala be abasatu be yazaala ne bba eyasooka bonna bakyali balamu, era ye yennyini afudde ng'omulimu guno gukyakubibwa. Muzzukulu wa Mukyala Ellison asembayo obuto, Annesley Voysey, yawasa n'afuuka kitaawe wa Henry Voysey, omukubi w'enteekateeka z'amayumba eyali amanyiddwako, Richard Voysey, eyayawulibwa mu buweereza bw'Ekkanisa ya Bungereza, ne Rev. Charles Voysey, eby'obulamu bwe ebimanyiddwa obulungi. Tewali n'omu mu ttabi lino ery'ekika eyali abulwako amaanyi g'obwongo, oba obuvumu okunywerera ku ndowooza ze.

Hetty Wesley, Mukyala Wright, yali mulwadde nnyo mu kiseera nnyina we yafiira; yali aweddemu amaanyi olw'ebyo bye yagumiikiriza mu mikono gya bba omutamiivu, eyalabika nga, newakubadde kyali bwe kityo, yali akyamwagalako mu ngeri emu. Yazaala abaana abawerako, abaafa nga bakyali bawere, ekyamunakuwaza ennyo; naye omuwala ayitibwa Amelia kirowoozebwa nti yawangaala emyaka egiwerako, oba nga yafa nga nnyina tannafa. Kigambibwa nti Hetty yasigala n'obulungi bw'obuvubuka bwe obumu okutuusa nga akaddiye nnyo. Yali mukwano omwesigwa, era mu nnaku ze ez'oluvannyuma omujjanjabi, wa kitaawe omuto Matthew, eyamuyambanga ennyo mu by'ensimbi. Mu 1743 yali abeera e Stanmore mu Middlesex; mangu oluvannyuma n'afuuka Omumetodisiti, n'alabaganga nnyo ne bannyina. Baali bakakasa nti amazzi ag'ebbugumu ag'e Clifton (Clifton Hot-wells), bwe gakozesebwa obulungi, gayinza okuwonya endwadde ez'omubiri ezisinga obungi, era bwe batyo ne bamusindika eyo. Baalina emikwano mingi mu Bristol ne mu bitundu ebigiriraanye, era mwannyinaabwe n'ayanirizibwa Mukyala Vigor, gwe yabeera naye okumala emyezi egiwerako. Mu kiseera ky'amakungula mu 1745, yali azzeeyo eka, n'awandiikira Charles ebbaluwa, mwe yayogerera ku bba n'okwagala: — " London, Frith Street, " MWANNYINAZE OMWAGALWA ENNYO, " nga 4 Okitobba 1745.

" Nnafuna ebbaluwa zo zombi ez'ekisa era nkwebaza olw'ezo, naye nneewuunya nti towulirangako mawulire ga kussuuka kwange, newakubadde nga nze sisobola kuwandiika, kubanga bangi bandabye be mmanyi nti muwandiikiganwa, era abamu ku bo baagenze e Bath oba e Bristol mu nnaku zino, naddala mwannyinaffe Naylor ne Mukyala Wigginton. Mazima nkyali munafu nnyo, nsigala ku kitanda kyange, okuggyako bwe ngolokoka okukyaliiriza, era tekikkirizika nga bwe nfuuse amagumba gokka, n'amagumba gange gaagala kuyita mu lususu. Naye olw'okusaasira, omusujja ogwali gunteeka mu kabi akaali kanneetoolodde ABAASIGALAWO N'EZZADDE LYABWE.

(nga gulina n'ekifuba eky'amaanyi n'obubonero obumu obw'okufa) guwedde, era kati nsuubirwa nnyo okuwona okusinga bwe kyali kibadde; weewaawo, singa nfunamu amaanyi, sandibuusabuusa. Nzikiriza ddala nti obuteefu buno obw'omubiri n'emirembe eminene egy'omu mwoyo biva mu kusaba okw'okukkiriza. Obuwagizi buno mbutwala ng'obw'ekitalo okusingawo, kubanga sikyawulira kubeerawo kwa Katonda okuva lwe nnagwa ku kitanda; era omanyi nga bwe tuba bwe tulekebwa fekka mu bulumi obungi n'okutya okufa. Kyokka, newakubadde nkyali ng'alekeddwa, era omulabe akola nnyo, nnina emirembe n'okwebaza mu kigero ekinene ennyo ekisukkulumye ku butonde. Aleluuya! Ka kibe nga " mazima ddala obubalagaze bw'okufa buyise " oba nedda, ndi mu mirembe ddala era nneewaddeyo, nga mmaze okukwasa kino, wamu n'obulamu obw'omwoyo obwa Will omwagalwa n'ebintu ebirala byonna, Omusawo Omufuzi w'emyoyo n'emibiri.

" Mwannyinaze omwagalwa ennyo, tewali nsonga ya kwefaako ku bwange eyinza kunneegomba okusigala kwo mu nsi eno ey'akabi ennyo era ey'ekiseetaani; naye bulijjo tuteekwa okugamba nti, ' By'oyagala bikolebwe '; era nsanyuka okulowooza nti Katonda ajja kutukkiriza okuddamu okusisinkana, newakubadde sisobola kugamba nti njagala obulamu wadde edakiika emu okusingawo, ne ku nkola eyo. Willy akulamusizza n'okwagala, era yandisanyuse mu mazima okukulaba. Nkwegayiridde weegatte nange mu kusaba aleme kuddirira. Ne Matty akulamusizza n'ekitiibwa era asaba okumusabira. Emyoyo gyabwe gyombi tegikulaakulana nga bwe nandyagadde. Kitalo nti newakubadde tumanyi nti okutukuzibwa mulimu ogugenda mpolampola, twagala baliraanwa baffe batambule mangu okutusinga; naye Willy omwavu alindirira kirabo kisooka kyokka. Sirina kutya kwonna ku abo abanyiikivu mu mazima.

" Obanga eggwanga lyonna lizaliridde ddala olw'eby'obufuzi, newakubadde nga terigezezza wadde okutukuvuwamu n'akatono, tekyewuunyisa nti omuntu gwe wayogeddeko mu bbaluwa yo esembayo ajjudde ebyo, newakubadde nga yeekomako, era tayogera bya kulya mu nsi lukwe, ne bw'aba alowooza ki. Nsanyuse nti abakkiriza be mmanyi tebalabika kugwa mu kusukkiriza kwonna ku nsonga ez'ekiseera kino, oba okufiirwa ' ekintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa ' olw'okwogera ennyo oba olw'okusaba ekitono. Mukama atuwe okusalawo okutuufu mu bintu byonna.

" Okusaba kwange, okwagala kwange n'okwagaliza okusingayo obulungi bigoberere emikwano gyonna egyagalwa e Bristol, gye nnafunako ebirungi ebitabalika; naye, okusinga bonna, Mukyala Vigor n'ab'omu maka ge, abaalaga okwagala okutakoowa mu kumpeereza n'okunzikiriza. . . .

" Gubadde gumu ku musalaba gyange egisinga obuzito obutasobola kubawandiikira bonna; naye singa mpona, sinnaggwaamu ssuubi lya kukikola, oba nga kikkirizibwa okuva eri omuyizi omupya. Oyinza okulowooza nti nsobola okubawandiikira nga bwe nkuwandiikira ggwe; naye, Charles omwagalwa, kaakano mpandiika nga ndi ku kitanda, era tosobola kukkiriza bwe kinnumya. Nsuubira okukujjukira n'okukusabira omukisa emirundi mingi nga sinnafa; nga nneegomba tusooke tusisinkane omulundi omulala ogw'essanyu, oba nga kye kisinga obulungi. Bwe ntyo, nga nsabira Ekkanisa yonna, abaweereza, abayambi n'abantu bonna, nkkirizibwe okuteeka omukono nga nze mwannyoko asiima ennyo era akwagala, " MEHET. WRIGHT."

Mukyala Wright kirabika yassuukako mu bulwadde buno, newakubadde nga teyaddamu kuba wa maanyi; naye mu Janwali ne Febwali 1750, kyeyoleka bulungi nti enkomerero ye yali esembera. Yalina ku nneewulira ezaasukkiranga era kumpi ez'obuzaaliranwa ezaali zimanyiddwa ennyo mu Bametodisiti abaasooka, era n'agamba mukwano gwe eyagenda okumulaba nti, " Nneegombye nnyo okufa, kubanga omanyi nti ffe Abametodisiti bulijjo tufa nga tujjudde essanyu eriyitiridde." Kirabika Charles ye yekka mu bannyina eyali mu London mu kiseera ekyo, era nga 14 ne 18 Maaki amwogerako nti " ali kumpi nnyo n'omwalo "; naye bwe yagenda okumulaba nga 21, omwoyo gwe gwali gwakava mu mubiri. Nga 26, ayongerako nti, " Nnamugoberera okutuuka ku ntaana ye ey'emirembe, ne nkaaba wamu n'abo abakaaba." Yali aweza emyaka amakumi ataano mu esatu.

Omwami Wright yali tasobola kukubagizibwa, n'asaba Charles Wesley obutamwabulira, newakubadde mwannyina yali afudde. Yawangaala emyaka egiwerako oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwe, n'awasa omukazi omulala, era bulijjo teyabeeranga mu mirembe ne mukyala we ow'okubiri. Okumala emyaka egiwerako teyalabako ku b'oluganda Wesley, naye bwe yakubwa olukonvuba, n'atumya Charles, era n'asanyuka nnyo okumulaba. Omubuulizi w'enjiri oyo eyali alina essuubi eringi yalaba ensonga ey'okusuubira ku nkomerero ye, era oboolyawo, ku nkomerero, ensobi ze zaali nnyo za mutwe okusinga ez'omutima.

Dr. Adam Clarke yakuŋŋaanya n'afulumya ebitontome kkumi ebya Mukyala Wright; byali bikwatagana n'endowooza z'abantu be yabeerangamu, era nga bitabuddwamu ennaku eyakwasa obulamu bwe ekiwuubaalo; naye okukoowa ensi eno okutaliiko kkomo, n'okwegomba okw'essanyu eriyitiridde eri ebiseera eby'omu maaso ebitamanyiddwa era ebitasobola kumanyibwa, bulijjo kiba kya bulwadde era tekiba kirungi. Olunyiriri lwokka olusaanidde okujuliza wano luva mu katontome akatono akaawandiikirwa nnyina eyali afiiriddwa abaana be: — " Newakubadde okufa kw'abaana bo kukuleetedde Ennaku ezisinga ez'okuzaalibwa kwabwe;

Tokungubaga nti abalala bazaalira nsi, Ng'ate ggwe ojjuzizza Eggulu abantu." Tetwongera kulaba ku Anne Wesley, Mukyala Lambert, ne bba, oluvannyuma lw'okubeerawo kwabwe ku kuziika kwa nnyina mu Bunhill Fields, era tewali kimanyiddwa ku by'obulamu bwa mutabani waabwe.

Martha Wesley, Mukyala Hall, yali afaanana nnyo mwannyina John mu ndabika, ne kiba nti Dr. Adam Clarke yagamba nti tewali n'omu yandimanyiddeko ani y'ani singa baali bambadde mu ngeri y'emu. N'empandiika ye nayo yali efaanana nnyo eyiye, era kino kiteekwa okuba nga kyava ku kuba nti bwe yali aweza emyaka ng'ekkumi n'omwenda, yawandiikanga " bubi nnyo," ng'ebigambo bye ye yennyini bwe biri, era ne yeewulira nga wa wansi nnyo okusinga Emilia ne Hetty. Noolwekyo John n'amuwandiikira ebyokukoppa, bye yakoppa n'obwegendereza obungi ennyo, era bw'atyo n'akola empandiika ye ng'egoberera eyiye.

Tumaze okulaba nti yabeeranga ne bba e Salisbury, era nti Mukyala Wesley yamalanga nnyo ebiseera nabo nga tannasenguka kugenda ku Foundry. Mu kiseera kye yabeera mu kibuga ekyo, Mukyala Hall yazaala abaana kkumi, era omu yekka ku bo ye yawangaala okusukka obuwere. Omwami Hall yali musajja wa kyewuunyo, era, nga bwe kyazuulibwa, omusajja ow'empisa embi. Yalina ebisaanyizo byonna ebyetaagisa omukulu w'Abamormoni, era singa yali abeera mu nnaku zino, kirabika nnyo yandyegasse ku kibiina ekyo. Ebiwerako ku bunafu bwe byava ku kudda emabega oluvannyuma lw'okunyiikira n'okwekakaba okw'amaanyi mu ddiini mu buvubuka bwe; yatandika okwerowooleza, n'okubuusabuusa ebintu, ebyo newakubadde nga kati bya bulijjo, mu biseera ebyo byatwalibwanga n'okwesisiwala. Mu bigambo ebitono, Omwami Hall yava ku njigiriza entuufu, n'agaana okukkiriza enjigiriza nnyingi, kaakano ezisirikirwa okuggyako abo abanyiikivu ennyo mu ddiini. Kino kye kyali omusingi n'entikko y'ensobi ye mu maaso ga bangi ku bakozi banne aba John ne Charles Wesley, abaamunenya n'ebigambo ebikakali okusinga ab'oluganda bennyini bwe baakola. Obuntu butera okugwa mu kusukkiriza ng'okwo.

Waliwo obukakanyavu obumu mu bbaluwa eno John gye yawandiikira Mukyala Hall amangu ddala nga nnyina waabwe yaakaziikibwa. Kiri ng'ayagala okulaga nti ebiseera nnyina by'amala ng'atuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwe obw'obutonde eri abaana be biteekwa okuggyibwa ku biseera ebyandikozeseddwa mu kukulaakulanya obulamu bwe obw'omwoyo, era, bwe kiba bwe kityo, kiba kitundu ku nzikiriza ey'okwefaako ennyo. Eky'essanyu, abasinga obungi mu ffe tukkiriza nti bwe tutuukiriza obulungi era n'omutima omulongoofu obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe obw'obuzadde n'obulala, tuba tutuukiriza bulungi nnyo ekigendererwa kye twatondebwa. John Wesley, ataazaalako mwana we yennyini, era obufumbo bwe nga tebwali bwa kwegatta kwa myoyo ddala, yatunuulira ensonga eno mu ngeri endala ddala: — " Newcastle-on-Tyne, " MWANNYINAZE OMWAGALWA, " nga 17 Novemba 1742.

" Nzikiriza nti okufa kw'abaana bo kyakulabirako ekinene eky'obulungi bwa Katonda gy'oli. Emirundi mingi wambuulira ebiseera byo bingi bwe baabimalanga. Kaakano ebiseera ebyo bikuddiziddwa, era tolina kirala kya kukola wabula okuweereza Mukama waffe ng'oli mu buteraliikirira, era nga tewali birala bikuziyiza, okutuusa lw'olitukuzibwa mu mubiri, emmeeme n'omwoyo. Amangu ddala nga ndabye Omwami Hall, nnamuyita abeere ku Foundry, naye n'asaba mmusonyiwe. Waliwo obutakwatagana obw'ekyewuunyo mu mbeera ye ne mu ndowooza ze ku nze. Ab'oluganda abasirise (still brethren) mpolampola bamuteekeddemu nga bwe basobodde okunyooma kwabwe nze ne muganda wange, n'obutayagala nkola yaffe yonna, eyawukana ku yaabwe ng'ekitangaala bwe kyawukana ku kizikiza. Weewaawo, mu butamanya bwabwe bamuyigirizza n'okuvumirira enteekateeka yange n'engeri gye nfugamu ebweru, ab'omu nnyumba yange n'ekibiina. Ate nga mmanyi nti kino kye kirabo eky'enjawulo Katonda kye yampa, era mu kyo (olw'ekisa kye) abasinga obukulu mu bo tebalina kye bansinza. Newakubadde kiri bwe kityo, mu ye mukyasigaddemu ekitundu ku kunzisaamu ekitiibwa kwe yalina e Oxford, era luvannyuma kujja kuwangula. Ajja kubazuula abasajja bano ab'ennaku, n'ebire bijja kugenda.

" Nzikiriza nti ekigendererwa kya Katonda ekya kaakano kwe kukyalira Ekkanisa ya Bungereza enaku era eyalekebwawo, era nti, olw'ekyo, tewali kusinga Omwami Gambold eyabuzibwabuzibwa wadde omulala yenna agivaamu alikulaakulana. Ayi! ' Musabirenga Yerusaalemi emirembe: Abo abakwagala bafune ebirungi.' Omwami Hall ansasudde olw'ebitabo. Saagala nsimbi zonna okuva gy'oli, okwagala kwo kumala. Naye wandiikiranga emirundi mingi era ebbaluwa empanvu nga bw'osobola eri mukwano gwo era mwannyoko akwagala, " J. WESLEY."

Ebbaluwa eno ekakasa nga John Wesley bwe yali ewala ennyo okulowooza okwawukana ku Kkanisa ya Bungereza, era eraga nti yali amanyi bulungi ekirabo kye yalina eky'okutegeka n'okukulembera.

Tekimanyiddwa bulungi obanga Mukyala Hall yeesiga ab'ewaabwe okutuuka ku kubabuulira ku bwenzi bwa bba nga tannamala myaka mingi ng'abonyaabonyezebwa nabwo. Yali mukazi wa ddaala erisinga obugulumivu era eritera okulabika, era yanyigiriza ddala okwefaako kwonna okw'obutonde, ne kiba nti yalabiriranga abaana b'abalala n'okwewaayo kungi nga gy'obeera baali babe, ate eri ba Agali abatalina mukisa abaabazaala n'abalaga ekisa n'okusaasira kungi nga gy'obeera bba teyali abaagala okumusinga ye. Omwami Hall mu biseera bye ebisingako obulungi yawuliranga era n'alaga okusiima okusingayo eri empisa ze, naye yali muntu munafu era nga tasobola kwefuga. Kigambibwa nti olumu kitaawe yasunguwalira Isaaka w'omu maka nga nnyina alabirira Isimayiri, n'atiisa nnyo omwana ng'amusibira mu kabada enzirugavu olw'ensobi entono ennyo. Kino kumpi kyasukka ku ky'asobola okugumiikiriza, naye yali amaliridde nti obuyinza bwa bba ku mutabani we tebulina kukendeera. Ekibonerezo kyali kisukkiridde nnyo okusinga ensobi, naye n'atasobola kumumatiza. Ku nkomerero n'amujjukiza nti newakubadde ye yali asunguwalira omwana we awatali nsonga, ye teyagoba mwana we mu kitanda ky'omwana, naye n'alangirira nti ajja kukikola okuggyako ng'asumulula era n'asonyiwa akaana ako akaali katidde. John ne Charles oluvannyuma baggya mutabani wa mwannyinaabwe mu nnyumba ya kitaawe ne bamusomesa ku ssente zaabwe; naye bwe yali aweza emyaka nga kkumi n'ena n'akwatibwa kawaali ku ssomero, n'afa nga nnyina tannatuuka gy'ali. Eno yali nnaku eyatiibwa nti yandimusse; naye yagumiikiriza era ne yeewaayo, era Ebiseera, omuwonya omukulu, ne bimuleetera okubudaabudibwa.

Lumu Charles Wesley yabuuza mwannyina nga bwe yasobola okugabira omukazi eyali amuggyeko ekifo kye ebimuwummuza n'ensimbi mu kiseera kye eky'obwetaavu. " Ah," bwe yagamba, " nnali mmanyi nti nsobola okufuna bye nneetaaga okuva eri bangi; naye ye, ekitonde ekyo eky'ennaku, yali tasobola, kubanga bangi bandirowoozezza nti bakoze kirungi okumulekera mu nnaku gye yali yeereetedde. . . . Saakola ng'omukazi, wabula ng'Omukristaayo." Bwali Bukristaayo obw'awaggulu ennyo, era obusaanira Mukama oyo ataagoba Maliyamu Magudaleene ku bigere bye. Mazima batono abeeyita Abakristaayo abatuuka ku kintu kyonna ekifaanana ekyo.

Mukyala Hall bwe yagwa mu bwavu yali akyali mugabi nnyo, ne kiba nti mwannyina Charles yagamba nti, " Tekigasa kuwa Patty kintu kyonna kimwongere kuwummula, kubanga bulijjo akigabira omuntu omulala omwavu okumusinga."

Mu 1747 Omwami Hall yasunguwala nnyo mu kimu ku biseera John bwe yakyala e Salisbury, kirabika olw'okumunenya kwe, n'amugoba ye ne Martha mu nnyumba. Mangu oluvannyuma Mukyala Hall n'amuvaako, n'awandiika okunnyonnyola ensonga lwaki: — " Bwe mmaze okukakasa ku nkomerero nti sikyasobola n'akatono kukusanyusa olw'ekintu kyonna kye nnyinza okwogera oba okukola, mmaze ekiseera nga nsazeewo okukuggyako omugugu guno ogutalina mugaso, amangu ddala nga Katonda bw'anaasiima okumpa omukisa. Bw'oba ng'okyalina obuntu obumala eri mukyala abadde naawe emyaka emingi bwe gityo, okukkiriza okumuwa ekintu kyonna eky'okumuyamba okwebeezaawo, nja kukwebaza." Kirowoozebwa nti oluvannyuma lw'ebyo yamusonyiwa n'addayo gy'ali, naye nga kwali kumuvaako nate n'anoonya obukuumi bwa John ku Foundry. Nti teyalina kiruyi kyonna eri bba atali mwesigwa, era nti okwawukana yakutwala nga kwa kaseera buseera, kiragibwa mu bbaluwa endala.

" Newakubadde nandisanyuse nnyo okuwulira okuva gy'oli, sisobola kwewuunya nti tewaddamu bbaluwa yange, kubanga saakoma ku kukuvaako omulundi ogw'okubiri, wabula nasaba n'obukwakkulizo, bwe ntya nti tolaba nga oyagala n'akatono okubukkiriza. Mazima nteekwa okukkiriza omusango ogunvunaanibwa, era, nga bwe nkutwala ng'omulamuzi wekka, sijja kujulira ku kibonerezo ekyo; wabula nsaba onzikirize njogere ebigambo bitono nga tonnakisala. Oyinza okujjukira nti, buli lwe nnasunguwalanga ne ntuuka okwogera ku kukuvaako, tewasobolanga kunsunguwaza okutuuka ku kugamba nti sigenda kudda."
