Obutafaanana bakazi abasinga obungi abayisibwa obubi, Mukyala

Hall teyayogerangako bubi ku bba, era yagambanga nti tekisoboka mukazi alina okwagala okw'amazima mu mutima gwe okukikola.

Yali abeera ku Foundry Charles bwe yawasa Miss Sarah Gwynne e Garth mu South Wales, n'amuwandiikira okumukulisa n'okwagala. Olw'okuba abafumbo abo okumala akaseera tebaafuna maka gaabwe, yandisanyuse okubategekera ewaabwe mu London, naye bo ne baagala okusenga e Bristol. Mu kibuga ekyo Omwami Hall naye mwe yagenda, n'ayita mukyala we amwegatteko; naye olw'okuba enneewulira ze eri ab'ewaabwe zaali za bukyayi so si za mukwano, kyeyoleka nti teyawuliziganya na Charles wadde mukyala we omuto e Stoke's Croft. Charles yamusisinkana mu kkubo mu butanwa bwe yali agenda mu kisenge mwe yabuulira, n'agenda naye; naye wakati mu kubuulira Omwami Hall n'ayingira n'amuggyayo. Olunaku olwaddako n'ayingira nate, ng'ayita Charles erinnya lye. Okudduka kwalabika ng'amagezi agasinga, era Omwami Hall n'agoberera, naye n'atasobola kuzuula muko we gye yali yeekwese. Ensonga eyo yaggwera mu kugenda kwa Mukyala Hall e London, ne bba omwonoonyi n'agenda e Ireland, gye yava ku nkomerero n'agenda mu West Indies, naye nga tali yekka. Mukwano gwe bwe yafa n'akomawo e Bungereza ng'ajjudde okwenenya, n'ayanirizibwa n'essanyu mukyala we omugumiikiriza, eyasigala naye n'amujjanjaba okutuusa lwe yafa, ekyabaawo e Bristol mu Janwali 1776, emyaka amakumi ana oluvannyuma lw'obufumbo bwabwe. Mu ssaawa ze ezaasembayo n'akoowoola nti, " Nnalumya malayika, malayika atannenyezangako." Ebigambo bino byaliyirira Mukyala Hall ennaku yonna gye yali amuleetedde.

Mu kiseera ekiwanvu wakati w'obufumbo bwa Charles Wesley n'okufa kw'Omwami Hall, Mukyala Hall yali atuuse 15 * okumanya ennyo muka mwannyina Omuwelisi, era n'emikwano gye, ab'ennyumba ya Jones ab'omu Fonmon Castle, be yafuuka nabo ab'omukwano ennyo ne kiba nti baabeerera wamu okumala ekiseera e Salisbury. Era yafangayo kumpi ng'omuzadde ku baana b'Omwami ne Mukyala Charles Wesley, abaatuuma omuwala omuto erinnya lye. Ng'abaana abalala bangi be baazaala, omwana oyo yafa; naye Charles omuto, Sally ne Samuel bwe baazaalibwa, omu ng'addirira munne, yabasanyukira nnyo. Sally yakula n'afuuka munne gw'ayagala era mukwano gwe, era singa tewaaliwo mukwano mungi bwe gutyo wakati waabwe, bingi bye tumanyi kaakano ku ab'ekika kya Wesley byandibuze.

Mukyala Hall kirabika yali musanyufu nnyo mu mirembe mu kitundu eky'oluvannyuma eky'obulamu bwe, bwe yamala ennyo mu London. Yali muntu akola ebintu mu nteekateeka era nga tayanguyiriza, ng'atunuulira oluuyi olulungi olw'ekintu kyonna n'omuntu yenna, era nga yeewala ensonga zonna ez'ennaku. Yamalanga ebiseera bingi ne Dr. Johnson, eyanyumirwanga emboozi ye ennamu era eyeesigamanga ku kijjukizo kye eky'amaanyi era ekituufu. Yandisanyuse okumusendasenda okujja abeere mu nnyumba ye, naye abakyala babiri abakadde, Mukyala Williams ne Mukyala Du Moulin, baali babeera naye dda, era Mukyala Hall n'alowooza nti okubeerawo kwe, okuggyako ng'omugenyi owa wano na wali, tekwali kwetaagisa.

John Wesley yassangamu nnyo ekitiibwa omuwandiisi w'enkuluze oyo omukadde, n'amuweereza, ng'ayita mu Mukyala Hall, ekitabo kye eky'Ebinnyonnyola Endagaano Enkadde n'Empya (Notes on the Old and New Testament). Era Mukyala Hall yafuna essanyu okubamanyisa bombi mu bo bennyini, era Dr. Johnson n'ayagala nnyo omusajja oyo omunyiikivu era omuyivu, era yandyagadde okumulaba emirundi mingi. Yanyiiga nnyo kubanga John, eyali yasiibula dda eby'okuwummula, yali talina budde bwa kukuza mukwano naye n'ab'ekibinja kye, era n'agamba lumu Boswell nti:

"Nkyawa okusisinkana John Wesley; embwa eyo ekusikiriza n'emboozi ye, n'oluvannyuma n'ekudduka okugenda okukyalira omukazi omukadde omu." Era nate:

" Emboozi ya John Wesley nnungi, naye bulijjo taba na budde. Bulijjo ateekwa okugenda ku ssaawa ezimu ezigere. Kino tekisanyusa n'akatono omusajja ayagala okufunya amagulu ge n'amala emboozi ye yonna nga nze bwe nkola." Omuntu awulira nti Dr. Johnson mazima teyatondebwa lwa mulembe gwa ggaali za mukka na maato ga mukka, naye nti John Wesley yandizanyumiddwa nnyo.

Ekyewuunyisa, Mukyala Hall ye yennyini teyali wa bigambo bisesa, era teyasiimanga bigambo ebisesa mu balala. Ne mu buto yali muntu mukkakkamu era atali wa kuzannya; era lumu nnyina bwe yasanga abaana be abato nga bazannya era nga baseka, n'akoowoola nti, " Ah! mmwe mwenna lumu mulibeera n'obwegendereza," Martha n'amutunuulira mu maaso n'abuuza nti, " Nange ndyeyongera okubeera n'obwegendereza?" Mukyala Wesley n'amuddamu n'amaanyi nti " Nedda," nga gy'obeera ekyo tekisoboka. Charles yagamba nti, " Mwannyinaffe Patty yali mugezi nnyo okuba ow'ebigambo ebisesa "; era kiwandiikiddwa nti lumu Dr. Johnson bwe yali mu mbeera ey'ennaku ng'ayogera ennyo ku butali ssanyu bw'abantu ng'ali mu maaso ge, n'agamba nti: " Dokita, bulijjo obeeredde mu bantu ab'ebigambo ebisesa, so si mu batukuvu; era beebo abantu abasinga obutasuubirwa kunoonya ssanyu lya mazima oba okuzuula ' ejjinja ery'omuwendo omungi '." Yagaana okusiima ebiwandiiko bya Swift, ebyali byagalwa ennyo bannyina ne baganda be, era yakyawa nnyo naddala The Tale of a Tub, kye yatwala ng'ekitaliiko kitiibwa kyonna eri eby'eddiini.

Oluvannyuma lw'okumala emyaka nga amakumi abiri mu bufumbo nga babeera e Bristol, Charles Wesley ne mukyala we baasengukira e London n'abaana baabwe, Mukyala Hall gye yafunira essanyu okumanyisa muwala wa mwannyina Sally eri Dokita oyo omunene, n'okumulaga ebitontome bye yawandiikanga buli kiseera. Omugezi oyo yakubanga omutwe gwe mpola n'ekisa, n'agamba ssenga we nti, " Ajja kuba mulungi, Nnyabo; ajja kuba mulungi." James Boswell anyumya mu kitabo kye eky'obulamu bwa Johnson, nga bwe ku Ssande ya Paasika, mu 1781, Mukyala Hall, Omwami Allen ne Boswell yennyini baaliira awamu ne Dokita n'abakyala bombi abakadde be yali alabirira. Olunaku olwo mu butonde bwalwo lwawa emboozi engeri yaayo, era Boswell " n'ayogera ku kibiina ekimu eky'eddiini ekiringa ekya Robin Hood, ekyakuŋŋaananga buli Ssande akawungeezi mu Coachmakers' Hall okukubaganya ebirowoozo mu ddembe, era nti ensonga ey'ekiro ekyo yali ekyawandiikibwa ekyogera ku ebyo ebyabaawo Omulokozi waffe bwe yafa — ' Entaana ne zibikkuka era abantu ba Katonda bangi abaali bafudde ne bazuukira, era Yesu bwe yamala okuzuukira ne bava mu ntaana gye baali baziikiddwa ne bayingira mu kibuga ekitukuvu ne balabibwa abantu bangi.' Mukyala Hall n'agamba nti yali nsonga ya kyewuunyo nnyo, era nti yandyagadde nnyo okugiwulira ng'ekubaganyizibwako ebirowoozo. Johnson n'addamu, ng'anyiigiddeko, nti, ' Omuntu tayinza kugenda mu kifo ng'ekyo okugiwulira.' Naye nze ne nsalawo nti nja kugenda. ' Naye, Ssebo,' Mukyala Hall bwe yagamba Johnson, ' nandyagadde okukuwulira ggwe ng'ogyogerako.' Yalabika nga tayagala kugiyingiramu. Yayogera ku kuzuukira kw'olulyo lw'omuntu lwonna okutwalira awamu, n'anywerera ku kya kuba nti tulizuukizibwa n'emibiri gye gimu. Johnson: ' Nedda, Nnyabo, tulaba nti tegugenda kuba mubiri gwe gumu, kubanga Ebyawandiikibwa bikozesa ekyokulabirako ky'empeke esigibwa. Toyinza kulowooza nti tulizuukira n'omubiri omulwadde; kimala singa wabaawo okufaanagana okumala okwawula obuntu bw'omuntu.' Dokita n'anyumya engero y'okuwulira eddoboozi lya nnyina lumu nga limuyita bwe yali e Oxford. Mukyala Hall yalabika ng'ayagala okumanya ebisingawo, naye ye n'aleka ekibuuzo ekyo mu kizikiza." Ku mulundi ogwo Mukyala Williams ne Mukyala Hall baayogera nnyo nga balaga ku mukyaza waabwe, okutuusa ku nkomerero lwe yabasirisa ng'ajuliza olunyiriri olumanyiddwa obulungi okuva mu Beggars' Opera — Naye babiri omulundi gumu tewali muntu ayinza kubagumiikiriza.

Dr. Johnson yalina akanafu akatono ak'okwagala okuba omwogezi omukulu, era tewali musajja ayagala okuba ekyo ky'ayita " okubuulirirwa " omukazi. Kyokka okubuulira kwa Mukyala Hall kirabika kwali kwa ngeri nkakkamu, era kwali kukwata ku ndowooza okusinga ku bantu. Yalinanga ekirungi eky'okwogera ku buli muntu; era bwe kyabanga kyetaagisa okwogera ku nsobi, bulijjo yajjukiranga embeera ezaali zizikendeeza.

Yasigala bulungi era ng'alina amaanyi, era ng'asobola okutambula ebbanga eddene okutuusa ku nkomerero; era bwe yali asusse emyaka kinaana, Sally Wesley yagezaako okufuna okusuubiza nti ayinza okubeera naye mu kiseera kye eky'okufa. " Yee," ssenga we bwe yaddamu, " bw'onoosobola okukigumiikiriza; naye nkukuutira obutankungubagira okusukka ekitundu ky'essaawa."

John Wesley yafa mu Maaki 1791, n'aleka Mukyala Hall nga ye yekka asigaddewo ku b'omu maka g'e Epworth, era n'alumwa nnyo olw'okufa kwe. Mu kiseera ekyo yali aweza emyaka kinaana mu etaano, era yamusingako okuwangaala emyezi nga ena gyokka. Ku ntandikwa ya Julaayi kyeyoleka nti yali agenda aggwaamu amaanyi mpolampola, era Sally n'asaba enkizo ey'okumutunuulira; naye omulwadde, atefaako yekka okutuusa ku nkomerero, n'akalambira nti bulijjo ateekwa okuddayo eka ekiro, " oleme okulemwa okwebaka — olwo okweraliikirira kwo kwandindeetera okweraliikirira kwange." Yafa nga 12; era akaseera katono nga tannafa, muwala wa mwannyina bwe yamubuuza oba ng'awulira obulumi bwonna, n'addamu nti, " Nedda, wabula enneewulira empya." Nga enkomerero eneetera okutuuka n'ayita Sally, n'amunyiga omukono, n'agamba nti, " Nnina obukakafu bwe mmaze ebbanga eddene nga nsabira. Leekaana!" Amangu ago n'assa omukka gwe ogw'enkomerero.

Kyalabika nga kya butonde ddala okumuziika mu ntaana y'emu ne mwannyina gwe yasinga okwagala mu City Road Burial Ground, era tewaaliwo kiwandiiko kisaanira kusinga ekyo ekyateekebwa ku ntaana yonna, bwe, oluvannyuma lw'erinnya lye n'emyaka gye, ebigambo bino eby'omusajja ow'amagezi owa Isirayiri byayolebwa ku jjinja: " Ayogera n'amagezi, era ayigiriza ebyekisa." Mukyala Hall yalekera muwala wa mwannyina omwagalwa ensimbi ze ezaali ezitono ennyo, wamu n'empapula ze n'ebbaluwa ze, eyabitwala ng'eby'omuwendo ng'ebijjukizo by'oyo eyali gy'ali nga nnyina ow'okubiri.

Ebintu ebisinga obungi mu bulamu bwa John ne Charles Wesley bimanyiddwa nnyo, ne kiba nti tekyetaagisa kubiddamu wano. Kyokka kyewuunyisa nti erinnya ly'ekika lyayisibwa mu Charles yekka ne mutabani we asembayo obuto Samuel. Mukyala Charles Wesley yali aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu mu kiseera ky'obufumbo bwe, ne bba amakumi ana mu ebiri. Baazaala abaana mwenda, era basatu bokka ku bo be baakula; era olw'okuba omwana omulenzi omukulu n'omuwala baabeera era ne bafa nga tebafumbiddwa, abazzukulu bonna ba Samuel, era abaana be abawerako bakyali balamu.

Erinnya lya Mukyala C. Wesley ery'obuwala lyali Sarah Gwynne, era bazadde be baabeeranga e Garth mu South Wales. Nnyina yali wa mu kika ekigagga ennyo, nga y'omu ku baana b'obuwala mukaaga, nga buli omu ku bo yalina pawundi emitwalo esatu ez'okufumbirwa. Amaloboozi amalungi n'ekitone ky'ennyimba byali bisikirwa mu kika ekyo, n'olwekyo awatali kubuusabuusa kyava nnyo ku nnyaabwe batabani bombi, Charles ne Samuel, okufuna ekitone ky'ennyimba ekyabafuula abatutumufu. Obufumbo bwa Charles ne Sarah Wesley bwamala emyaka amakumi asatu mu mwenda, n'afa ng'aweza emyaka kinaana, era ye yamusingako okuwangaala emyaka amakumi asatu mu ena, ng'aweza emyaka kyenda mu mukaaga bwe yafa.

Mutabani waabwe omukulu Charles, eyazaalibwa nga 11 Desemba 1757, yasooka okulaga ekitone kye bwe yali anaatera okuweza emyaka esatu, bwe yakuba oluyimba obulungi ku harpsichord, era, ekisingawo, n'alugattako eddoboozi erya wansi (bass) ettuufu. Bwe yali aweza emyaka ena kitaawe yatwala akaana ako e London, abayimbi abaasinga mu biseera ebyo gye baalaga nti asaanidde okukuzibwa ng'agoberera ekitone kye eky'obutonde ng'omulimu gwe. Kitaawe ne kitaawe omuto tebalabika kuba nga baawakanya n'akatono, era kirabika kyabasanyusa nnyo bwe baakizuula nti omulenzi yeesenza ku nnyimba za lutikko mu butonde bwe. Dr. Boyce ye yamala ebbanga eddene nga ye musomesa we omukulu, era oluvannyuma lwe Omwami Kelway, eyamanyisa omuyizi we era gwe yali awagira eri Kabaka George III.

Wansi w'okusomesebwa kitaawe yafuna emisingi gy'okusoma okw'ennimi ez'edda (Olulatini n'Oluyonaani), n'akula n'empisa ennungi ennyo era kumpi ez'abakungu ab'omu lubiri, era olw'obwesimbu bwe n'omutima gwe ogw'ekisa yali ayagalibwa buli muntu; naye yali tasobola n'akatono kwerabirira mu nsi eno embi, ne kiba nti mwannyina yeewaayo gy'ali, n'aba ng'ekika kya malayika omukuumi, newakubadde nga yali tayagala kweraga.

Omulundi ogwasooka Charles okufuna ekiragiro kya Kabaka okujja mu Buckingham House gwali mu 1775, bwe yali yaakaweza emyaka kkumi na munaana; era yasitulibwa okuyita mu Park mu ntebe ey'okusitulwa (sedan-chair), ng'amaze, bwe kigambibwa, okwambazibwa n'obwegendereza nnyina ne mwannyina. Okuva olwo buli mwaka yayitibwanga e Windsor; era Princess Charlotte bwe yakula okwetaaga omusomesa w'ennyimba, ye yalondebwa ku kifo ekyo. Ku nkomerero yafuuka omukubi wa organ (ekivuga ekinene eky'omu kkanisa) mu Kkanisa y'e Marylebone, era yali amanyiddwa nnyo mu b'ennyimba. Omu eyali amumanyi obulungi yagamba nti, " Mu nnyimba yali malayika; mu buli kintu ekirala yali mwana muto." Kumpi teyalwalako lunaku na lumu, era yafa mu 1834 ng'aweza emyaka nsanvu mu musanvu.

Sally, nga bwe yayitibwanga okumwawula ku nnyina, yazaalibwa e Bristol mu 1759, era okuva ku ntandikwa yali ayagalibwa nnyo kitaawe, eyali omuzadde ow'okwagala okungi ennyo. Newakubadde yali mukozi nnyo ng'atambula ku mbalaasi wakati wa London ne Bristol, era ng'atuukiriza ebiragiro bya muganda we, ebyali bingi era nga bitera okujja, yasobolanga okuwandiikira mukyala we ebbaluwa empanvu ku baana. Akawala kateekwa okuba nga kaali kaweza omwaka nga gumu bwe yawandiika nti: " Asaanidde okufaanana nze, kubanga ajja kuba mwana wange. Omu n'omulala bampa ebirabo bya Charley, naye tewali n'omu alabika okufaayo ku Sally omwavu — ne nnyina we ow'omu batismu alabika okumunyooma." Bulijjo yalowoozanga ku muwala we, ng'amutegekera ebintu ebimwewuunyisa, era ng'alagira nnyina okumusindika ku lusozi okugenda e Gotham okuva ewaabwe mu Stoke's Croft, alyoke afune amaanyi okuva mu mpewo ey'omu byalo. Yakula n'afuuka omusomi omunene, era ku ntandikwa n'ayagala okuba omuwandiisi, mu bitontome kya ddala, kubanga bwe kitandibadde bwe kityo teyandibadde Wesley. John Wesley yali amwagala nnyo, era bwe yali aweza emyaka nga kkumi n'etaano, n'amusuubiza okumutwala naye e Canterbury n'e Dover. Olugambo olw'obuswavu lwasituka olwalabika ng'olumuwaliriza okusigala mu London, era Charles n'amukubiriza okwongezaayo olugendo. " Muganda wange," John bwe yagamba, " bwe nnawaayo eri Katonda okuwummula kwange, ebiseera byange, obulamu bwange, nnaggyako erinnya lyange eddungi? Nedda. Gamba Sally nti nja kumutwala e Canterbury enkya." Yali mukazi mugezi, era yawandiikanga n'omukono omulungi era ogutegeerekeka, nga bulijjo ayogera mu Lungereza olulongoofu, ng'olwo omukyala ow'omu nnaku zino lw'ayinza okuwandiika; era empandiika y'ebigambo bye yali etuukiridde. Buli lulimi lwe yafunanga omukisa okuyiga lwamwanguyira, nga bwe kyali eri kitaawe ne jjajjaawe; era yeeyongerako ku nsimbi ze entono ng'avvuunula ebbaluwa ez'ennimi ez'ebweru eri amawulire ag'omu biseera ebyo. Nga nnyina, yafiirwa obulungi bwe obw'endabika nga akyali muto olwa kawaali, era ekyo ne kyongera ku nsonyi ze ez'obutonde, newakubadde nga zaakendeerako mu myaka gye egy'oluvannyuma. Yawa Dr. Adam Clarke ebintu bingi nnyo ebitonotono bye yakozesa mu kitabo kye Wesley Family. Kizibu okulonda akatontome akampi akalaga engeri ye ey'okuwandiika, naye kano, akaawandiikirwa Campbell bwe yafiirwa omu ku baana be, kyakulabirako kirungi nnyo. Kaasooka okufulumizibwa okuva mu biwandiiko bye ebyawandiikibwa n'omukono mu 1876 mu Memorials ez'Omwami Stevenson, era ne kaddamu okufulumizibwa mu Quiver, wamu n'ebbaluwa ezimu ez'olubereberye eziyiye n'eza mwannyina, emyezi mitono oluvannyuma: — KU KUFA KW'OMWANA OMUWERE. Ku lulwo ensi ey'enkwe tekutegekera Buvubuka obujjudde emitego egy'enkwe: Tewali muliro gwa kwegomba okw'obukambwe Gulikukema n'ekitiibwa mu myaka gyo egikuze; Tewali mululu gulikusendasenda mu bukadde bwo, Ewala n'essanyu eddungi erisaasaana; Oli musanyufu okusinga omukisa ogusinga obulungi, Ng'oggyiddwa mu bibi ebitawaanya abakulu, Mu kutegana okw'okweraliikirira, mu nnyombo eziwamba, Ne mu buli kweraliikirira okw'obulamu obwa wansi. Oli musanyufu! newakubadde nga kumpi tewalinnya Ku kkubo ery'amaggwa eridda eri Katonda, Obulungi obutalina mukwano we bukaabira ne busaba, Emirundi mingi nga bubuze mu kalippagano akabuusabuusa, So tewamanya nti obulungi bwakaaba bwereere — So tewawulira kibi kisinga bulumi, Oli mutukuvu dda mu ggulu, Omwana omwagalwa! eyakaaba bukaabi n'afa!

Miss Wesley yafiira e Bristol, mu kiseera ky'amakungula mu 1828, olw'obulwadde bw'omumiro, ng'aweza emyaka nkaaga mu mwenda. Yaziikibwa mu ntaana y'emu ne bannyina ne baganda be bataano, mu limbo ly'Ekkanisa ya St. James; era Charles, eyali tasobola kukubagizibwa olw'okumufiirwa, era kumpi nga tasobola kwekolera kintu kyonna, n'addayo e London mu kigaali eky'embalaasi ez'okukyusakyusa, ng'asaasaanyizza pawundi amakumi asatu mu mukaaga!

Samuel yazaalibwa nga 24 Febwali 1766, ku lunaku olw'okujjukira omulundi ogw'ekinaana mu ebiri okuzaalibwa kwa Handel. Teyali wa kitone ekyakula mangu mu nnyimba nga Charles, era mu kifo ky'okukuba eddoboozi erya wansi ettuufu ng'awulira buwulizi mu butonde bwe, teyagezaako kulikuba okutuusa lwe yayiga ebiwandiiko by'ennyimba. Omuntu omu yamuwa endingidi entono (violin), era yagikozesanga okuwerekera Charles, n'okuyimba ng'akuba, era olumu, ekyatiisa ennyo abaalina endowooza ez'omu biseera ebyo — nti muganda omukulu muto we ateekwa kumutwala ng'atasobola kukola nsobi — yeetulanga okunenya. Yatandika okuyiiya oratorio eyitibwa Ruth nga tannaweza myaka mukaaga, era yali amaze ddala okugimaliriza n'okugiwandiika bwe yali aweza emyaka munaana, n'agiwa Dr. Boyce n'obwegendereza bungi, eyagikkiriza n'okwebaza okw'ekitiibwa. Ateekwa okuba nga yali akyali mwana muto ddala bwe yakuba organ mu Bath Abbey okumala omwezi gumu, era n'akuba violin esooka mu bivvulu bingi eby'obwannannyini. Yakulaakulana bulungi mu kusoma kwe okwa bulijjo, era yalina amagezi amangi ag'obulijjo.

Charles Wesley bwe yamala okusengukira e London, era ng'abatabani be boogerwako nnyo, Dr. Johnson — eyali, nga bwe kimanyiddwa obulungi, talina kutu kwa nnyimba — n'awulira nti buvunaanyizibwa bwe obutasobola kwewalibwa, olw'okussa ekitiibwa n'omukwano eri ab'omu maka ago, okugenda awulire abalenzi nga bakuba ennyimba. Teyasooka kwetooloola mu nsonga, wabula amangu ago n'aleeta ensonga eyo ng'agamba — mu ngeri ye ey'obuzito — kitaabwe nti, " Ntegeera, Ssebo, nti abalenzi bo bakugu mu nnyimba; nkwegayiridde, ka mbawulire." Bulijjo baali beetegefu, ne batuula ku bivuga byabwe amangu ago. Dr. Johnson n'atwala entebe, n'alonda ekitabo ku kifo ekiri ku ddirisa, amangu ago n'atandika okusoma n'okwekyusakyusa, nga bwe yali empisa ye. Ennyimba bwe zaakoma, n'ayimusa amaaso, n'aggala ekitabo kye, n'agamba nti, " Abasajja abavubuka, mbeebaza nnyo," n'agenda.

Samuel Wesley yali tayagala n'akatono London, era okumala emyaka mingi yanoonya era n'afuna emirimu gy'ennyimba mu byalo. Oluvannyuma lw'okuwasa yabeerako okumala ekiseera okumpi ne Barnet, n'oluvannyuma e Camden Town, eyali ekyali kyalo ddala mu nnaku ezo. Yali muwandiisi wa bbaluwa atakoowa, era yajjuzanga empapula nnyingi n'amawulire ag'ennyimba n'amalala, okusanyusa Charles ne Sally. Yazaala waakiri abaana kkumi, " abasibe abaweebwa ebiseera eby'omu maaso " (hostages to fortune), n'afa mu Okitobba 1837, mu mwaka gwe ogw'ensanvu mu ebiri.

Yawangaala okulaba mutabani we omukulu, Charles, ng'afuuse Doctor of Divinity, era Sub-Dean w'Amasinzizo ga Kabaka (Chapels Royal). Okumala emyaka amakumi asatu Dr. Wesley bwe yali akwatagana ne St. James's Palace, era, mu kifo kye eky'obukulu, yaliwo nga Kwiini Victoria akakasibwa, atikkirwa engule, era afumbirwa, era ne bwe yasabirwa oluvannyuma lw'okuzaala (" churched "), ng'amaze okuzaala omwana we omubereberye, Princess Royal. Yaliwo ku kubatizibwa kw'omwana oyo ow'obwakabaka, era, emyaka kkumi n'omusanvu oluvannyuma, ku bufumbo bwe n'Omulangira Omusika owa Prussia. Yafiira e St. James's mu 1859, n'aleka abawala babiri.

Samuel Sebastian Wesley, amanyiddwa obulungi nga Doctor of Music, yali mutabani wa Samuel Wesley ow'okusatu, era mu buvubuka bwe yali omu ku bayimbi ba Chapel Royal, St. James's. Bwe yali aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu gumu n'okusingawo katono, yalondebwa okuba omukubi wa organ mu Lutikko y'e Hereford, gye yawasiza, oluvannyuma lw'omwaka gumu oba ebiri, mwannyina wa Dean, Dr. Merewether. Mu 1835 yafuuka omukubi wa organ mu Lutikko y'e Exeter; naye bwe yamalayo emyaka musanvu, n'agenda e Leeds, n'akola ng'omukubi wa organ mu kkanisa y'ekigo mu kitundu ku bbanga eddene era ery'amaanyi Dean Hook omugenzi lye yamala ng'akulira ekigo. Mu 1849 yaweebwa ekifo ky'omukubi wa organ mu Lutikko y'e Winchester n'akikkiriza. Kyali kifo ekyamusanyusa ennyo, naddala kubanga kyasobozesa batabani be bataano okusomera mu Winchester School. Mu 1865 yafuuka omukubi wa organ mu Lutikko y'e Gloucester, era okuva olwo n'akola omulimu omukulu mu mikolo gy'ennyimba egy'omu bitundu bya West of England. Babiri ku batabani be basumba mu Kkanisa ya Bungereza, babiri basawo (Doctors of Medicine), era omu yeerwanako okukulaakulana mu Australia. Yafa nga 19 Apuli 1876, ng'akyali ku myaka egitali mingi nnyo egya nkaaga mu mukaaga, egyo, okujuliza ssenga we Sally bwe yali ayogera ku omu ku b'ekika omulala, egyali ewala nnyo okutuuka ku bbanga ly'obulamu " jjajjaffe ab'ekitiibwa lye baatuukako."

Kyewuunyisa nti enzikiriza y'Abametodisiti efunye okusiimibwa kutono nnyo mu kika ky'eyagitandika yennyini. Okuggyako abamu ku bannyinaabwe, abeegatta ku Kibiina, John ne Charles baayimirira bokka mu bulamu bwabwe, ku bikwata ku b'ekika kyabwe, era abasinga obungi ku abo abaabadde n'erinnya lyabwe okuva olwo banywerera nnyo ku Kkanisa ya Bungereza. Kino kye kyandyagadde John yennyini, kubanga teyali wa kwawukana, newakubadde nga teyasobola kuziyiza nkyukakyuka ye yali ensibuko yaayo enkulu; era teyayagala kugiziyiza, naye teyalaba nti yandireese okwawukana. Kyokka omusaayi gweyoleka, era ebitone bingi nnyo n'amaanyi bikyalabikira mu bazzukulu bonna ab'ekika ky'e Epworth. Nga bayanguyiriza era nga ba magezi ga mangu, era, oboolyawo, nga tebeeraliikirira nnyo bya nkya, bonna bateekwa okuba nga bali ku bigere nga bakola, era mu mpisa zino balaga bulungi olulyo lwabwe, n'amaanyi g'ensibuko eyo ey'olubereberye ekyali ewala ennyo okuggwaamu amaanyi.
